title: IC - Construction Takeoff Specialist
description:
Before You Apply

Please note this is an Independent Contractor opportunity for professionals located in Latin America. This engagement does not constitute employment and does not include employee benefits. Contractors are expected to provide their own computer, internet connection, and any required software licenses except for Company-provided coded tools.

About the Opportunity

High-Light Electric, Inc., part of Mendoza Companies, is seeking a detail-oriented Independent Contractor to provide Digital Takeoff Services supporting our Electrical Estimating team.

This is a fully remote independent contractor engagement for professionals located in Latin America who have experience performing digital quantity takeoffs for construction projects.

The contractor will support the estimating process by converting construction drawings and specifications into organized, coded quantity data used by our estimating team.

This engagement is structured around project-based deliverables rather than employment, offering flexibility while supporting a growing estimating operation.

What You'll Do

As part of each assigned project, you will:

  • Perform complete digital quantity takeoffs using Bluebeam and Company-provided coded tools.
  • Apply the appropriate work/cost codes to all quantified items.
  • Prepare takeoff files in a format that can be imported into the Company's estimating spreadsheets.
  • Identify plan conflicts, specification discrepancies, missing information, and scope questions for estimator review.
  • Prepare concise takeoff summary reports documenting assumptions and observations.
  • Participate in estimating discussions to answer questions regarding completed takeoffs.
  • Continuously study Company standards, plans, specifications, and public works documentation to improve deliverable quality.
  • Contribute recommendations that help improve estimating tools, coding standards, and takeoff methodologies.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for professionals who demonstrate:

  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • Strong analytical thinking
  • Ability to interpret construction plans and specifications
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Excellent organization and documentation skills
  • Ability to meet agreed project deadlines
  • Proactive communication regarding questions and conflicts
  • Ability to produce complete, accurate, and well-documented deliverables with minimal oversight

How This Engagement Works

Project assignments are reviewed and coordinated during recurring planning meetings.

For each project package:

  • The estimated number of hours is agreed upon before work begins.
  • Deliverables are reviewed upon completion.
  • Approved work is invoiced according to the agreed engagement.
  • Additional work resulting from project addenda is managed separately.

There is no guaranteed minimum volume of work, as each assignment is an individual project engagement.

Independent Contractor Requirements

To be considered for this engagement, contractors must:

  • Operate as an independent contractor.
  • Provide their own computer.
  • Provide their own reliable internet connection.
  • Provide their own software licenses except for Company-provided coded tools and materials.
  • Be responsible for their own taxes, insurance, and benefits.
  • Be able to provide services remotely from Latin America.

Growth Opportunities

As our estimating operations continue to expand, contractors who consistently demonstrate accuracy, reliability, and high-quality deliverables may become eligible for:

  • Larger and more complex project assignments
  • Greater autonomy
  • Opportunities to help train and support future takeoff contractors

Expanded responsibilities are based on demonstrated performance and business needs.

Equal Opportunity

High-Light Electric, Inc. is committed to providing equal opportunity and considers qualified applicants without regard to any protected characteristic under applicable law.

Important Information

This opportunity is for an independent contractor engagement and is not an offer of employment. Contractors are engaged on a project-by-project basis, maintain control over the means and methods used to perform the services, and are responsible for providing their own equipment, internet connection, taxes, insurance, and any other business expenses consistent with their independent contractor status.

Salary: $11 to $14 per hour

Why Join SSOE?

At SSOE, you'll be at the forefront of delivering transformative technology initiatives that shape and build environments that drive operational excellence. Here's what sets us apart:

  • Strategic Impact: Lead critical initiatives with executive visibility and the autonomy to influence organizational strategy.
  • Technical Excellence: Work on cutting-edge technology projects involving cloud architecture, AI integration, digital transformation, and enterprise-scale systems.
  • Growth & Development: Mentor the next generation of project leaders while advancing your own skills in a culture that values continuous learning.
  • Innovation Culture: Join a team that embraces new technologies, encourages creative problem-solving, and values both technical depth and strategic thinking.
  • Competitive Salary: $140K-150K/year depending on location, education, experience, and certifications.

title: Boyd Thermal by Eaton - Metallurgy/Metal Joining Subject Matter
description:
Job Description


The Metallurgy/Metal Joining Subject Matter Expert (SME) will serve as the technical authority on materials engineering and metal joining initiatives. They will define best practices in physical and chemical metallurgy, develop advanced welding and joining procedures, and ensure our manufacturing processes produce safe, durable, and high-performance components. Engagement will be for near term and future R&D efforts.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Metal Joining & Welding Leadership
  • Develop, qualify, and optimize metal joining procedures (e.g., fusion welding, solid-state joining, brazing).
  • Evaluate weld thermal cycles, microstructural changes in the Heat-Affected Zone (HAZ), and potential defects to ensure structural integrity.
  • Advise on the selection of filler metals, shielding gases, and post-weld heat treatments (PWHT).
  • Metallurgical Analysis & Testing
  • Analyze the physical, chemical, and mechanical properties of metals and alloys.
  • Perform root-cause failure analysis (including fractography and microscopy) to determine why components fail in the field or during testing.
  • Oversee metallurgical lab operations, including mechanical testing and microstructural characterization.
  • R&D and Process Optimization
  • Spearhead research and development for innovative joining techniques.
  • Collaborate with design and production teams to ensure material specifications align with project requirements and manufacturing capabilities.
  • Evaluated advanced manufacturing process options to improve joint reliability/repeatability through process automation.
  • Compliance & Mentorship
  • Ensure all metallurgical processes and joint designs comply with industry standards (e.g., ASME, AWS, API) and regulatory requirements.
  • Mentor engineers, technicians, and production staff on metallurgical best practices.

Basic Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Metallurgy, Materials Science, or Welding Engineering.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in physical/mechanical metallurgy, specifically focusing on metal joining processes in sectors like aerospace, automotive, or heavy manufacturing.
  • Deep understanding of phase transformations, residual stress, and the ductile-to-brittle transition temperature in welded joints.
  • Experience with computational metallurgy software (e.g., Thermo-Calc, JMatPro) and materials characterization equipment (SEM, XRD, OES).
  • Exceptional technical writing and presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex metallurgical data into actionable engineering solutions

Job Summary:

The Standard’s Individual Annuities division has an open role responsible for driving and supporting work related to our financial reporting team: FP&A, valuation, reserve analytics, hedging, reinsurance, and business performance.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys owning financial results related to highly visible functions that impact our financial results and strategic direction and will play a key role in the production, analysis, and communication of financial results and projections of our MYGA and FIA businesses, partnering closely with pricing, modeling, ALM, and finance teams.

Responsibilities include reporting, valuation, earnings analysis, reserve attribution analysis, as well as supporting key strategic initiative / teams such as affiliate reinsurance, modeling, VM22 team, and business integration. This is a high impact individual contributor role, with near term leadership opportunities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own execution and enhancement of reporting, valuation, earnings analysis, FP&A, and hedging and communicate results to senior management.
  • Design and implement reporting support for functions such as VM22, reinsurance, and business integration.
  • Analyze GAAP, statutory, and management reporting results, including reserves, earnings, and capital movements.
  • Enhance governance model (change management, internal controls, and offshore partner review).
  • Partner with pricing, modeling, and corporate actuarial to ensure consistency in understanding stakeholder needs and effective/aligned story telling.
  • Analyze results—identify drivers, limitations, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop and improve analytical tools, reporting processes, and speed / clarity of processes and capabilities.
  • Provide mentorship and project leadership to onshore and offshore team members related to core team responsibilities.

Certification: ASA required/FSA preferred

Experience:

  • Modeling experience including change management, internal controls & review required.
  • FP&A and FIA financial reporting experience (preferred)

Utilizes Company and industry practices to complete risk-based analysis and propose appropriate risk-based opportunities. (Salary Range: $131,750.00 - $192,500.00)

title: ServiceNow CSM Solution Architect (Freelance mogelijk)

Als ServiceNow CSM Architect neem je de technische voortrekkersrol op in de verdere evolutie van de CSM-oplossing. Je werkt nauw samen met een business analist en een CSM Developer aan de realisatie van de volgende fase van het platform.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Bachelor of master in ICT, of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Minstens 10 jaar ervaring met ServiceNow, inclusief diepgaande hands-on expertise in de CSM-module en de platformarchitectuur.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring in een technische lead- of architectuurrol binnen ServiceNow-implementaties.
  • Ervaring met technische requirementsanalyse en het uitwerken van toekomstbestendig architectuurontwerp.
  • Sterke ervaring met casetype-architectuur, portaalarchitectuur en integratiearchitectuur binnen CSM.
  • Diepgaand inzicht in ServiceNow-architectuur, datamodel en Customer Service Management.
  • Sterke hands-on ontwikkelvaardigheden in JavaScript/GlideScript, Flow Designer en UI Builder.
  • Kennis van beveiligingsarchitectuur en RBAC binnen ServiceNow.
  • Ervaring met code reviews, kwaliteitsbewaking en het definiëren van technische standaarden.
  • Uitstekende communicatie- en stakeholdervaardigheden.
  • Je treedt op als inhoudelijke expert en durft voorstellen kritisch te challengen.

  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands of Frans: één van beide talen gebruik je als voertaal en de andere beheers je minstens zeer goed.
  • Goede kennis van het Engels.

Pluspunten

  • Ervaring binnen de federale overheid.

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. title: 2nd Shift QC Technician
description:
Video Showcasing Job Responsibilities

Position Summary:

The Quality Control Technician is responsible for carrying out daily quality control and food safety activities throughout the processing facility to ensure products meet safety, regulatory, and customer standards. The QC Tech is expected to work closely with operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Follow all food safety, food quality, food defense, and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) programs
  • Perform pre-operational inspections of the processing facility prior to production
  • Sample and evaluate product attributes, accurately document results, and communicate issues to the Supervisor when standards are not met
  • Work with USDA inspectors to ensure compliance with all regulatory and food safety requirements
  • Monitor packaging operations to confirm product accuracy, labeling, and order counts.
  • Conduct and document non-conformances and corrective actions
  • Perform receiving inspections, equipment checks, calibration verification, and basic quality-related lab testing
  • Maintain accurate and complete quality records and notify supervision when supplies are low
  • Perform other related duties as assigned
  • Maintain a clean and safe work area by following GMPs, safety procedures, and wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)

Qualifications:

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and food safety standard
  • Ability to communicate effectively and use basic problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in a production environment
  • Ability to stand for long periods (up to 10 hours) and perform repetitive tasks
  • Prior experience in food manufacturing or quality control preferred

Resumen del Puesto:

El Técnico de Control de Calidad es responsable de realizar actividades diarias de control de calidad e inocuidad alimentaria en toda la planta de procesamiento, con el fin de garantizar que los productos cumplan con los estándares de seguridad, regulatorios y del cliente. El Técnico de Control de Calidad debe trabajar en estrecha colaboración con el área de operaciones.

Responsabilidades Principales:

  • Seguir todos los programas de inocuidad alimentaria, calidad del producto, defensa alimentaria y Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (GMP)
  • Realizar inspecciones preoperacionales de la planta de procesamiento antes del inicio de la producción
  • Tomar muestras y evaluar atributos del producto, documentar resultados con precisión y comunicar cualquier desviación al supervisor cuando no se cumplan los estándares
  • Trabajar con inspectores del USDA para asegurar el cumplimiento de los requisitos regulatorios y de inocuidad alimentaria
  • Monitorear las operaciones de empaque para verificar la exactitud del producto, el etiquetado y el conteo de pedidos
  • Registrar y dar seguimiento a no conformidades y acciones correctivas
  • Realizar inspecciones de recepción, revisiones de equipos, verificación de calibraciones y pruebas básicas de laboratorio relacionadas con calidad
  • Mantener registros de calidad precisos y completos, y notificar a la supervisión cuando los suministros estén bajos
  • Realizar otras tareas relacionadas según se asignen
  • Mantener un área de trabajo limpia y segura siguiendo las Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (GMP), los procedimientos de seguridad y utilizando el Equipo de Protección Personal (PPE) requerido

Calificaciones:

  • Gran atención al detalle y compromiso con los estándares de calidad e inocuidad alimentaria
  • Capacidad para comunicarse de manera efectiva y utilizar habilidades básicas de resolución de problemas
  • Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente en un entorno de producción
  • Capacidad para permanecer de pie por períodos prolongados (hasta 10 horas) y realizar tareas repetitivas
  • Experiencia previa en manufactura de alimentos o control de calidad (preferida)

title: PRN - RN
description:
PRN - Registered Nurse

Eye Specialty Group is seeking a PRN - RN to help make a difference. This RN will work on an as needed basis at our ASCs in Memphis, TN; Southaven and Olive Branch, MS. Candidates will need availability to work Monday-Thursday. There is no call, weekends, or major holidays with these positions. If interested, please apply.

Position Summary:

The Registered Nurse is responsible for providing nursing care to surgery center patients including assessments, and clinical care such as medication administration, placing IVs, and providing waived testing. The position will complete all required documentation as needed.


Essential Skills/Responsibilities:

  • Performs the practice of nursing as stated by the Scope of Practice mandated by the TN and MS Board of Nursing. Follows the guidelines recommended by the AORN. Demonstrates competency to circulate ophthalmology cases and performs assessment of patients according to the centers’ policies and procedures.
  • Maintains confidential information acquired concerning patients personal, financial, and medical information obtained at the centers.
  • Maintains and develops nursing skills through department educational in-services.
  • Reports to work at assigned times.
  • Completes annual competency requirements.
  • Maintains an open line of communication within the chain of command.
  • Accepts any other assigned duties within their scope of practice to keep the Centers’ patient care flowing smoothly.
  • Adheres to all of the Centers’ safety guidelines and their policies and procedures.
  • Manages and operates equipment safely and correctly.
  • Demonstrates an ability to assist physicians in an outpatient setting.
  • Maintains a good working relationship and effective communication both within the department and with other departments for the benefit of the patient.
  • Demonstrates an ability to be flexible, organized and function under stressful situations.
  • Coordinates and supervises patient care.
  • Provides clinical services including inserting IVs, taking vital signs, administering blood glucose testing.
  • Administers medications according to physician orders.
  • Performs a proper preoperative assessment in accordance with the centers policy and procedures and as needed postoperatively.
  • Assesses and re-assesses the patient’s pain level. Utilizes appropriate pain management techniques. Educates the patient and family regarding pain management.
  • Gives care to the patient, reflecting flexibility in rules and regulations, as indicated by individual patient needs.
  • Makes decisions reflecting knowledge of facts, knowledge of diseases/surgical conditions, care required and good judgment.
  • Performs point-of-care testing as needed, interprets results and takes appropriate action in accordance to unit’s policies and procedures.
  • Reflects knowledge in all areas of care specific to outpatient surgery (i.e., ophthalmology, lasers, sedation).
  • Organizes and manages nursing activities reflecting due consideration for patients’ needs and the needs of the facility and staff.
  • Knows medications and IV fluids and their correct administration, based on age of the patient and patient’s clinical condition.
  • Follows the five (5) medication rights and reduces the potential for medication errors.
  • Formulates a teaching plan, based on identified patient learning needs, and evaluates effectiveness of learning; family is included in teaching, as appropriate, from pre-op to discharge.
  • Provides patient with explanation and verbal re-assurance consistently.
  • Identifies physical symptoms on an ongoing basis and takes appropriate action in a timely manner if needed.
  • Performs all aspects of patient care in an environment that optimizes patient safety and reduces the likelihood of medical/health care errors.
  • Manages and operates equipment safely and correctly.
  • Demonstrates an ability to assist physicians in the OR when needed.
  • Treats patients and their families with respect and dignity. Practices good guest relations.
  • Identifies and addresses psychosocial needs of patients and family.
  • Carries out sterile technique during treatments and special procedures.
  • Maintains an environment that provides the patient and family with feelings of safety and security.
  • Consults other departments, as needed and as appropriate, to provide for an interdisciplinary approach to the patient’s needs.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders across the company to understand their needs and to deliver robust, flexible solutions and clear insights to meet those needs. You will build data solutions end to end: architecture, implementation, CI/CD and orchestration of pipelines, QA, visualization and effective data communication. You’ll be part of the Data Team within the Software Engineering organization, which is made up of data scientists, engineers and analysts working on similar tasks across Planet domains.

You will own the ongoing evolution of data solutions supporting monitoring and analysis of Planet’s Missions team and Constellation Services (CxS) products, a new line of products which support large customers in buying secure access and reserved capacity on our satellites. You will collaborate closely with CxS-focused counterparts on our Product, Engineering, Space Systems and Commercial orgs to ensure they have the data they need to evaluate the success of the products. This role will appeal to candidates who are looking for opportunities to evolve a complex data system end to end and bring needed technology to the defense and intelligence sector.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

About the University

We have one simple promise – to make a positive impact. Through our ground-breaking research, teaching excellence and commitment to sustainable living, we are changing lives for the better.

About the College/Department

Here at the University of Derby, the College of Science and Engineering is the home STEM, the skills that are essential to the UK’s Industrial Strategy. From digitisation to decarbonisation, we have an important role to play in shaping the future. And by researching or collaborating with us, you can too.

The College brings together a powerful combination of scientific expertise, technological innovation, and creative practice. With disciplines spanning computing, AI, Data Science, engineering, environmental sciences, built environments and Psychology. We are uniquely positioned to solve real-world challenges through interdisciplinary collaboration.

Our courses are designed with employability and future industry needs in mind, supported by cutting-edge facilities, strong employer partnerships, and a commitment to sustainability. Through applied research and hands-on learning, we equip students and staff to drive progress in areas that matter most; from smart technology to clean energy, advanced manufacturing to immersive design.

School of Computing

This is an exciting time in Computing, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at the University of Derby. Building on recent Research Excellence Framework (REF) success, our school has ambitions to become leaders in these areas. In the last ten years, we’ve invested heavily in our facilities, including a £13mSTEM centre. We aspire to be at the forefront of teaching and research around topics such as machine learning, artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things and complex networks. OurData Science Research Centrewill play a key role in this.

Our engagement with global industries based in the Derby region, for example through ourEast Midlands Institute of Technology, helps ensure that our research and teaching are at the forefront of emerging industry needs and opportunities. Our links with companies in our region includingBloc Digital,Rolls-RoyceandAlstom, also mean our students benefit from placement years and live briefs.

About ZapCarbon Ltd

ZapCarbon is an award-winning UK environmental innovation company that develops low-carbon technologies and data-driven solutions to improve energy efficiency, reduce carbon emissions, and create healthier homes. Since its founding in 2006, the company has worked with public and private sector organisations to deliver practical innovations that support sustainability, energy optimisation, and net-zero ambitions.

The company’s mission is to create positive environmental and social impact through innovation, collaborating with partners to drive systemic change that benefits both people and the planet. Its portfolio includes smart home monitoring technologies, healthy homes solutions, and energy-saving products that help housing providers, developers, and property managers improve building performance, resident wellbeing, and environmental outcomes.

ZapCarbon's values are centred on sustainability, innovation, collaboration, and social responsibility. Through a strong commitment to research and development, the company seeks to deliver practical, scalable solutions that tackle real-world challenges such as energy consumption, damp and mould prevention, fuel poverty, and carbon reduction.

As a KTP Associate, you will join a forward-thinking organisation with a proven track record of innovation and a passion for developing technologies that contribute to a more sustainable future.

About the Role

University of Derby’s College of Science and Engineering in partnership with ZapCarbon Ltd are offering an exciting career-development opportunity to manage and deliver a challenging strategic Knowledge Transfer Partnership (KTP) project. Based at ZapCarbon’s premises in Leighton Buzzard, you will be employed by the University as a KTP Associate but work under the terms and conditions of the company.

You will lead a major innovation programme, developing and delivering a scalable, AI-driven system that enables housing providers to better interpret and act on large-scale building data, improving maintenance decision-making, reducing costs and supporting the decarbonisation of housing stock.

Working at the heart of the business, you will take ownership of the full project lifecycle from acquiring and integrating multiple data sources, developing and validating machine learning models, building data pipelines and dashboards, and translating technical outputs into actionable insights for operational and strategic stakeholders.

Using your knowledge and skills to support the business and achieve specific project aims, you will receive on-going support by a Supervisor at ZapCarbon, an Academic Supervisor and Academic Lead from the University of Derby to help you deliver. A personal training and development budget will also be available for you to access, as well as receiving access to the same training opportunities and facilities as University staff.

This is an exciting opportunity to manage and deliver a challenging strategically important project working with academic mentors and key support from the company to transfer academic expertise into a real-world business environment. This role offers significant career development, providing hands-on experience in applied AI, machine learning, data engineering and digital innovation within a commercial environment.

Knowledge Transfer Partnerships

This full-time post is part-funded by the UK Government’s KTP programme. A KTP is a three-way project between a graduate, an organisation and a university. KTP is one of the UK’s largest graduate recruitment programmes and has been placing graduates on challenging, high profile projects for 50 years. In addition to a competitive salary and core KTP development training, you will have a dedicated budget of £4,000 further training and career development. To find out more about the scheme visit: ktp-uk.org/graduates

Please note by completing an application form for this role, you are giving your consent for us to share your personal data with the KTP partner.

About You

We are looking for a highly motivated and technically skilled individual who is excited by the opportunity to apply advanced data science and AI techniques to real-world challenges. You will hold a Master's degree in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science or a closely related discipline, or a Bachelor's degree in a related field backed by substantial relevant experience, and you will bring proven experience of developing machine learning models using complex, multi-source datasets.

You will be confident working across the full data lifecycle from data engineering and model development through to deployment into practical tools such as dashboards or decision-support systems and able to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Strong programming skills in Python, alongside proficiency in SQL, are essential, as is a solid understanding of machine learning workflows, model validation and performance evaluation. You will be comfortable designing scalable analytical solutions, integrating data from a variety of sources (including sensor data), and working with visualisation tools such as Power BI.

Just as importantly, you will be organised, proactive and able to manage your own workload, balancing multiple priorities and delivering to deadlines within a fast-paced, collaborative environment. The role involves collaborating with senior managers, operational teams, academic experts and external partners, so you will need the confidence and interpersonal skills to engage people at all levels, explain complex ideas clearly, and bring others with you on the journey.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are a strong technical foundation in machine learning and data engineering, the ability to translate analysis into real-world applications, and a genuine interest in applying your expertise to sustainability, housing and net zero challenges.

Benefits

Whilst you will be employed by University of Derby, your terms and conditions will be that of ZapCarbon Ltd.

Key Contact

For further information and informal enquiries regarding the role, please contact Christopher Sansom, Zero Carbon Research Theme Lead via c.sansom@derby.ac.uk

For enquiries regarding your application and for sponsorship eligibility, please contact the recruitment team via recruitment@derby.ac.uk

Important Information

This role may be eligible for sponsorship by the University.

The offered salary for this role is less than the going rate for the occupation and the minimum salary threshold for the Skilled Worker route (£41,700 per annum, as of 22nd July 2025). Therefore you will only be eligible to apply for a Skilled Worker visa subject to your individual circumstances which must meet one of the following criteria set out by UKVI:

  • Your job is on the Immigration Skills List
  • You’re under 26, studying or a recent graduate, or in professional training
  • You have a PhD level qualification that’s relevant to your job
  • You have a postdoctoral position in science or higher education

You must also meet the English Language requirement.

Broadcast Engineer - Part Time Weekend Positions

New York Public Radio, home to WNYC, WQXR, New Jersey Public Radio, WNYC Studios, Gothamist and The Greene Space, is seeking two part-time Broadcast Engineers in our Programming Department. These two positions will support breaking news, local news, and provide production and technical support to the broadcast teams on the weekend. The station needs one engineer to support the morning shift and one engineer to support the afternoon/evening shift, both on the weekend.

Broadcast Engineers are the technical professionals at the heart of New York Public Radio. They operate studio equipment alongside reporters and producers in the creation of live broadcasts, podcasts, in-person performances, videos and more in service of NYPR’s public service mission. These Broadcast Engineer positions will run the live control board for New York Public Radio’s signature shows on the weekends, and will also assist on all other production needs within the Programming Department.

This position will report to the Director of Broadcast Operations in the WNYC Programming Department.

The successful candidate will have a good sense of the New York Public Radio sound, some knowledge of New York Public Radio programs, superior attention to detail, and a background in live audio production. The position requires excellent people skills as much of the job will require interfacing with content producers at NYPR.


Responsibilities

• Operate the board during local broadcasts on weekend live shows, fundraisers, and breaking news events.

• Support the on‑air hosts at all times.

• Record live interviews with both in studio and remote guests.

• Use digital audio work tools to produce and mix stories for air

• Update news content for breaking news.

• Communicate with Programming, News and Broadcast Technology colleagues throughout the weekends.

• Provide disaster recovery support.

Qualifications

• At least 3 years of experience in live audio production, preferably live radio production.

• Familiarity with the sound of New York Public Radio or public radio generally.

• Familiarity with the Zetta On‑Air Delivery system is helpful.

• Fluency in audio editing, knowledge of live on‑air board protocols and other systems for broadcast/digital delivery of audio.

• Experience using ISDN, AoIP or phone hybrids.

• Ability to work within a highly collaborative team in a fast‑paced environment.

• Excellent communication skills.

Additional Information

This is a part-time non-exempt role with an hourly rate of $38.85.

The morning shift runs Saturdays and Sundays from 6am to 2pm (16 hours/week at $38.86/hour; $32,331.52/year).

The afternoon/evening shift runs Saturdays and Sundays from 12:30 p.m. to 8:30 p.m., and one additional day (Friday) from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.pm (25 hours/week at $38.86/hour; approximately $50,518/year), with additional production support and fill-in responsibilities.

title: Corporate Tax Analyst
description:
Team description

SumUp's Compliance and Control tax team keeps corporate income tax filings accurate and on time across more than 38 entities in Europe and Australia, protecting the business from compliance and governance risk. You'll sit at the centre of that work, preparing draft tax returns and supporting workpapers, managing a live compliance calendar, and coordinating directly with external advisors, while the Corporate Tax Principal owns the technical positions and final sign off. It's a chance to build real, hands on expertise across multiple jurisdictions from day one, working alongside a small, collaborative tax team that values clear communication over guesswork.

What you'll do

  • Prepare draft corporate income tax (CIT) returns and supporting workpapers for entities in scope, based on positions set by the Corporate Tax Principal

  • Maintain a master compliance calendar covering filing deadlines, payments and statutory submissions, flagging risks early

  • Coordinate day to day with local tax advisors on data requests, drafts and timelines

  • Run pre filing checks and reconciliations, including tax return to general ledger tie outs

  • Keep audit ready documentation for every filing, including return packages, reconciliations and sign offs

  • Support wider tax team initiatives, including work to standardise templates and improve automation

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Experience preparing corporate income tax returns and audit ready workpapers, gained in a Big 4, mid-tier firm or in house tax team

  • Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups and building structured reconciliation files

  • Comfort working with ERP outputs (ideally SAP) and financial statements

  • Ability to manage multiple deadlines across several jurisdictions and advisors without losing sight of the detail

  • Clear, confident English communication, with the judgement to flag questions and risks early rather than guess

Why you should join SumUp

🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our modern Sofia office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 and 10 paid days of educational leave which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

🏖 Generous time off: 25 days of paid leave, plus one extra day per year of service (up to 35), along with public holidays and special leave options

🏥 Peace of mind: additional health insurance and life insurance

💪 Stay active: on-site yoga and a co-sponsored Multisport card offering access to hundreds of sports facilities

🍽 Meal support: benefit from a tax-free food voucher program plus flexibility via our Re:Benefits platform

🚌 Easy commute: free shuttle buses connecting directly to Joliot-Curie metro station

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 38 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. title: Director of Revenue Enablement
description:
About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic and collaborative Director of Revenue Enablement to help scale our go-to-market organization. In this role, you'll partner across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, Recruiting, and Learning & Development to ensure our customer-facing teams have the knowledge, tools, processes, and content they need to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive business results.

You'll serve as the connective tissue across our GTM organization—translating strategy into execution, identifying performance gaps, enabling successful product launches, and creating scalable programs that improve sales effectiveness and customer outcomes.

If you enjoy solving sales challenges, influencing cross-functional teams, and building programs that have measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

Sales Enablement & Training

  • Design, build, and continuously improve onboarding programs to accelerate new-hire ramp time.
  • Develop ongoing training programs that strengthen product knowledge, consultative selling, objection handling, and customer experience.
  • Create certifications, learning paths, coaching resources, and sales enablement programs.
  • Analyze sales performance trends and identify opportunities for targeted enablement initiatives.

Data & Feedback Loop

  • Analyze conversion, win/loss, and retention data to identify what's working and feed it back into training
  • Review call recordings and customer interactions to surface best practices from top performers and turn them into repeatable playbooks
  • Track and report on enablement-specific metrics and their downstream impact on conversion or win rate

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate positioning, messaging, and competitive insights into practical sales playbooks, talk tracks, FAQs, and customer-facing resources.
  • Collaborate with Product Management to prepare customer-facing teams for product launches by developing training, enablement content, and readiness plans.
  • Work closely with Marketing to ensure campaign messaging is consistently reflected throughout the customer journey.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to support CRM adoption, process improvements, sales workflows, and operational readiness.
  • Collaborate with Customer Experience and Customer Success teams to improve onboarding, retention, upsell, and support experiences.
  • Gather frontline feedback and communicate customer insights back to Product, Marketing, and Sales Leadership to continuously improve our GTM strategy.

Content & Communication

  • Create and refine high-converting playbooks, call scripts, objection-handling guides, and cross-sell/upsell matrices for the sales team.
  • Own the organization and maintenance of sales enablement content, including playbooks, product documentation, competitive battle cards, sales presentations, and knowledge resources.
  • Ensure customer-facing teams have easy access to current, accurate, and actionable enablement materials.
  • Package customer proof points, case studies, and FAQs into reusable assets teams can pull from in the moment
  • Develop scalable communication plans for product launches, process updates, and organizational changes.

Tools & Process

  • Own or co-own enablement tooling (e.g., CRM/helpdesk macros, content/asset libraries, call recording platforms) so teams can find the right resource in seconds, not minutes
  • Partner with RevOps to keep CRM data clean and process consistent across teams

What You'll Bring

  • Prior experience carrying an individual sales quota or serving in a consultative customer-facing role (Sales, Business Development, Account Management, Customer Success, Retail Leadership, or similar). You understand firsthand what it takes to build trust with customers, navigate objections, and operate in a performance-driven environment.
  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing revenue role and/or Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, Sales Operations, Product Marketing, or a related GTM function.
  • Experience designing and scaling enablement programs that improve onboarding, sales readiness, product adoption, or customer experience.
  • Proven ability to build trusted partnerships across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, and executive leadership.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and influence audiences ranging from frontline employees to senior leaders.
  • An analytical mindset with experience using performance metrics, customer feedback, and business insights to identify opportunities and measure the impact of enablement initiatives.
  • A builder's mentality—you enjoy creating scalable programs, playbooks, and processes that help teams perform at their best.
  • High emotional intelligence and credibility. You listen before prescribing solutions, seek to understand the realities of frontline teams, and earn trust through empathy, collaboration, and thoughtful execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a direct-to-consumer, retail, consumer technology, marketplace, or high-growth environment.
  • Experience supporting product launches and go-to-market initiatives across multiple customer-facing teams.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar), learning management systems, and enablement tools such as Gong, Highspot, Seismic, WorkRamp, or similar platforms.
  • Experience coaching managers or facilitating leadership development programs.

Success in This Role

After your first 60-days, you will have:

  • Built scalable onboarding and ongoing enablement programs that improve sales readiness and consistency.
  • Successfully enabled multiple product launches across customer-facing teams.
  • Established trusted partnerships across Sales, Product, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Customer Experience.
  • Increased adoption of key sales processes, tools, and messaging.
  • Demonstrated measurable improvements in ramp time, productivity, customer experience, or sales effectiveness.
  • Become a strategic partner who helps connect business strategy with frontline execution.

Why This Role Matters

Our customers experience our brand through every interaction with our teams. This role helps ensure those interactions are consistent, informed, and customer-centric. By connecting strategy with execution and enabling our teams to perform at their best, you'll play a critical role in helping us scale our business while delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Why You'll Love Inspira

  • Amazing people with a great vision and values
  • Mission-driven team culture focused on student success
  • Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, base plans 100% employer paid
  • Pre-tax benefits (FSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter)
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • 401(k) with company match

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group.

Inspira Education Group does not discriminate based on race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in providing employment opportunities and benefits.

title: Enterprise Systems Specialist
description:
Work Schedule

Standard Office Hours (40/wk)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

DESCRIPTION

Position Overview

As Enterprise Systems Specialist at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will play a crucial role in supporting the implementation, lifecycle management, and ongoing operation of business-critical enterprise applications at the manufacturing site level.

You will act as a key coordination point between site business users, Global IT and Application teams, ERP teams, Infrastructure, vendors, implementation partners, and support teams. You will use your functional and technical knowledge of enterprise applications and business processes to clarify requirements, support process reengineering, manage site-level application governance, and coordinate activities across the full application lifecycle.

You will also play a key role in the site's multi-year PMX decommissioning program, supporting the transition of material handling, warehouse, and quality-related processes to SAP while ensuring reliable operation and continuity of existing enterprise applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the main site-level IT coordination, support, and governance contact for assigned applications and related projects.

  • Build strong working relationships with Supply Chain, Quality, Warehouse, Manufacturing, Engineering, Procurement, Site IT, Global Application teams, ERP teams, vendors, and implementation partners.

  • Coordinate application lifecycle activities including requirements, design, configuration, testing, training, go-live, hypercare, support handover, upgrades, and steady-state operations.

  • Play a key role in the PMX decommissioning program, coordinating site activities related to the transition of material handling, warehouse, and quality processes to SAP.

  • Track, prioritize, and escalate application issues, risks, dependencies, decisions, and readiness actions, ensuring clear business impact, ownership, and timely follow-up.

  • Coordinate functional and technical discussions between site users, Global IT teams, ERP teams, Application teams, vendors, and implementation partners.

  • Capture business feedback, process gaps, user needs, integration requirements, and local constraints in a structured way.

  • Coordinate site readiness for user access, roles, master data dependencies, interfaces, infrastructure requirements, and connectivity.

  • Support testing, validation, and compliance activities by coordinating business inputs and action closure with Quality and Validation teams.

  • Support and maintain assigned enterprise applications such as SAP-related solutions, Maximo, Kinaxis, PlanetTogether, and other business-critical platforms.

  • Coordinate vendors and support providers for incidents, changes, upgrades, and application lifecycle activities.

Compliance & Documentation

  • Ensure documentation readiness for enterprise applications, user roles, business processes, support models, SOPs, work instructions, and training materials.

  • Coordinate CSV and compliance inputs with Quality and Validation teams for GxP-relevant applications.

  • Ensure documentation is updated when applications, interfaces, access models, business processes, or support models change.

  • Support periodic user access reviews, application lifecycle reviews, and other required compliance activities.

  • Maintain clear records of key decisions, open actions, issue follow-up, knowledge transfer, and support handover.

  • Support internal, customer, and regulatory audits by providing required application documentation and follow-up.

Continuous Improvement

  • Coordinate site support for assigned applications and ensure effective user support and issue follow-up.

  • Identify recurring issues, support gaps, training needs, technical debt, and improvement opportunities.

  • Coordinate application changes, impact assessments, testing, documentation updates, training, and user adoption.

  • Support process simplification and standardization through global enterprise platforms and reduced reliance on legacy or locally customized solutions.

  • Contribute to application lifecycle planning, upgrade roadmaps, and replacement strategies.

REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Information Systems, or related field.

  • Experience supporting enterprise application implementations, lifecycle management, or Site IT projects in manufacturing environments.

  • Strong understanding of business processes supported by enterprise applications, including warehouse, material management, supply chain, quality, maintenance, or related functions.

  • Strong functional and technical understanding of enterprise applications and their integration within manufacturing environments.

  • Experience in business process reengineering, requirements clarification, and translating business needs into system requirements.

  • Understanding of regulated manufacturing environments and CSV expectations is preferred.

Key Proficiencies

  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coordination, follow-up, and issue-tracking skills.

  • Good ability to build effective relationships across business, Site IT, global application teams, and external partners.

  • Knowledge of enterprise application lifecycle management, including requirements, configuration, testing, deployment, support, change management, and upgrades.

  • Good understanding of SAP and its integration with manufacturing, warehouse, quality, maintenance, MES, and other enterprise applications.

  • Knowledge of Maximo, Kinaxis, PlanetTogether, PMX, PharmaSuite, or comparable enterprise platforms is an advantage.

  • Understanding of application interfaces, master data, user roles and access, integrations, and support models.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into clear functional and technical inputs for global or external delivery teams.

  • Practical problem-solving approach focused on execution, user support, application reliability, and business continuity.

  • Fluent in English; additional languages are beneficial.

title: QA/QC Engineer
description:
Decima International is a professional services company, providing project management and controls services to clients in the United States and the Middle East. Our mission is to become the premier professional services provider across all industry sectors we are engaged in. To accomplish this, Decima International’s founders established a simple yet powerful formula:

Approach each client engagement as a partnership, create an environment that attracts the most talented professionals and allows them to flourish, and regulate growth to maintain excellence in our service standards.

Role Overview

We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented QA/QC Engineer to support quality assurance and quality control activities for major mission-critical and data center projects in KSA.

The role will be responsible for conducting site inspections, monitoring contractor compliance, reviewing Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), supporting NCR management, maintaining quality records, and ensuring construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, procedures, contractual requirements, and applicable quality standards.

The ideal candidate has hands-on QA/QC experience on large-scale construction, infrastructure, EPC, PMC, or mission-critical projects and a practical understanding of ISO 9001, inspection processes, NCRs, quality documentation, and construction quality requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct QA/QC inspections and surveillance activities across assigned construction works.

  • Verify that construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, contractual requirements, method statements, procedures, and applicable quality standards.

  • Perform FOK, installation, PUE, and other required project quality inspections.

  • Review and monitor contractor Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, inspection requests, and supporting quality records.

  • Witness inspections and testing activities in accordance with approved ITPs.

  • Identify non-conforming work and support the preparation and issuance of Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).

  • Monitor NCRs through corrective action and closure and escalate unresolved or recurring quality issues to the QA/QC Manager.

  • Support root cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

  • Monitor workmanship, materials, installations, and construction activities for compliance with project requirements.

  • Coordinate with contractors, consultants, vendors, discipline engineers, and project teams to resolve quality-related issues.

  • Review material inspection requests, work inspection requests, test records, certificates, and related quality documentation.

  • Maintain accurate inspection records, quality reports, NCR logs, punch lists, and supporting evidence.

  • Support internal and external quality audits and surveillance activities.

  • Identify recurring quality issues, trends, and areas of concern and report them to the QA/QC Manager.

  • Assist in preparing quality KPIs, reports, dashboards, and project quality statistics.

  • Support testing, commissioning, punch-list closeout, handover, and final quality documentation.

  • Verify completion and availability of quality records required for system and project handover.

  • Promote compliance with the Project Quality Management Plan and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Support implementation of the Project Quality Management System across assigned work packages.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

  • Relevant QA/QC engineering experience on construction, infrastructure, EPC, PMC, or major capital projects.

  • Hands-on experience with site inspections, ITPs, inspection requests, quality documentation, and NCR management.

  • Good understanding of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems.

  • Experience reviewing construction activities against approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and project quality requirements.

  • Experience identifying non-conformances and following corrective actions through closure.

  • Knowledge of root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action processes.

  • Strong documentation, reporting, and record-management skills.

  • Ability to coordinate effectively with contractors, consultants, vendors, and multidisciplinary project teams.

  • Strong communication, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience on hyperscale data center or mission-critical projects.

  • Previous experience within a PMC, consultant, EPC, or major contractor environment.

  • ISO 9001 Internal Auditor, Lead Auditor, Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or equivalent quality certification.

  • Familiarity with electronic Quality Management Systems and document control platforms.

  • Experience supporting commissioning quality activities and handover documentation.

  • Knowledge of international construction quality standards and best practices.

  • Familiarity with FIDIC contracts and associated QA/QC requirements.

  • Experience preparing quality reports, dashboards, NCR statistics, and quality performance metrics.

  • Department: Quality Assurance & Quality Control

title: Sr Agent Architect (Italy)
description:
About Parloa

Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience - one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role

As a Sr Agent Architect at Parloa, you will act as a solution architect for enterprise AI Agent deployments. You will design end-to-end system architectures that connect Parloa's platform to complex enterprise environments, solve multi-system integration challenges, and apply systems thinking to build reliable, scalable AI solutions for global enterprise clients.

You will also shape the conversational experience layer, using prompt engineering and your knowledge of LLMs to translate customer requirements into agent behavior. Architecture and integration depth are the core of this role. Conversational design skills are valued and can be developed on the job.

Areas of ownership

  • Design end-to-end solution architectures for AI Agent deployments, mapping how Parloa's platform integrates into customers' enterprise systems (CRMs, ERPs, ticketing systems, contact center platforms).
  • Build and configure integrations using integration platforms and APIs, applying systems thinking to solve complex, multi-system data flows.
  • Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineers on complex or custom integration scenarios that go beyond standard integration capabilities.
  • Apply structured testing approaches to validate architecture, integration reliability, and AI agent performance under real-world conditions.
  • Identify and resolve blockers together with other departments at Parloa (e.g., Product, Solution Engineering, Sales) and the customer.
  • Scope AI Agent deployments, providing strategic architecture advice and execution support to customers and partners.
  • Use your knowledge of LLM internals (e.g., embeddings) to analyze customer requirements and design prompts for reliable, user-aligned agent behavior.
  • Translate complex customer workflows into structured conversational components that LLMs can execute reliably.
  • Fine-tune conversational flows and voice output (e.g., SSML, Lexicons, Regex) to align with customer brand standards.
  • Document best practices, how-to guides, and product capabilities for internal and external audiences, representing the expertise of the Agent Architect team.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise customer-facing roles, with proven expertise in solution architecture, systems architecture, or enterprise integration.
  • Strong systems thinking, with a track record of solving complex technical problems across multiple systems and data sources.
  • Experience with complex SaaS implementations at scale (CRMs, ERPs, contact center platforms, ticketing systems).
  • Proficiency in REST API design, JSON/XML data structures, API testing tools (e.g., Postman), and API authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, JWT).
  • Experience reading and consuming API documentation across enterprise SaaS platforms, including data transformation and field mapping logic.
  • Analytical and critical thinker with expertise in risk assessment and problem-solving.
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with a passion for meeting milestones and effective communication.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with initiative, results orientation, and ability to identify opportunities for impact.
  • Ability to analyze customer requirements and translate them into LLM prompts and conversational flows, with attention to subtle conversational nuance and A/B testing to assess agent performance.
  • Prior conversation design, prompt engineering (e.g., chain-of-thought, few-shot learning), or A/B testing experience is a plus, not a requirement - we will train this.
  • Excellent written and spoken Italian and English skills are required.

Our Recruiting Process:

title: Lotus Clinical Research Project Manager
description:
Company: Lotus Clinical Research

Job Title: Clinical Research Project Manager

Location: Lotus Clinical Research100% Remote

Who we are:

PURPOSE

The Project Manager is a proven leader in clinical program management in the clinical research industry, and manages, executes and reports on clinical study operations. This position provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary project team, internally and externally. Under limited supervision, the Project Manager acts as the liaison between the sponsor, team members, and sites while managing projects to ensure quality service. Responsibilities encompass the overall management of a project including budgeting, timeline adherence, internal and external communications, and project deliverables.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIESinclude the following.

Other duties may be assigned. Employee performs all, part, and/or any combination of the duties listed below.

Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical research projects and ensures compliance with applicable regulations, guidelines, and corporate policies for study activities.

Manages and executes the overall project scope, budget, and timelines. Identifies project success factors for analysis, reporting, and tracking.

Manages resources and timelines associated with all study start-up and implementation activities.

Leads the development of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials as required.

Ensures the appropriate development of study documents including, but not limited to, study plans, case report form instructions, site selection materials, investigator updates, and other project-specific documents required for the conduct of assigned studies.

Participates in the review of clinical data for analysis.

Ensures that all project tasks meet client expectations and are completed in accordance with the contract, trial protocol, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Serves as a liaison between clients and internal team to ensure project specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated.

Plans for and manages all materials to support the appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational devices. Monitors adherence to project contract and budget.

Coordinates with clinical, business development, and operations management to identify goals and scope of clinical study projects. Ensures operational and regulatory integrity of assigned studies and participates in FDA or other regulatory authority inspections, as needed.

Supports the management and oversight of clinical study related vendors.

Reviews site monitoring reports ensuring finalization as required by SOP and/or client contractual requirements.

Enhances department and organization reputation by participating in departmental or corporate initiatives.

Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations.

Attends off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education/degree in life science/healthcare is required accompanied by 5 years of working within clinical research at a local medical organization, investigational site, pharmaceutical company, CRO, or clinical fellowship program.

CRO experience is highly desirable.

Experience managing external vendors preferred.

Experience leading project operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies preferred.

Experience writing, reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process preferred.

SKILLS and/or ABILITIES

Ability to facilitate a teamwork philosophy with a positive attitude.

Organizing and coordinating skills, teaching and facilitation skills, ability to assess training needs and objectives for the team.

Experience overseeing and coordinating the work of others.

Ability to work effectively and efficiently handling multiple tasks simultaneously.

Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.

Ability to manage multiple deadlines.

Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.

Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee regularly reaches with hands and arms. The employee periodically is required to lift and/or carry up to 10 pounds. Occasionally, employee stoops, bends, kneels, and crouches; and pushes/pulls filled wheeled carts. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

Work in a home environment where the noise level is usually largely controlled by the employee, and a travel environment where the noise level is usually moderate to high. Employee is subject to many interruptions; pressure due to deadline requirements; and handling multiple tasks simultaneously while performing assigned duties.

SAFETY REQUIREMENTS

Employee is required to pay particular attention to safety in their home and travel environment

title: Senior Legal Expert in Administrative Law (Roster)
description:
Organization Profile

Every year, millions of people around the world go missing as a result of conflict, human rights abuses, disasters, organized crime, irregular migration, and other causes. This is a complex global challenge that can be tackled effectively through cross-cutting programs that address a variety of difficult, interconnected issues.

The International Commission on Missing Persons (ICMP) is a treaty-based intergovernmental organization with Headquarters in The Hague, the Netherlands. Its mandate is to secure the cooperation of governments and others in locating missing persons from conflict, human rights abuses, disasters, organized crime, migration and other causes and to assist them in doing so. To learn more about ICMP click here.

Purpose of the role

ICMP is seeking to establish a roster of Senior Legal Experts in Administrative Law to provide, on a needs basis, strategic and high-level legal advice on matters relating to the administration and management of the organization. The consultancy will support the Head of the Legal Unit and Principal Legal Advisor in overseeing complex legal issues related to internal governance, personnel policies, institutional risk management, and staff grievances. The consultancy may also involve strengthening ICMP’s internal legal and policy framework in line with best practices in international administrative law.

Key Deliverables

In coordination with, and under the oversight of, the Head of Legal Unit and Principal Legal Advisor, the Legal Expert will, when required:

  • Provide legal advice and analysis on complex matters relating to internal governance, institutional policies, and organizational compliance.
  • Support the review, interpretation, and development of personnel policies, procedures, and administrative frameworks to ensure alignment with applicable laws, regulations, and organizational standards.
  • Assist in identifying, assessing, and managing legal risks associated with institutional operations, governance, and human resources matters.
  • Conduct legal research and prepare opinions, memoranda, briefing notes, and other legal documents on issues related to governance, employment, and institutional risk.
  • Advise on staff appeals of administrative decisions, disciplinary matters, workplace disputes, and other employment-related issues, ensuring adherence to due process and organizational policies.
  • Review and draft legal documents, policies, guidelines, and internal governance instruments as required.
  • Support the handling of sensitive and complex legal matters, including investigations, dispute resolution, and conflict management, where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure legal considerations are integrated into organizational decision-making and policy implementation.
  • Monitor developments in relevant legal and regulatory frameworks and provide recommendations on their implications for the organization.
  • Prepare legal reports, presentations, and briefing materials for senior management and governance bodies, as required.
  • Contribute to strengthening institutional governance and legal compliance by identifying opportunities for policy and process improvements.
  • Perform any other legal advisory and support functions assigned by the Head of Legal and Principal Legal Advisor that are consistent with the scope of the consultancy.

Qualifications

  • Advanced university degree (Masters or equivalent) in Law.
  • Admission to practice law in a national jurisdiction.
  • Minimum of 7 years of progressively responsible legal experience, with significant practical and advisory experience in the international administrative and employment law.
  • Previous experience working in or advising an international or intergovernmental organization.
  • Expert knowledge of international administrative jurisprudence and practice experience with legal proceedings before international administrative tribunals or dispute resolution bodies.
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English; additional language skills (e.g., Arabic, French) are an asset.
  • Exceptional analytical, drafting, and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to advise senior leadership and manage sensitive legal matters with discretion and sound judgment.

Duration

Subject to the timing of the recruitment process, the duration of the consultancy roster is envisaged to be for a two-year period, from 1 September 2026 to 1 September 2028.

Other conditions

The consultant must:

  • Be available to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, when required to respond to urgent or time-sensitive legal matters, investigations, or organizational priorities.
  • Be able to undertake duty travel to The Hague and other locations, as required, to provide in-person legal support, attend meetings, participate in hearings or consultations, and engage with key stakeholders
  • While this is a remote position, the consultant must be eligible to travel to and enter the Netherlands without requiring sponsorship or other immigration support from ICMP. The consultant will be responsible for obtaining and maintaining any required visas, permits, or travel authorizations.

Compensation

This is a fixed-term, part-time consultancy. The consultancy duration and working schedule will be discussed and agreed upon with the relevant consultant. Remuneration will be commensurate with experience and qualifications.

PLEASE NOTE: All applications must be submitted in English. ICMP does not accept applications in any other language.

Deadline for Applications: Ongoing.

ICMP is committed to maintaining an environment of mutual respect, where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants. ICMP believes that diversity and inclusion among our staff are critical to our success as a global organization, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented individuals from a thoroughly diverse range of candidates. ICMP is proud to be part of the International Gender Champions network.

ICMP may cancel this recruitment without notice or may decide to offer a position with different duties and/or contract length.

ICMP does not request payment during any stage of the selection process.
