title: Associate Director - Implementation
description:
About Intugine

Ever wondered how the physical goods we consume every day (think dairy, snacks, or your favourite choco chip ice cream) reach you in time? Or how beautiful furniture or sophisticated electronic equipment and gadgets you use are delivered in the best possible condition at your doorstep.

Their journey spans from getting sourced, manufactured, and stored, to getting moved across a highly intricate supply chain network across the globe before it gets delivered. Global brands constantly face challenges like not having visibility of their raw materials, which delays production and in turn, delays customer shipments, or tracking shipments across various modalities and multiple geographies.

Intugine Technologies is one of the most trusted solution partners catering to these brands with its best-in-class visibility platform helping brands gain comprehensive visibility over their supply chain across modalities(air/land/sea/rail). Their solutions have helped eliminate operational inefficiencies, reduce logistics costs and improve OTIF, order to delivery TAT, and minimise dwell time and detention costs.


Intugine is a proud partner of the National Logistics Policy, an initiative by the Government of India. With this, it provides these brands with additional information via their integrations with FASTag, Port Community System, and Freight Operations Information System to name a few.





Today Intugine works with 75+ global enterprise names like GE Healthcare, Signify, Flipkart, Mahindra Logistics, Titan, Diageo, Ultratech Cement, Bridgestone, and GMMCO.


To know more, visit the website: https://www.intugine.com


Role Summary

The Implementation Head will play a key leadership role in driving Intugine’s end-to-end implementation function and will work closely with the leadership team on implementation strategy, business priorities, and operational excellence. The role will own large and complex enterprise implementations, Lead and manage 30–50 professionals through direct and indirect reporting structures across program management, field implementation, and on-ground operations, driving scalable processes across customers and geographies.


This role requires someone who can operate at both strategic and operational levels — from shaping implementation strategy and improving revenue realisation timelines to stepping in and solving critical on-ground challenges when required.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in operations-heavy, hardware/IoT-enabled SaaS environments, with a proven ability to lead large teams, manage enterprise customers and build scalable implementation systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with the leadership to define implementation priorities, operating plans and strategic initiatives.

  • Own end-to-end implementation for Intugine's key enterprise customers, ensuring timely go-live and successful adoption.

  • Own the implementation strategy and solution design for new and existing enterprise accounts.

  • Lead and mentor a 30–50 member implementation organisation across program management, field implementation and on-ground support.

  • Drive implementation KPIs, revenue realisation, utilisation and operational efficiency, providing regular visibility to leadership.

  • Build scalable implementation processes and a repeatable implementation playbook across customers and geographies.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering and Customer Success to solve complex customer and implementation challenges.

  • Take ownership of critical escalations and work directly with customers and internal teams to unblock implementation.

  • Build and develop a strong second line of leadership within the implementation function.

  • Identify opportunities to improve implementation margins, timelines, quality and overall customer experience.

Requirements

  • 8–12 years of experience in implementation, logistics technology, supply chain, IoT, hardware, or related domains.

  • B.Tech / B.E. from a Tier-1 or Tier-2 engineering institute is mandatory.

  • Exposure to IoT/hardware implementation, particularly within logistics technology or SaaS environments, is a plus.

  • Proven experience in Logistics Tech / Supply Chain Technology with hands-on implementation ownership.

  • Proven track record of leading large implementation teams across multiple projects, customers, and geographies.



  • Strong implementation architecture and solution-thinking capabilities, with the ability to translate complex customer requirements into scalable implementation frameworks.

  • Strong client-facing experience with end-to-end delivery ownership and the ability to manage senior customer stakeholders.

  • Strong technical literacy, particularly around APIs, system integrations, data flows, and troubleshooting integration-related challenges.

  • Strong problem-solving, stakeholder management, communication, and execution skills.

  • Ability to work closely with senior leadership and independently drive strategic and operational initiatives.

Good to Have

  • Experience in Mid-Mile or Last-Mile Logistics.

  • Experience working with Supply Chain Control Towers / Visibility Platforms.

  • Familiarity with integration platforms and middleware.

  • Experience managing large-scale, multi-location implementation programs.

title: Redaksjonsutvikler i Aftenposten
description:
Om stillingen
Brenner du for kvalitetsjournalistikk og har lyst til å utvikle den videre? Er du analytisk sterk og vil bidra til å gjøre en av Norges viktigste redaksjoner enda bedre ved hjelp av innsikt og analyse?

Da kan du være den vi ser etter til vårt utviklingsteam.

De siste årene har Aftenposten opplevd vekst i abonnenter, lesere og lyttere, og ambisjonen er å nå ut til enda flere med vår kvalitetsjournalistikk. Vi har også et klart mål om at våre eksisterende abonnenter skal bruke oss enda oftere enn i dag.

Som redaksjonsutvikler får du en nøkkelrolle i utviklingen av vår journalistikk i både tekst og lyd. Du vil jobbe tett med våre redaktører, ledere, journalister, resten av strategi- og analysemiljøet i Aftenposten og i Schibsted.

Vi er på jakt etter en engasjert person som vil dykke ned i hvordan Aftenpostens innhold og produkter brukes, identifisere hva som kan gjøre oss enda mer relevante for nye og eksisterende abonnenter og presentere denne innsikten for redaksjonen på en forståelig og pedagogisk måte.

Arbeidsoppgaver
Du vil blant annet:

  • Fremskaffe og analysere relevant data og innsikt som skal være grunnlag for redaksjonelle. prioriteringer, utvikling, målarbeid og nye strategier.

  • Formidle analyser og innsikt på en pedagogisk måte til folk i redaksjonen.

  • Støtte ledere og være en pådriver i arbeidet med utvikling og ulike prosjekter.

  • Være sentral i langsiktige utviklingsprosjekter og samtidig dekke løpende analysebehov i redaksjonen.

Hvem ser vi etter?
For å lykkes i rollen må du ha:

  • Solid erfaring fra en redaksjon og arbeid med journalistikk.

  • Erfaring med analyse og databehandling.

  • Sterke analytiske ferdigheter og kommunisere vanskelige problemstillinger tydelig og pedagogisk.

  • Evne til å bygge gode relasjoner og samarbeide godt med mennesker med ulik fagbakgrunn.

  • Nysgjerrighet på teknologi og nye arbeidsmetoder.

  • Lyst til å få ting til å skje og ta ansvar for gjennomføring.


Vi ser for oss at du har minst noen års relevant arbeidserfaring, men det er ikke et krav til relevant utdanning. Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med grunnleggende statistisk metode og strategiarbeid, men ikke et krav. Det er viktigere for oss at du er nysgjerrig og setter deg raskt inn i nye ting.

Hva kan vi tilby?

  • En helt sentral rolle og stort ansvar i et av landets mest fremoverlente og ambisiøse mediehus.

  • Store utviklingsmuligheter, tett oppfølging og samarbeid med mange deler av Aftenposten.

  • Meget godt arbeidsmiljø og hyggelige kolleger. I tillegg vil du være en del av et sterkt fagmiljø i Schibsted.

  • Konkurransedyktige vilkår og en rekke ansattgoder.


Praktisk informasjon
Dette er en fast stilling med oppstart snarest. Vi vurderer kandidater fortløpende, men søknadsfrist er 16. september.

Spørsmål om stillingen?

Ta kontakt med:

Kristin Kornberg, leder for innsikt og innholdsutvikling, tlf 98 24 98 07 / kristin.kornberg@aftenposten.no eller

Kristjan Molstad, klubbleder, tlf. 415 67 357 / kristjan.molstad@aftenposten.no.

Om oss

Hundretusener av nordmenn stoler hver dag på at Aftenposten gir dem troverdig, engasjerende og innsiktsfull dekning av det viktigste som skjer i Norge og verden. Vi har som ambisjon å være den foretrukne kvalitetsavisen for samfunnsengasjerte mennesker i hele landet – og et ledende digitalt mediehus.

Aftenposten har utviklet seg fra å være Norges største papiravis til å bli en av landets fremste digitale medieaktører, med sterk vekst i digitale abonnementer og en stadig voksende portefølje av podkaster og nye produkter. For å lykkes må vi være best på journalistikk, teknologiutvikling og kommersialisering – og vi jobber på tvers av fagmiljøer for å skape morgendagens mediehus.

Journalistikken, produktutviklingen og det kommersielle arbeidet vårt er prisbelønt – både nasjonalt og internasjonalt. Ambisjonene for fremtiden er store.

Aftenposten er en del av Schibsted, et ledende nordisk mediekonsern med andre sterke merkevarer som VG, Bergens Tidende, Aftonbladet, Svenska Dagbladet og TV4. Det gir oss kraft, kompetanse og muligheter til å tenke større.

title: AI Deployment Strategist (EMEA)
description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role:


As an AI Deployment Strategist, you are the long-term owner of our most important customer accounts. You pair with Account Executives to close: scoping pilots, setting success criteria, and running the technical side of the commercial conversation. At signature, you take the account and stay on it, driving adoption and expansion over years rather than quarters, so AEs can move to the next deal. This role suits entrepreneurial, technically credible operators; founder and founder CEO backgrounds are a strong fit.

What we value most is first principles thinking: reasoning about unfamiliar problems from the ground up rather than from playbooks. You will be evaluated on this directly in the interview process, and strength here can outweigh gaps elsewhere in your background.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Account Ownership: Own the customer relationship and commercial outcome from signature onward, including adoption, expansion, and renewals.

  • Deal Support: Partner with AEs pre-signature on pilot scoping, success criteria, and technical-commercial framing.

  • Delivery Cadence: Run the operating rhythm of the account across the customer's and Fireworks' teams (FDEs, AMLEs, product, support).

  • Value Realization: Translate customer goals into concrete deployment milestones and make sure they land.

  • Expansion Strategy: Identify and drive new workloads, teams, and use cases within existing accounts.

  • Voice of Customer: Represent account needs internally with enough technical precision to be actionable.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • First principles and critical thinking: the ability to break down novel problems and reason to a solution without a reference implementation. This is the primary interview signal and can outweigh other qualifications.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent technical depth.

  • 3+ years in roles combining technical substance with commercial ownership (deployment strategy, technical consulting, founder, forward deployed, or similar).

  • Strong technical credibility: able to hold your own with customer engineering leadership and our field engineers, and to reason about AI infrastructure tradeoffs.

  • Track record of owning outcomes over long horizons, not handing off after the sale.

  • Excellent judgment, communication, and stakeholder management with senior audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Founder or founding team experience, especially as CEO or commercial lead of a technical product.

  • Experience deploying or operating AI/ML products in production with enterprise customers.

  • Experience navigating enterprise constraints in EMEA (procurement, data residency, GDPR, EU AI Act).

  • Experience in a startup or fast-paced environment.

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer: Cloud Infra & CI/CD
description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

(What you will be working on)

As a Software Engineer, you will take on meaningful ownership of features and technical work that spans multiple components of our products. You will work with a degree of independence while continuing to grow through mentorship, and you will play an active role in shaping the quality, reliability, and culture of the team you work in.

Craft & Execution

You will deliver features and proofs of concept that span multiple components or modules, typically working across two to three areas within your team. While you will receive mentorship on architectural decisions and cross-component integration, you are expected to make thoughtful trade-offs between performance, security, and maintainability based on your understanding of the context. You will write and review code with clarity and long-term maintainability in mind, applying good engineering practices consistently, and you will expand test coverage — including unit and integration tests — to support key workflows and reduce flakiness.

Beyond feature delivery, you are responsible for the team's CI/CD processes and deployment pipelines; and will address pockets of technical debt within your domain, suggest improvements that enhance product performance or team velocity. You will also take a deliberate approach to balancing short-term delivery speed with long-term code health, flagging when quick fixes introduce future risk, and applying organisational platform and compliance standards effectively.

After your work ships, you are expected to follow through on its impact — checking metrics, reviewing error rates, and addressing post-deployment issues proactively. You will actively participate in incident triage and resolution with team support, and escalate complex issues when needed.

You will also bring rigour to the use of AI-generated code, reviewing it for correctness, edge cases, security issues, and maintainability to the same standard as any human-authored contribution. Writing clear task descriptions and specifications to get higher-quality AI assistance and reduce rework is part of how you work.

Ownership

You will independently own your assigned tasks and projects, identifying and addressing issues proactively with minimal guidance. You will know when to seek help and from whom, and you will look for opportunities to recommend improvements to processes or outcomes within your own work.

Strategic Alignment

You will align your work with your team's goals and priorities, focusing on tasks that deliver the most expected business value. You will adapt to changing priorities independently, without needing to be redirected.

Culture and Organisational Influence

You will collaborate with peers and stakeholders to ensure work is executed effectively, address minor conflicts constructively and respectfully, and suggest improvements that enhance team effectiveness. You will share knowledge, resources, successes, and failures openly — because you understand that team success depends on everyone having the information they need.

(What we are looking for)

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in Software Engineering and DevOps/cloud infrastructure roles.
  • Proven track record building scalable cloud platforms or shared infrastructure.
  • Experience driving cross-team engineering standards or platform adoption.

title: Director, Data Engineering & Platform
description:
Job Description Summary

‎

The Director, Data Engineering & Platform provides M4-level organizational leadership for the execution of the enterprise data engineering and platform vision and strategy established by the VP, Enterprise Data Platforms. The Director contributes to the evolution of the platform strategy in partnership with the VP, Director of Data Architecture, and peer leaders, but is primarily accountable for translating that strategy into an executable operating model, multi-year modernization roadmap, engineering governance, delivery priorities, and measurable enterprise outcomes.
This role owns the way enterprise data engineering and platform work is executed across the organization. The Director leads multiple engineering managers and cross-functional engineering organizations responsible for enterprise data engineering, platform engineering, data integration, data operations, and platform services. The role ensures that enterprise data capabilities are secure, scalable, resilient, cost-effective, and aligned to strategic growth initiatives, digital transformation, AI enablement, interoperability, enterprise reporting, and data-driven decision-making.
The Director balances organizational leadership, technology execution, financial stewardship, vendor strategy, operating discipline, and business partnership while developing a high-performing engineering organization capable of delivering enterprise-scale data products and platform services.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

Enterprise Strategy Execution & Platform Capability Leadership

  • Own execution of the enterprise data engineering and platform strategy established by the VP, Enterprise Data Platforms, translating strategic direction into an operating model, multi-year execution roadmap, delivery priorities, and measurable outcomes.
  • Contribute to enterprise platform vision, strategy, and technology direction in partnership with the VP, Director of Data Architecture, and peer technology leaders.
  • Establish the enterprise data engineering operating model, engineering governance, standards, and operating principles adopted across the organization.
  • Establish and maintain the platform evolution roadmap aligned with enterprise data strategy, modernization priorities, architectural direction, security requirements, and business objectives.
  • Accountable for implementing enterprise data platform capabilities that support strategic growth initiatives, digital transformation, AI enablement, interoperability, enterprise reporting, and data product delivery.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, platform capabilities, and engineering practices to recommend pragmatic adoption approaches that improve enterprise outcomes.

Enterprise Platform Ownership & Modernization Execution

  • Own enterprise data engineering operations and the way work is executed across platform engineering, data engineering, data integration, and data operations.
  • Own execution of the enterprise platform strategy, including platform modernization, cloud transformation, lifecycle management, automation, and operational maturity.
  • Own the modernization roadmap for enterprise data engineering and platform capabilities, ensuring roadmap execution remains aligned with VP strategy, enterprise architecture, and business priorities.
  • Accountable for enterprise engineering service performance, technology resilience, organizational capability, and strategic platform evolution.
  • Ensure enterprise platforms meet organizational expectations for availability, scalability, security, resiliency, regulatory compliance, observability, cost effectiveness, and operational supportability.
  • Establish enterprise service-level objectives, operational performance standards, recovery expectations, and continuous improvement practices across platform and engineering services.

Engineering Organization Leadership & Span of Control

  • Direct multiple engineering managers and cross-functional engineering teams responsible for enterprise data engineering, platform engineering, data integration, and platform operations.
  • Direct Engineering Managers responsible for Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Operations, and Data Integration.
  • Develop workforce strategies including workforce planning, organizational design, staffing plans, succession planning, leadership development, recruiting strategy, and vendor strategy.
  • Establish organizational goals, performance expectations, accountability measures, and execution disciplines aligned with enterprise priorities.
  • Develop engineering and platform organizational leadership capability through succession planning, leadership coaching, management development, and clear accountability for delivery outcomes.
  • Build an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, operational excellence, customer service, and reliable enterprise delivery.

Enterprise Architecture Partnership & Engineering Governance

  • Define enterprise data engineering strategy in partnership with the Director of Data Architecture and the VP, Enterprise Data Platforms.
  • Establish enterprise engineering standards, the platform evolution roadmap aligned with strategy, and operating principles governing data engineering across the organization.
  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Compliance, Infrastructure, Data Governance, Analytics, and Product leaders to maintain enterprise technology standards and practical delivery guardrails.
  • Ensure engineering practices comply with organizational policies, regulatory requirements, cybersecurity standards, privacy expectations, audit requirements, and healthcare data protection obligations.
  • Govern data engineering patterns, automation practices, reliability standards, deployment approaches, observability expectations, and operational controls across platform and engineering services.

Portfolio, Investment & Decision Influence

  • Govern investment priorities across multiple portfolios and engineering organizations based on business value, operational risk, strategic alignment, cost profile, and organizational capacity.
  • Contribute a strong Director-level voice with peers and the VP in portfolio prioritization, organization structure, capital investment, vendor selection, strategic technology direction, operating model design, and sourcing decisions.
  • Develop business cases supporting modernization initiatives, enterprise data platform capabilities, automation investments, and emerging technology adoption.
  • Partner with the VP and peer leaders to translate technology investment decisions into execution roadmaps, resource plans, delivery commitments, and outcome measures.
  • Monitor portfolio performance using executive dashboards, key performance indicators, delivery health metrics, cost trends, and organizational outcome measures.

Financial & Vendor Management

  • Own annual operating and capital budget planning and management for enterprise data engineering and platform services in partnership with the VP, Enterprise Data Platforms.
  • Actively engage with the VP in annual planning, operating budget development, capital planning, technology investment portfolio management, ROI analysis, vendor management, and contract negotiations.
  • Govern cloud spend, software licensing strategy, technology procurement, vendor contracts, managed service relationships, and vendor performance for enterprise data engineering and platform services.
  • Lead investment prioritization, vendor negotiations, software licensing analysis, cloud spend governance, and business case development for platform and engineering capabilities.
  • Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value while maintaining financial stewardship, cost transparency, and accountability for platform economics.
  • Present budget performance, investment recommendations, vendor considerations, and financial tradeoffs to the VP and executive stakeholders as appropriate.

Business Accountability & Executive Partnership

  • Accountable for implementing enterprise data platform capabilities supporting strategic growth initiatives, digital transformation, AI enablement, interoperability, enterprise reporting, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Translate business priorities into enterprise data engineering capabilities that improve operational performance, customer outcomes, clinical and business insight, and trusted data product delivery.
  • Represent Data Engineering & Platform in executive planning, governance, prioritization, and strategic investment forums as delegated by or in partnership with the VP.
  • Serve as a trusted technology execution partner to business leaders, analytics leaders, product leaders, clinical operations, finance, governance committees, and technology peers.
  • Ensure enterprise data engineering capabilities support organizational growth, platform adoption, enterprise reporting, interoperability, AI enablement, and long-term technology modernization.

Operational Excellence

  • Establish organizational metrics measuring platform adoption, engineering productivity, reliability, service quality, operational maturity, customer satisfaction, financial performance, and business value realization.
  • Drive continuous improvement across engineering delivery, operational processes, automation, release management, platform performance, incident management, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Ensure platform and engineering services are observable, supportable, cost transparent, well governed, and resilient enough to support enterprise-scale data products.
  • Create durable management routines that improve delivery predictability, production reliability, engineering quality, and cross-functional alignment.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Direct multiple engineering managers and technical leaders across Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Operations, and Data Integration.
  • Establish execution roadmaps, organizational priorities, operating cadences, and accountability measures aligned with VP strategy and enterprise priorities.
  • Build leadership capability through coaching, management development, succession planning, and talent development.
  • Lead workforce planning, organizational design, recruiting strategy, vendor strategy, and capacity planning for the enterprise data engineering and platform organization.
  • Foster collaboration across technology, business, clinical, analytics, governance, security, infrastructure, and operational organizations.
  • Drive organizational accountability for delivery, quality, operational resilience, innovation, financial stewardship, and customer outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
  • 9–12 years of progressive experience in technology leadership, data engineering, platform engineering, enterprise data platforms, cloud data platforms, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years leading managers and highly technical resources in enterprise engineering, platform engineering, data engineering, integration, or data operations environments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise transformation, platform modernization, cloud transformation, or large-scale data engineering initiatives.
  • Experience directing multiple engineering teams and leading through managers, technical leaders, delivery partners, and vendors.
  • Experience managing or materially influencing multi-million-dollar operating and capital budgets, technology investment portfolios, ROI analysis, vendor management, and contract negotiations.
  • Executive communication experience, including the ability to present technology strategy, investment tradeoffs, delivery risks, and business outcomes to senior leadership.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with enterprise architecture, information security, compliance, analytics, product, finance, clinical, and business leadership stakeholders.
  • Strong working knowledge of modern cloud data platforms, data engineering practices, platform operations, automation, reliability engineering, data governance, cybersecurity, and operational excellence frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within healthcare or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience supporting enterprise AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, interoperability, enterprise reporting, and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Experience governing enterprise cloud platforms, modern data architectures, data engineering operating models, and large-scale engineering organizations.
  • Experience leading enterprise modernization and organizational transformation initiatives while balancing strategy, execution, cost, risk, and delivery capacity.
  • Experience with Databricks or comparable enterprise lakehouse, cloud data platform, data engineering, or analytics platform capabilities.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native engineering, enterprise data governance, cybersecurity, data protection, observability, automation, and operational excellence frameworks.

‎

title: Remote Role: Automation Program Manager/ QA Consultant- Automation | Warehouse A
description:
Role: Automation Program Manager/ QA Consultant- Automation

Duration: Long Term

Location: Remote

About the Role

Facility is integrating a Warehouse Control System with ERP for inventory management. We are seeking an experienced Automation Test Program Manager / QA Consultant to own end-to-end test strategy and execution across this automation initiative, driving the program toward a full go-live by end of December.

This is a hands-on leadership role — not a pure documentation function. The consultant will need to build the test plan, actively run the test cycle day-to-day, coordinate across engineering, operations, and IT teams, and translate testing status into clear, executive-ready reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test Strategy & Planning: Develop a high-level, end-to-end test plan covering the full device flow — from automation hardware/conveyance triggers, through (WCS layer) logic, to ERP (receiving, put-away etc.).
  • Test Cycle Management: Own and manage the test cycle schedule, including test case development, environment/data readiness, defect triage, regression cycles, and UAT sign-off criteria.
  • Cross-Team Coordination: Work directly with automation/hardware teams, WCS product/engineering teams, ERP IT teams, and warehouse operations to align on test scope, dependencies, and readiness gates.
  • Integration & Interface Testing: Ensure test coverage of system integration points — automation-to-WCS signals/events and WCS-to-ERP transactional integration (e.g., inventory updates,serial number tracking).
  • Defect & Risk Management: Establish a defect tracking and triage process; identify, escalate, and drive resolution of blocking issues; maintain a go-live risk register.
  • Executive Reporting: Produce regular, concise status reporting for executive leadership — test progress, defect burn-down, go-live readiness, and risk callouts — suitable for steering committee/leadership review.
  • Go-Live Readiness: Define and track exit criteria/entrance criteria for go-live; support cutover planning and hypercare test validation post-launch.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in test program management, QA leadership, or systems integration testing, ideally within supply chain, warehouse automation, or logistics environments.
  • Demonstrated experience testing systems that span WCS/WMS layers and ERP inventory systems
  • Experience with warehouse automation go-lives — conveyance systems, sortation, robotics, or similar physical automation integrated with software control layers.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end test methodology: test strategy, test case design, UAT, regression, defect management, and readiness/exit criteria.
  • Proven ability to manage cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, operations, vendors, IT) without direct authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to executive/leadership audiences.
  • Comfortable working on-site in a warehouse/DCC operational environment in Nashville.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with sortation/guidance systems (e.g., put-to-light/sort-to-light) or automated transport (e.g., AMRs/robotics).

Deliverables

  • High-level end-to-end test plan and test strategy document
  • Test cycle schedule and tracking dashboard
  • Defect/risk log with escalation cadence
  • Go-live readiness assessment and exit-criteria checklist
  • Weekly/bi-weekly executive status reporting through go-live

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Meille Dressmannilla on tärkeää, että töissä on hauskaa!

Meidän suurin vahvuutemme on ihmiset – ja se, mitä saamme yhdessä aikaan tiiminä. Olet luonteeltasi sosiaalinen ja iloinen, ja nautit myyntityöstä sekä siitä, kun saat palvella asiakkaita. Työskentelet mielelläsi yhdessä osana tiimiä ja viihdyt vaihtelevissa tehtävissä. Päivän aikana tapahtuu paljon, mutta tärkeintä on, että asiakkaat saavat positiivisen asiakaskokemuksen, myymälä näyttää houkuttelevalta ja työilmapiiri on hyvä sekä kannustava.

Odotamme, että olet:

- ulospäinsuuntautunut ja nautit asiakaskohtaamisista ja myyntityöstä
- energinen ja saat asioita tapahtumaan
- positiivinen tiimipelaaja, joka kannustaa ympärillään olevia
- luotettava, joustava ja vastuullinen
- valmis työskentelemään iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin

title: Software Engineer, Data Programme
description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

What you will be working on

The mission of GovTech's Data Program is to deliver fit-for-purpose data assets and services for policy making, service delivery and operations across Whole-of-Government (WOG). Our programme creates value through enablement - reducing friction for agencies so they can move faster and make better decisions in their work with existing government datasets.

Key Technical Responsibilities

You will contribute to the development of one or more of our four strategic technical initiatives:

  • Standardised Data Platform
    • Build and maintain unified data platform infrastructure for government agencies
    • Develop APIs and services that standardise data ingestion, processing, and storage
    • Create reusable components and templates for agency data platform implementation
    • Implement data connectors and integration tools for legacy systems
  • Unified Frontend / DataHive
    • Develop the central data discovery and access request platform
    • Build intuitive user interfaces for data catalogue browsing and metadata search
    • Implement request management workflows and approval systems
    • Create responsive web applications that serve both data consumers and providers
  • Unified Serving Backbone
    • Design and implement standardised data delivery APIs and microservices
    • Build robust data serving infrastructure that can handle high-volume requests
    • Develop authentication and authorisation systems for secure data access
    • Create monitoring and alerting systems for data delivery pipelines
  • Observability & Governance Infrastructure
    • Build central observability systems for data quality monitoring and lineage tracking
    • Develop dashboards and analytics tools for data usage patterns
    • Implement automated data quality checks and validation frameworks
    • Create audit trails and compliance reporting systems

As a Software Engineer, You Will

  • Build end-to-end data analytics products/platforms with your team
  • Design system architectures
  • Write production quality code
  • Manage deployments to cloud and (occasionally) on-premise infrastructure
  • Build prototypes to demonstrate technology opportunities
  • Learn and share knowledge in a multi-disciplinary team
  • Establish best practices
  • Share your expertise and mentor other engineers
  • Help with recruiting.

You are not just here to write code, but also to figure out what we should be building and how we should build it. Your job will be to bring expertise and capability to the public sector. Sometimes this means coding new systems from scratch. Other times this means using the best solutions the community has to offer. We use cloud services, open source software, and commodity hardware as far as possible. Knowing what to build and what to reuse lets us avoid wasting time on solved problems and focus on delivering actual value.

What It Is Like Working Here

We build products that serve a variety of agency users, who use them to solve highly meaningful problems pertinent to our society, from transportation, to education, to healthcare. The public sector is full of opportunities where even the simplest software can have a big impact on people’s lives. We are here to improve how we live as a society through what we can offer as a government.

  • Rapid Prototyping - Instead of spending too much time debating ideas we prefer testing them. This identifies potential problems quickly, and more importantly, conveys what is possible to others easily.
  • Reliable Productization - To scale an idea, a prototype or a Minimum Viable Product to a software product, we scrutinize and commit to its usability, reliability, scalability and maintainability.
  • Ownership - In addition to technical responsibilities, this means having ideas on how things should be done and taking responsibility for seeing them through. Building something that you believe in is the best way to build something good.
  • Continuous Learning - Working on new ideas often means not fully understanding what you are working on. Taking time to learn new architectures, frameworks, technologies, and even languages is not just encouraged but essential.

What we are looking for

The Customers For Our Products Are Normally Agency Users, Which Means That Breadth Of Knowledge In Government IT Infrastructure And Experience In Government Networks Will Help. Since Our Direction Is Cloud-first, You Will Likely Have Some Experience In Patch/update Scheduling, And Knowledge Of Security Incident Response Procedures. A Disciplined Approach And Strong Problem-solving Instincts Are Fundamental To Succeed. Your Aptitude For Completing The Tasks And Attitude To Continuous Learning Are More Valued Than Any Formal Certification. To Succeed, You Will Need To Possess Some Of The Following

  • Excellent problem solving and methodical troubleshooting skills
  • Strong knowledge and experience in DevOps automation, containerization and orchestration using tools eg. Ansible, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Artifactory/Nexus Sonatype
  • Cloud computing deployment and management experience in AWS, GCP
  • Strong scripting skills e.g. Python, Bash, JavaScript, Scala, Rust, Go
  • Strong understanding of Apache Spark/Flink, Hadoop, distributed file systems and resource scaling/scheduling, streaming message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka)
  • Strong understanding of virtualization and networking concepts
  • Experience with patch maintenance, regression testing and security incident response
  • Experience with interactive workloads, machine learning toolkits and how they integrate with cloud computing e.g. Databricks, KX
  • Experience with highly scalable distributed systems
  • Experience with on-premise deployments, government application and networking infrastructure/routing
  • Breadth of knowledge - OS, networking, distributed computing, cloud computing

What we offer you

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you.

Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers.

Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

title: Senior Director, Interoperability
description:
Job Description

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Set the multi-year vision for our interoperability. Own where interoperability is headed at Devoted, and turn that vision into measurable gains in clinical quality, operational efficiency, and the reliability of the data we depend on.

  • Deliver Devoted's interoperability compliance. Define what strong compliance looks like across a complex, shifting regulatory landscape and make sure Devoted stays ahead of it. Today that headlines with the CMS Interoperability and Prior Authorization Final Rule (CMS-0057-F) but the mandate is the broader picture and whatever comes next, not any single rule.

  • Build the organization behind data exchange. Lead and grow the data exchange operational teams within our tech org that make interoperability real — clinical data acquisition, integration operations, and telephony — into an organization that executes at scale.

  • Get a sprawling landscape moving in one direction. Interoperability touches Clinical, Operations, Engineering, Data, Legal, and Compliance; you'll create alignment across all of them and clear the systemic blockers that slow data exchange.

  • Shape a deliberate vendor strategy. Build and steward our most important vendor partnerships — a multi-million-dollar portfolio — into a coherent strategy that strengthens capabilities, reduces integration risk, and serves Devoted's long-term interests.

  • Advance Devoted's interests in the outside world. Shape the relationships — and, where possible, the policy — with provider and regulatory partners that determine what data we're able to exchange and on what terms.

  • Be the authority leadership relies on. Translate a fast-moving, complex interoperability landscape into clear decisions for senior leadership.

Required skills and experience:

  • You've led at scale: 10+ years of relevant experience, including a track record of leading other leaders. You've built and scaled multi-function organizations and have recruited, coached, and mentored talent while setting a positive, high-accountability culture.

  • You know interoperability cold: A genuine command of the healthcare data exchange landscape — standards (e.g., FHIR, HL7, C-CDA), the regulatory environment (e.g., CMS Interoperability rules, ASTP/ONC, TEFCA, information blocking), health information exchange, and EHR and clinical/claims/pharmacy data integration.

  • You know how to deliver on regulation and compliance: You've hit major milestones that satisfy both regulatory requirements and business outcomes — ideally on FHIR/API-based initiatives such as the CMS interoperability rules — and you understand what it takes to succeed, coordinating technical and operational work across many teams to get there.

  • You've aligned the room: You've repeatedly brought many stakeholder groups to agreement on a single plan — listening, synthesizing competing input, and communicating a decision back to teams, leadership, and eventually an entire company.

  • You've been at the negotiating table: You've owned and negotiated multi-million-dollar vendor relationships, and you can read a vendor landscape and form a defensible point of view.

  • You've represented the org externally: You've been the credible voice for an organization's position with external partners — providers, regulators, industry forums.

  • You've owned the roadmap and the details: You've built multi-year strategic roadmaps and driven them to measurable business and operational outcomes without losing the thread on execution.

  • You bringa data-driven mindset, a super proactive "get it done" attitude with the skills to back it up, and the mental agility to stay sharp, re-prioritize quickly, and thrive amid the uncertainty, fast pace, and flexibility inherent in a startup.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Provider, Payor or EHR experience: Working experience in a care delivery or health insurance environment, partnering across clinical, operational, and administrative leaders to drive patient outcomes and member experience.

  • Data exchange from the inside: Experience at an EHR, health information network, or clinical data intermediary/platform — a background that brings source-level fluency in how clinical data actually moves and a connectivity-first, build-fast mindset to the problem.

  • Value-based care: Understanding of payment incentives and frameworks for delivering value from a risk-bearing provider perspective.

  • Regulatory engagement: Direct experience engaging with regulatory partners and shaping or responding to interoperability policy.

  • Financial acumen: Strong financial modeling and budgeting skills, and experience owning a domain budget.

Desired Qualities:

  • You genuinely nerd out on interoperability. You understand the problems deeply, you have a real perspective on where the industry is heading, and you enjoy keeping up with the regulations and the standards.

  • You want to make healthcare better through better data exchange. You see interoperability not as plumbing, but as one of the highest-leverage ways to improve care for older Americans.

  • You can toggle between the details and the strategy. You know the specifics cold and you hold the overall vision — and you move fluidly between the two.

Salary range: $257,500 - $290,000 annually

title: Director of GTM
description:
About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

We're looking for a strategic and collaborative Director of GTM to help scale our go-to-market organization. In this role, you'll partner across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, Recruiting, and Learning & Development to ensure our customer-facing teams have the knowledge, tools, processes, and content they need to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive business results.

You'll serve as the connective tissue across our GTM organization—translating strategy into execution, identifying performance gaps, enabling successful product launches, and creating scalable programs that improve sales effectiveness and customer outcomes.

If you enjoy solving sales challenges, influencing cross-functional teams, and building programs that have measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and continuously improve onboarding programs to accelerate new-hire ramp time.

  • Analyze conversion, win/loss, and retention data to identify what's working and feed it back into training

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate positioning, messaging, and competitive insights into practical sales playbooks, talk tracks, FAQs, and customer-facing resources.

  • Partner with Revenue Operations to support CRM adoption, process improvements, sales workflows, and operational readiness.
  • Collaborate with Customer Experience and Customer Success teams to improve onboarding, retention, upsell, and support experiences.
  • Gather frontline feedback and communicate customer insights back to Product, Marketing, and Sales Leadership to continuously improve our GTM strategy.

Content & Communication

  • Create and refine high-converting playbooks, call scripts, objection-handling guides, and cross-sell/upsell matrices for the sales team.
  • Own the organization and maintenance of sales enablement content, including playbooks, product documentation, competitive battle cards, sales presentations, and knowledge resources.
  • Ensure customer-facing teams have easy access to current, accurate, and actionable enablement materials.
  • Package customer proof points, case studies, and FAQs into reusable assets teams can pull from in the moment
  • Develop scalable communication plans for product launches, process updates, and organizational changes.

Tools & Process

  • Own or co-own enablement tooling (e.g., CRM/helpdesk macros, content/asset libraries, call recording platforms) so teams can find the right resource in seconds, not minutes
  • Partner with RevOps to keep CRM data clean and process consistent across teams

What You'll Bring

  • Prior experience carrying an individual sales quota or serving in a consultative customer-facing role (Sales, Business Development, Account Management, Customer Success, Retail Leadership, or similar). You understand firsthand what it takes to build trust with customers, navigate objections, and operate in a performance-driven environment.
  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing revenue role and/or Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, Sales Operations, Product Marketing, or a related GTM function.
  • Experience designing and scaling enablement programs that improve onboarding, sales readiness, product adoption, or customer experience.
  • Proven ability to build trusted partnerships across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, and executive leadership.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and influence audiences ranging from frontline employees to senior leaders.
  • An analytical mindset with experience using performance metrics, customer feedback, and business insights to identify opportunities and measure the impact of enablement initiatives.
  • A builder's mentality—you enjoy creating scalable programs, playbooks, and processes that help teams perform at their best.
  • High emotional intelligence and credibility. You listen before prescribing solutions, seek to understand the realities of frontline teams, and earn trust through empathy, collaboration, and thoughtful execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a direct-to-consumer, retail, consumer technology, marketplace, or high-growth environment.
  • Experience supporting product launches and go-to-market initiatives across multiple customer-facing teams.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar), learning management systems, and enablement tools such as Gong, Highspot, Seismic, WorkRamp, or similar platforms.
  • Experience coaching managers or facilitating leadership development programs.

Success in This Role

After your first 60-days, you will have:

  • Built scalable onboarding and ongoing enablement programs that improve sales readiness and consistency.
  • Successfully enabled multiple product launches across customer-facing teams.
  • Established trusted partnerships across Sales, Product, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Customer Experience.
  • Increased adoption of key sales processes, tools, and messaging.
  • Demonstrated measurable improvements in ramp time, productivity, customer experience, or sales effectiveness.
  • Become a strategic partner who helps connect business strategy with frontline execution.

Why This Role Matters

Our customers experience our brand through every interaction with our teams. This role helps ensure those interactions are consistent, informed, and customer-centric. By connecting strategy with execution and enabling our teams to perform at their best, you'll play a critical role in helping us scale our business while delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Why You'll Love Inspira

  • Amazing people with a great vision and values
  • Mission-driven team culture focused on student success
  • Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, base plans 100% employer paid
  • Pre-tax benefits (FSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter)
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • 401(k) with company match

description:

Kapta Space, a VC-funded early-stage startup in Seattle, WA, is breaking new ground in Geospatial Intelligence. Our technology centers around a proven, scalable electronically-steered radar for sophisticated spaceborne applications such as earth observation using synthetic aperture radar (SAR) techniques, as well as enabling advanced defense missions such as target tracking on the ground and in the air.

Kapta is seeking a Director - Radar Payloads to own end-to-end development and delivery of Kapta's spaceborne electronically-steered radar payloads. This leader directs multidisciplinary teams spanning RF/microwave, antennas, digital/FPGA, firmware/software, power, mechanical/thermal, systems, AI&T, and manufacturing. The Director is accountable for technical performance, cost, schedule, risk, qualification, spacecraft integration, and delivery, and is a key interface to customers, suppliers, partners, and program leadership. This role requires a hands-on leader who drives rapid technical decisions and execution in a fast-paced environment.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate the ability to apply advanced technical principles, theories, and concepts, and will have the drive and discipline to complete projects independently and on time. Kapta Space recognizes that strong candidates come from diverse backgrounds; if you bring relevant experience and the capacity to grow into this role, we encourage you to apply.

Role

  • Own radar payload architecture and technical baseline across the electronically-steered aperture, RF front-ends, digital/FPGA processing, timing, power, thermal/mechanical, and control electronics.
  • Lead full payload lifecycle execution from requirements and architecture through design reviews, prototype builds, qualification/acceptance, AI&T, spacecraft integration, and on-orbit checkout.
  • Recruit, lead, and mentor a multidisciplinary payload team; set priorities, staffing, technical ownership, expectations, and a culture of accountability and innovation.
  • Partner with Systems Engineering, radar algorithms, software/firmware, GNC, spacecraft, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and operations to achieve mission-level performance.
  • Own payload V&V, calibration, and flight-readiness strategy, including RF/beam performance, timing, reliability, environmental qualification, and end-to-end radar testing.
  • With the Program Management Office, own integrated plans, budgets, schedules, technical milestones, risks/opportunities, and recovery actions to meet cost, schedule, and performance commitments.
  • Drive manufacturability, testability, reliability, cost, and production readiness; lead the transition from prototype builds to repeatable manufacturing and acceptance testing.
  • Serve as the payload technical focal point for customers, suppliers, subcontractors, spacecraft partners, and test facilities; lead reviews, trades, issue resolution, and supplier performance.

Required Qualifications

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a related STEM discipline; MS or PhD preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience developing complex RF, radar, communications, or space payload hardware, including flight or mission-critical systems.
  • Demonstrated experience as a senior/principal technical leader owning the architecture and delivery of complex multidisciplinary payload or RF systems through major lifecycle milestones.
  • 6+ years of engineering leadership/management experience leading multidisciplinary teams, including staffing, mentoring, performance management, and execution accountability.
  • Deep technical expertise in radar system architecture and performance, RF/microwave systems, electronically-steered/phased-array antennas, RF front-ends, high-speed digital/FPGA processing, mixed-signal electronics, timing/synchronization, and power electronics.
  • Strong system-level understanding of embedded firmware/software, PCB design, signal/power integrity, EMI/EMC, mechanical/thermal design, and spacecraft electrical/mechanical interfaces.
  • Proven success taking complex flight hardware from architecture and design through integration, environmental qualification, acceptance testing, manufacturing handoff, and spacecraft/field deployment.
  • Demonstrated ownership of technical performance, cost, schedule, risk, resource planning, supplier execution, and cross-functional delivery for complex engineering programs.
  • Excellent communication skills, with ability to clearly present technical findings and collaborate effectively across engineering functions.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret/SCI security clearance

Bonus if candidates have experience and skills in the following areas:

  • Experience with electronically-steered or phased-array radar systems, including beam-steering, calibration approaches and general space reliability.
  • Familiarity with space-qualified component selection, radiation-tolerant design, COTS-to-space qualification, reliability engineering, and fault-tolerant payload architectures.
  • Familiarity with radar system modeling and simulation, RF/antenna tools, radar/link budgets, signal-processing performance analysis, and thermal/structural analyses.
  • Experience planning and executing qualification and acceptance programs for space hardware and familiarity with applicable standards such as SMC-S-016, GSFC-STD-7000, and MIL-STD-461.
  • Experience in defense contracting environments or ISR/target-tracking radar missions.
  • Prior work in small, fast-iteration aerospace teams.

Concerned you do not meet all the requirements? Not a problem - please apply even if you do not meet all these criteria.

U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, Or Refugee/Asylee Status Required

title: Senior New Business Executive
description:
JUICE is a performance marketing agency that has driven more than $2.5 billion in client revenue for brands like L’Oréal, CBDistillery, Effy Jewelry, Bond Vet, and [solidcore]. Our average client stays with us for over three years, our teams are senior only, and we run on proprietary AI built by our parent company, ONAR. The agency wins consistently once we’re in the room. This role exists to get us into more rooms and to turn those conversations into signed clients.

This isn’t a seat where you build your own pipeline from a cold start. A dedicated BD operations lead runs targeting, outbound, and scheduling, and books qualified discovery calls onto your calendar. The CEO joins your largest closing calls. You own the number.

What you’ll do

  • Own new business revenue for JUICE: run discovery calls, shape the pitch to each brand, write and present proposals, negotiate, and close.

  • Sell monthly retainers to e-commerce and consumer brands, with a minimum engagement size we hold firm on. Quality matters as much as volume: your compensation includes a second-year component, so clients that stay make you money.

  • Work the pipeline our BD operations lead builds for you, and bring your own network on top of it.

  • Keep the pipeline honest: stages, values, and next steps current, reviewed in a weekly meeting with the ONAR leadership team (CEO, President, and Finance).

  • Feed what you hear in the market back into our targeting, our pitch, and our creative.

What good looks like

  • Roughly 20 held discovery calls a month, booked for you, converting to 8 proposals and 2 or more signed clients at or above our engagement floor.

  • A first close inside your first 90 days, with a compounding book from there.

Who you are

  • 5+ years selling agency retainers, ideally $5K to $25K per month, at a performance or digital marketing agency. You’ve carried a number and hit it.

  • A real network in e-commerce, DTC, or consumer brands, and the credibility to get a founder or CMO on the phone.

  • A discovery-led seller. You ask about margins, LTV, and channel mix before you ever show a deck.

  • Confident enough in your close rate to want commission-heavy compensation with uncapped upside.

  • Fluent with modern tools. We use AI daily across the company and expect you to as well.

Compensation

A recoverable draw plus uncapped commission paid on collected revenue, including a trailing component in each client’s second year. On-target earnings are strong six figures with no ceiling; the economics reward sellers who sign clients that stay. Full structure shared early in the process.

How to apply

Submit your resume and a short note answering one question: What’s the largest retainer you’ve ever sold, and how did you win it?

title: Radar / Combat Systems Engineer (Mid - Senior Level)
description:
About P17 Solutions

P17 Solutions is a distinguished Small Business Administration 8(a) certified company, specializing in delivering professional services to a diverse range of clients, including Federal, State, and Local Government agencies, industry partners, and organizations across both public and private sectors. With an unwavering commitment to excellence and a proven track record of success, we have established ourselves as a trusted and reliable provider of cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions.

At P17 Solutions, we are more than just a company; we are your trusted strategic partner in navigating the intricate landscape of government, industry, and technology. Join us on our journey of innovation and excellence as we continue to shape the future of transportation and public services. Visit us at www.p17solutions.com.

Position Summary

Mid- to Senior-Level Radar and Combat Systems Engineer to support mission-critical engineering activities at Naval Surface Warfare Center Dahlgren Division in Dahlgren, Virginia. The successful candidate will apply expertise in the AN/SPY radar family, Mk 99 Fire Control System, radar signal processing, and Aegis Weapon System integration to support system analysis, modeling, integration, testing, and performance evaluation.

The engineer will work with government and industry teams to assess radar and fire-control performance, analyze test and operational data, investigate system anomalies, and develop technically sound recommendations for complex air and missile defense challenges. This position requires an understanding of radar principles and the ability to evaluate how sensors, fire-control systems, weapons, and combat-system elements operate together throughout an engagement.

As one of P17's foundational NAVSEA team members, the selected candidate will have the opportunity to make an immediate technical impact, work directly with company leadership, and help shape P17's growing radar and combat-systems engineering presence at Dahlgren.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze AN/SPY radar performance, including detection, tracking, discrimination, resource management, and engagement-support functions.
  • Support engineering activities involving AN/SPY-1, AN/SPY-6, AN/SPY-7, or related phased-array radar technologies.
  • Evaluate Mk 99 Fire Control System and AN/SPG-62 illuminator performance in support of Standard Missile engagements.
  • Analyze radar signal-processing functions such as detection, filtering, pulse compression, Doppler processing, clutter suppression, beamforming, track formation, and electronic protection.
  • Assess interfaces and data flows among radar, command-and-decision, weapon-control, fire-control, and missile systems.
  • Develop models, simulations, algorithms, or analytical tools to evaluate system behavior and performance.
  • Analyze recorded test, exercise, laboratory, and fleet data to identify performance trends, anomalies, and root causes.
  • Support system integration, verification, validation, and formal test events in laboratory, land-based, and operational environments.
  • Define test objectives, success criteria, data requirements, and analysis methods.
  • Investigate discrepancies involving sensor measurements, track quality, engagement timelines, interfaces, or system-level performance.
  • Prepare technical reports, briefings, test documentation, engineering assessments, and recommendations for government stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Navy engineers, warfare-center personnel, fleet representatives, laboratories, and industry partners.
  • Provide technical mentorship and help develop P17's radar, combat-systems, and signal-processing capabilities.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, systems engineering, physics, mathematics, computer science, or a related technical field.
  • Mid to Senior level experience
    • 5 + years of relevant engineering experience; senior candidates should generally possess ten or more years.
  • Active DoD security clearance or ability to obtain and maintain the clearance required for the position.
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Radar systems
    • Aegis Weapon System
    • Naval fire-control systems
    • Missile-defense systems
    • Digital signal processing
    • Sensor integration
    • Combat-system test and evaluation
  • Working knowledge of radar fundamentals, including waveform processing, detection, tracking, clutter, electronic beam steering, signal-to-noise considerations, and measurement accuracy.
  • Ability to analyze complex technical problems and communicate conclusions clearly to engineering and program stakeholders.
  • Experience producing professional technical reports, analyses, presentations, or test documentation.
  • US. citizenship required; At this time, P17 Solutions cannot provide sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline.
  • Direct experience with AN/SPY-1, AN/SPY-6, AN/SPY-7, Mk 99 FCS, AN/SPG-62, Standard Missile, or another Aegis element.
  • Experience with phased-array radar, including PESA or AESA architectures.
  • Knowledge of Aegis command-and-decision, weapon-control, fire-control, or track-management functions.
  • Experience analyzing radar or combat-system data from laboratory, developmental, operational, or fleet test events.
  • Familiarity with integrated air and missile defense, ballistic-missile defense, anti-air warfare, or naval surface warfare.
  • Experience with MATLAB, Python, C++, or comparable analytical and modeling tools.
  • Familiarity with digital signal-processing techniques, algorithm development, statistical analysis, or data visualization.
  • Experience with requirements analysis, interface-control documentation, verification and validation, or model-based systems engineering.
  • Experience supporting NAVSEA, the Missile Defense Agency, a Naval Warfare Center, or another DoD engineering organization.
  • Active Secret or Top Secret clearance, as applicable to the assigned work.

Work Environment

  • Full-time (remote) OR
  • Full-time, onsite in Dahlgren, VA.
    • Must reside within 90-mile radius; no relocation assistance

• Travel may exceed 30%

Compensation & Benefits

Citizenship and Security Clearance: Candidates must be US citizen. Proof of eligibility and verification is a must. P17 Solutions does not provide sponsorship at this time.

Upon receiving a conditional offer of employment, candidates will undergo a Government investigation and must meet eligibility requirements to obtain and maintain clearance needed for the position. Verification of past employment, education and references is also required.

We offer a competitive compensation salary and a benefits package designed to support you both personally and professionally. The salary range provided is a general guideline and should not be interpreted as a guarantee of compensation. Actual salary shall be commensurate with experience, qualifications, certifications, locality, clearance level and contract requirements. Role Title: Quality Engineer – Yarn & Fabric Inspection Lab (Entry-Level)

Location: Leander, TX, On-site

Shift: 1st shift, Full-time

Role Summary

We are seeking a motivated Textile Quality Engineer to join our team and lead the establishment and operation of a dedicated quality inspection laboratory for yarns and fabrics. In this entry-level role, you will design, implement, and run quality systems focused on 100% cotton, cotton blends, technical yarns, and knitted fabrics. You will ensure product consistency and performance while collaborating closely with textile engineers and production technicians in a fast-paced manufacturing and laboratory environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a driven early-career professional to build a career in textile quality engineering and help stand up critical lab capabilities from the ground up. This role offers clear advancement opportunities into team leadership, textile engineering, and manufacturing engineering roles.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the setup, commissioning, and ongoing operation of a quality inspection laboratory for yarns and fabrics, including equipment selection, layout, standard operating procedures, and workflow design.

  • Develop and implement inspection protocols, sampling plans, and acceptance criteria for cotton and cotton-blend yarns and knitted fabrics.

  • Perform and oversee comprehensive laboratory testing (e.g., tensile strength, yarn uniformity, abrasion, pilling, dimensional stability, colorfastness, fabric construction analysis, etc.) and analyze results against specifications.

  • Collaborate daily with textile engineers on development trials and with production technicians on the manufacturing floor to translate lab findings into process improvements and corrective actions.

  • Collaborate often with software system developers on integrating intelligible inspection data (i.e., the data lake) into high-performance analytical tools.

  • Establish and maintain quality documentation, including inspection records, non-conformance reports, statistical process controls, and technical reports.

  • Train production and technical staff on inspection methods, lab procedures, and quality standards.

  • Troubleshoot quality issues related to fiber, yarn, or fabric performance; root-cause problems and recommend corrective and preventive actions in partnership with engineering and production teams.

  • Ensure compliance with relevant textile testing standards (ASTM, AATCC, ISO) and drive continuous improvement of lab capabilities and inspection efficiency.

  • Stay current with emerging trends in sustainable cotton processing, textile testing methods, and quality management practices.

Basic Skills & Qualifications

  • 0–2 years of relevant experience (internships, co-ops, or capstone projects in textiles or quality strongly preferred). Recent graduates with strong academic or project-based experience in cotton textiles, yarn/fabric testing, or quality systems will be considered.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, Fiber Science, Quality Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.

  • Strong academic foundation and/or project experience in fiber science, yarn spinning, weaving/knitting processes, and textile testing.

  • Working knowledge of cotton fiber properties, yarn quality parameters, and their impact on fabric performance.

  • Familiarity with textile testing standards (ASTM, AATCC, ISO) and basic laboratory equipment operation.

  • Hands-on mindset and willingness to work in both laboratory and manufacturing floor environments; comfort with standing up new lab processes and equipment.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); ability to organize and analyze test data.

  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret technical data and drive root-cause analysis.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and to collaborate effectively with engineers and technicians.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Internship or co-op experience in a textile mill, yarn spinning facility, fabric development/quality lab, or manufacturing quality role.

  • Experience setting up, operating, or improving laboratory testing processes or quality inspection systems.

  • Knowledge of sustainable textile practices, including organic/recycled cotton and related quality considerations.

  • Familiarity with statistical process control (SPC), design of experiments (DOE), or basic quality tools (control charts, capability analysis, etc.).

  • Experience with technical yarns or performance fabric applications and associated quality metrics.

  • Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Minitab, Excel advanced functions, or Python for data analysis).

  • Any relevant certifications (e.g., Certified Textile Technologist, ASQ quality-related credentials, or similar) or participation in textile industry student competitions.

About Us:


Vantedge Medical is the premier metals-based med-tech solutions partner from concept to full-scale manufacturing. We are at the forefront of precision engineering and innovation, specializing in the development and manufacturing of vital components for medical markets such as Robotic Assisted Surgery, Orthopedics, Surgical Instruments, Dental, and more.
