Job Description

Join Us as a Clinical Research Associate (Level II) – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.


As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to perform and coordinate all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. As a Clinical Research Associate (Level II), you'll conduct remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You will manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments (i.e., FSO, FSP, Government, etc.). Acting as a site processes specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigational sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix.

What You’ll Do:
• Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable.
• Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential
• investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Performs trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
• Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
• Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System).
• Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
• Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
• Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.
• Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools, and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members.
• Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.


Education and Experience Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in a life sciences related fieldor a Registered Nursing certification or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.
• Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 1 years as a clinical research monitor) or completion of PPD Drug Development Fellowship.
• Valid driver's license where applicable.
In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
• Proven clinical monitoring skills
• Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
• Demonstrated ability to attain and maintain a working knowledge of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents
• Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical mindset, in-depthinvestigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving
• Ability to manage Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes
• Good oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel
• Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues
• Good organizational and time management skills
• Effective interpersonal skills
• Attention to detail
• Ability to remain flexibile and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios
• Ability to work in a team or independently as required
• Good computer skills: solid knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software
• Good English language and grammar skills
• Good presentation skills


Working Conditions and Environment:
• Work is performed in an office/ laboratory/clinical/and/or home office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
• Frequent drives to site locations. Frequent travel, generally 60-80% but more for some individuals. May also include extended overnight stays.
• Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
• Personal protective equipment required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves.
• Exposure to fluctuating and/or extreme temperatures on rare occasions

title: Backend Utvecklare
description:
Om uppdraget


Till vår kund söker vi en konsult till ett team som ansvarar för utvecklingen av checkout-lösningar i butik. Uppdraget går ut på att skapa en friktionsfri och sömlös kundupplevelse där köpprocessen upplevs som snabb, enkel och intuitiv – oavsett kassakanal.

Teamet präglas av en stark samarbetskultur där kunskapsdelning och gemensamt problemlösande står i fokus. Man arbetar aktivt med att automatisera repetitiva moment för att frigöra tid till värdeskapande arbete. Ägarskap för leveranser och produkter är centralt, och innovation uppmuntras genom kontinuerlig testning, utvärdering och lärande.

Arbetet bedrivs i hybridform där teamet vanligtvis arbetar från kontoret 2–3 dagar per vecka. Med hänsyn till behovet av en effektiv onboarding förväntas konsulten initialt vara på plats i högre utsträckning, samt vid behov även framåt – i linje med teamets och verksamhetens behov.

Vem söker vi?


Vi söker dig som är en senior utvecklare med stark teknisk kompetens och förmåga att omsätta krav och lösningsdesign till robusta och skalbara implementationer.

Du har lång erfarenhet av utveckling av REST API i modern .NET och är van att arbeta med SQL-databaser med hjälp av EF Core. Du har erfarenhet av distribuerad cache, exempelvis Redis, samt god kunskap inom API Management (t.ex. WSO2) och autentisering/auktorisation med OAuth 2.0. Du är bekant med asynkrona och eventdrivna arkitekturer och har arbetat med meddelandebaserade integrationsmönster, exempelvis via Azure Service Bus och/eller Kafka.

Vidare har du erfarenhet av att:

  • Implementera fullständiga lösningar från krav och design till färdig leverans
  • Bygga automatiserade tester som säkerställer kvalitet och verifierar att lösningen uppfyller kravbilden
  • Arbeta med system som har höga krav på prestanda, throughput och tillgänglighet
  • Utveckla och förvalta lösningar i container-baserade miljöer
  • Bygga och drifta molnbaserade lösningar, främst i Azure
  • Arbeta med mikrotjänstarkitektur och versionshantering i Git
  • Hantera DevOps-relaterade uppgifter såsom CI/CD

Du är van att arbeta agilt och trivs i team där samarbete, kvalitet och kontinuerliga förbättringar står i fokus. Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta i tvärfunktionella team nära Produktägare, UX och Design.

Som person


Du har ett seniort mindset. Du har lätt för att lära nytt – och tycker dessutom att det är roligt – samtidigt som du gärna delar med dig av din kunskap till andra. Du kompromissar inte med kvalitet och strävar efter att skriva ren, välstrukturerad och testbar kod.

Du värdesätter transparens och tydlig kommunikation, och ser det som en självklarhet att överkommunicera när det behövs. Du har ett intresse av att förbättra dialogen med kunder och verksamhet – att fånga upp problem, förstå behov och säkerställa att rätt lösningar tas fram.

Du är nyfiken på nya tekniker och arbetar aktivt för att ligga i framkant i din utveckling. Du har god förståelse för komplexa system och utvecklingsmiljöer, och tar ansvar för helheten i lösningar du är med och bygger.

Meriterande

  • Erfarenhet av system med mycket höga krav på tillgänglighet och resiliency
  • Erfarenhet av butikslösningar inom retail, särskilt kopplat till kundvarv, kundresa i butik och utcheckning/kassaflöden
  • Att du aktivt använder AI som stöd i din utvecklingsprocess och har ett intresse av att vidareutveckla dina kompetenser inom området


Ansökan


Låter detta som ditt nästa uppdrag? Skicka in din ansökan eller CV till Vanja Soro, Soros Consulting AB, på vanja.soro@sorosconsulting.se.

Urval sker löpande – varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Okta Architect
description:

This role offers the opportunity to lead enterprise identity and access management initiatives using the Okta platform.
You will architect secure, scalable IAM solutions spanning cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and on-premise environments.
The position has a strong focus on SSO, MFA, lifecycle management, API access, and modern authentication standards.
You will help establish IAM policies, governance frameworks, and security best practices across complex enterprise environments.
As a technical leader, you will guide implementation teams, provide architectural direction, and help resolve challenging integration requirements.
The role is ideal for an experienced identity professional who enjoys combining strategic architecture with hands-on implementation.
You will work in a fully remote environment where strong communication, collaboration, and technical leadership are essential.

Accountabilities

  • Architect, design, and implement enterprise identity and access management solutions using Okta.
  • Design and configure Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), lifecycle management, and API access management capabilities.
  • Integrate Okta with cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and on-premise systems across complex enterprise environments.
  • Establish IAM policies, governance standards, security controls, and best practices aligned with organizational requirements.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to implementation teams throughout IAM projects.
  • Mentor technical team members and support the adoption of effective identity architecture and implementation practices.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive architecture documentation, technical specifications, integration designs, and operational guidance.
  • Contribute to large-scale Okta migrations, consolidations, and identity modernization initiatives when required.
  • Support the adoption of Zero Trust security principles and evaluate opportunities to strengthen identity-centric security.
  • Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into secure, scalable IAM solutions.

    • Requirements

    • Strong knowledge of identity and access management concepts, including SSO, SAML, OIDC, OAuth, and SCIM.
    • Proven experience integrating Okta with complex enterprise applications, cloud services, SaaS platforms, and on-premise systems.
    • Strong architectural understanding of enterprise IAM environments, security controls, authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycle management.
    • Okta certification, particularly Okta Certified Professional or Okta Certified Architect, is strongly preferred.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to design solutions for complex integration and security challenges.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and stakeholders in a fully remote environment.

Watershed is a software platform for running a world-class climate program. We measure our success in the carbon reduction achievements of our customers. We are looking for team members to join our team focused on delivering outcomes for our Financial Institution customers.

The Financial Institutions team customizes the Watershed platform for the specific needs of Asset Managers, Banks, Portfolio Companies and others. Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. title: Senior Vulnerability Researcher
description:
Description

Company Overview:

Cellebrite’s (Nasdaq: CLBT) mission is to enable its global customers to protect and save lives by enhancing digital investigations and intelligence gathering to accelerate justice in communities around the world. Cellebrite’s AI-powered Digital Investigation Platform enables customers to lawfully access, collect, analyze and share digital evidence in legally sanctioned investigations while preserving data privacy. Thousands of public safety organizations, intelligence agencies and businesses rely on Cellebrite’s digital forensic and investigative solutions—available via cloud, on-premises and hybrid deployments—to close cases faster and safeguard communities. To learn more, visit us at www.cellebrite.com, and find us on social media @Cellebrite.

The role:

Remote · France / Europe · Full-time

You'll join Cellebrite's Labs group and work at the frontier of mobile forensics research, breaking into modern Android devices and other embedded targets, from smartphones to drones, turning that research into world-unique evidence-extraction capabilities. Recent devices, from throwaway handsets to the latest flagships, are genuinely hard targets. Hardware-backed encryption, secure boot chains, increasingly hardened security policies and mitigations, and trusted execution environments (TEE/eSE) all stand between an investigator and the evidence.

Your job is to get past all of it. You'll go after the full Android attack surface, from userland and the kernel down to firmware and silicon, across every interface a modern device exposes to the outside world. Expect to go deep on the problems you're given and to have real ownership of how you crack them.

This is work with a clear purpose. Our results help law enforcement lawfully extract evidence and put criminals behind bars, every day. We want researchers who believe in that mission, not just the technical challenge. If you want your research to serve a purpose beyond the exploit itself, this is that place.

Requirements

What we're looking for:

  • Proven experience in vulnerability research and exploitation, ideally on mobile or other modern targets (Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, macOS)
  • Strong reverse engineering skills, mainly on ARM/ARM64 and sometimes more exotic architecturesComfortable working across memory-corruption mitigations (PAC, MTE, CFI, KASLR, and friends)
  • Someone who loves hard problems and treats a locked-down system as a puzzle to be solved
  • Professional fluency in French (our team's working language) and English (used across the wider company)
  • We don't require any particular degree or certification. If you can do the work, we want to talk.

Nice to have:

  • Published research, CVEs, or conference talks
  • Advanced fuzzing experience
  • Knowledge in cryptographic primitives and their weaknesses
  • Offensive hardware research / board design
  • CTF experience
  • AI-assisted vulnerability research / agentic workflows
  • Ability, or willingness to grow into, leading people

How we work:

Remote · France / Europe · Full-time

We're a small team of researchers, fully remote but genuinely close. People share what they're working on, help each other through the hard parts, and you'll always feel plugged into what the team is doing rather than off on an island. We hire for talent and curiosity and back you with the trust and autonomy to go deep on hard subjects.

title: Mark- och anläggningskonsult till stationsprojekt 12420 kV
description:
Mark- och anläggningskonsult till stationsprojekt 12–420 kV

Uppdrag hos Ellevio – nätplanering och stationsprojektering i hela regionnätet, från Hälsingland till Halland

Soros Consulting AB söker för kunds räkning en erfaren konsult inom mark och anläggning till ett uppdrag hos Ellevio. Du kommer att arbeta nära nätplanerare och projektledare i planering och projektering av transformator- och ställverksstationer inom spannet 12–420 kV, från tidigt planeringsskede fram till färdigt förfrågningsunderlag (FFU) för upphandling av entreprenör.

Uppdraget omfattar allt från översiktliga bedömningar till detaljerade mark- och anläggningstekniska utredningar och bedömningsunderlag. Du ingår i en projektgrupp som leds av nätplanerare eller projektledare beroende på projektets fas, och samarbetar med Ellevios tillståndsspecialister (natur-/kulturmiljö och tillstånd) samt nätplanerare som arbetar med 3D-modellering av stationslayouter. Syftet är att tillsammans säkerställa att vald stationsplacering är tekniskt genomförbar, kostnadseffektiv och håller en accepterad risknivå ur mark-, miljö- och anläggningsperspektiv.

Uppdragets omfattning

Som specialiststöd till nätplanerare och projektledning arbetar du bland annat med:

  • Mark-, miljö- och grundläggningsförutsättningar
  • Framtagande av bedömningsunderlag i miljöfrågor
  • Anläggningsbarhet
  • Riskbedömningar kopplade till geoteknik, hydrogeologi och miljö
  • Kostnads- och genomförandepåverkan av olika placeringsalternativ

Stationer med utomhusställverk omfattar normalt kontrollbyggnad, fundament för ställverksportaler och apparater, oljegropar för transformatorer, dagvatten- och avvattningslösningar, väg­byggnation samt stängsel och säkerhetsanordningar – samtliga delar ska beaktas inom uppdraget.

Genomförande i tre steg

Varje steg redovisas i ett skriftligt PM med utredda alternativ, tekniska förutsättningar, identifierade risker och osäkerheter, för- och nackdelar, kostnadsuppskattning samt rekommenderat alternativ.

Steg 1 – Översiktlig screening

Tidig bedömning av lämpliga stationsplaceringar tillsammans med nätplanerare: kartstudier (t.ex. SGU), platsbesök och okulär besiktning, samt översiktlig bedömning av geotekniska, miljötekniska och hydrogeologiska förhållanden.

Steg 2 – Fördjupad verifiering

Teknisk trygghet inför fortsatt projektering, genom att leda och tolka resultat från t.ex. sticksondering (STI), grundvattenrör, provgropar och miljöteknisk markundersökning (MTU) – du behöver inte utföra alla moment själv.

Steg 3 – Underlag för upphandling (FFU)

Tillsammans med nätplanerare tas uppdragsbeskrivning för geoteknisk markundersökning (GMU) fram, i dialog med utförare, och underlaget kvalitetssäkras inför FFU.

Vi söker dig som har

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av mark-, väg- och anläggningsprojektering
  • Erfarenhet av grundläggning och provtagning i jord och berg
  • Erfarenhet av schakt- och sprängningsarbeten
  • Kalkylering, mängdning och kostnadsbedömning i tidiga projektskeden
  • Förmåga att göra riskbedömningar kopplade till geoteknik, hydrogeologi och miljö
  • Erfarenhet av massbalansering och framtagande av preliminära terrassnivåer
  • Kunskap om dagvatten, diken och avvattningslösningar
  • Redovisad erfarenhet från liknande stationsprojekt inom 12–420 kV

Meriterande

  • Erfarenhet av att ta fram och tolka ställverks- och stationsplaner
  • Erfarenhet av planering av entreprenadytor och upplagsplatser
  • Egen utrustning för sticksondering (STI) och installation av grundvattenrör

Upplägg och omfattning

  • 1–2 huvudsakliga resurser som fungerar som kontaktperson mot nätplanerare/projektledare; spetskompetens kan vid behov kopplas in för enstaka moment
  • Uppdragsområde: hela Ellevios regionnät, från Hälsingland till Halland
  • Fältbesök sker som korta insatser per projekt
  • Löpande leverans av tekniska PM enligt respektive steg, underlag anpassade för beslut, projektering och FFU, samt aktiv medverkan i möten med nätplanerare, tillståndsspecialist och projektledare

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

DESCRIPTION

Position Overview

As MES Systems Lead at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will play a crucial role in supporting Manufacturing Execution System (MES) implementation and post-go-live operations at the manufacturing site level.

You will act as the key coordination point between site users, Global MES teams, IT, Infrastructure, ERP, MES offshore development/configuration teams, vendors, and implementation partners. You will use your functional and technical knowledge of MES platforms and manufacturing processes to clarify requirements, support business process reengineering, manage site-level MES governance, and coordinate activities across the full MES lifecycle, from site readiness and implementation through go-live, hypercare, and steady-state support.

You will also play a key role in the site's multi-year manufacturing systems transformation, supporting the transition from legacy MES platforms to PharmaSuite while ensuring business continuity and operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the main site-level IT coordination and governance contact for MES projects and support activities

  • Build strong working relationships with Operations, Quality, MSAT, Validation, Site IT, Global MES, Infrastructure, ERP, vendors, and implementation partners

  • Coordinate MES lifecycle activities including requirements, design, build, testing, training, go-live, hypercare, support handover, and steady-state operations

  • Support and maintain the current MES platform, ensuring system availability, issue resolution, lifecycle management, and business continuity until transition to the target MES solution

  • Track, prioritize, and escalate MES actions, issues, risks, dependencies, and readiness items, ensuring clear business impact, ownership, and timely follow-up

  • Coordinate functional and technical discussions between site users, Global MES teams, and offshore development/configuration teams

  • Support business process reengineering and alignment with the core MES template, global standards, and practical shopfloor needs

  • Capture and translate site feedback, process gaps, user requirements, and local constraints into clear MES requirements

  • Coordinate site readiness for infrastructure, user access, shopfloor devices, printers, scanners, terminals, interfaces, and connectivity

  • Support testing, validation, and compliance activities by coordinating site inputs and action closure with Quality and Validation teams

Compliance & Documentation

  • Ensure MES documentation is complete and current, including processes, user roles, support models, SOPs, work instructions, user guides, and training materials

  • Coordinate CSV and compliance inputs with Quality and Validation teams

  • Ensure documentation is updated when MES processes, access, devices, interfaces, or support models change

  • Maintain clear records of key decisions, open actions, knowledge transfer, and support handover

Continuous Improvement

  • Manage site-level MES governance across demand, changes, tickets, priorities, escalations, and improvement actions

  • Coordinate site support and ensure effective user support and issue resolution

  • Work with Operations, Quality, MSAT, Validation, Global MES, and support teams to prevent MES-related operational bottlenecks

  • Identify recurring issues, training needs, process gaps, and improvement opportunities to strengthen MES performance and supportability

  • Coordinate MES changes, impact assessments, testing, documentation updates, training, and user adoption

REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Information Technology, or related field

  • Experience supporting MES implementations or Site IT projects in manufacturing environments

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, shopfloor operations, and MES platforms

  • Strong functional and technical understanding of MES applications, interfaces, user access, infrastructure, shopfloor devices, and support processes

Key Proficiencies

  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coordination, follow-up, and issue-tracking skills

  • Strong ability to build effective relationships across site, global, and external teams

  • Deep knowledge of MES platforms; experience with Rockwell MES is preferred. Knowledge of Werum PAS-X, Siemens Opcenter, or other MES platforms is an advantage

  • Understanding of MES integration with ERP, LIMS, automation systems, barcode systems, label printing, reporting platforms, and shopfloor devices

  • Ability to translate business and site requirements into clear functional and technical inputs for development/configuration teams

  • Practical problem-solving approach focused on execution, user support, system reliability, and business continuity

  • Fluent in English; additional languages are beneficial.

description:
Sr/Principal Statistician (Sponsor-dedicated) Many possible locations (EMEA) - Early Phase

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provides support across all assigned statistical tasks during the lifecycle of the project, from protocol to CSR.
  • Prepares Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), including development of well-presented mock-up displays for tables, listings, and figures. Collaborate with the sponsor, if required.
  • May be responsible for the statistical aspects of the protocol, generation of randomization schedule, publications and input to the clinical study report.
  • Coordinates the activities of other biostatistics and statistical programming personnel on assigned projects to ensure timely completion of high quality work. Provides independent review of project work produced by other biostatisticians in the department.
  • Creates or reviews programming specifications for analysis datasets, tables, listings, and figures.
  • Reviews SAS annotated case report forms (CRFs), database design, and other study documentation to ensure protocol criteria are met and all data is captured as required to support a high quality database and the planned analysis.
  • Conducts and participates in verification and quality control of project deliverables, ensuring that output meets expectations and is consistent with analysis described in SAP and specifications.
  • Implements company objectives, and create alternative solutions to address business and operational challenges.
  • Serves as biostatistics representative on project teams, interfacing as necessary with other departmental project team representatives. This would include preparing in advance for internal meetings, contributing ideas, and demonstrating respect for opinions of others.
  • Manages scheduling and time constraints across multiple projects, sets goals based on priorities from management, adapts to timeline or priority changes by reorganizing daily workload, and proactively communicates to biostatistics management any difficulties with meeting these timelines.
  • Monitors progress on study activities against agreed upon milestones and ensures the study timelines for project deliverables are met. Identifies out of scope tasks and escalate to management.
  • Provides statistical programming support as needed.
  • May participate in Data Safety Monitoring Board and/or Data Monitoring Committee activities, including charter development and serving as an independent non-voting biostatistician.
  • May lead projects involving integrated analyses, attend regulatory agency meetings or respond to questions, as needed, to support the statistical analysis results of clinical trials on behalf of the sponsor.
  • Follows applicable SOPs, WIs, and relevant regulatory guidelines (e.g. ICH).
  • Maintains well organized, complete, and up-to-date project documentation, and verification/quality control documents and programs; ensuring inspection readiness.
  • Displays willingness to work with others and assists with projects and initiatives as necessary to meet the needs of the business.
  • Supports business development activities by contributing to proposals, budgets, and attending sponsor bid defense meetings.
  • Coaches and mentors other Biostatistics staff.
  • Performs other work-related duties as assigned.
  • Minimal travel may be required.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Lead Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: SSO / Identity Management Specialist (Python / FastAPI / Microsoft Entra ID) (Hi
description:
​
Job Overview:

We are looking for an experienced SSO / Identity Management Specialist to support the implementation of enterprise Single Sign-On capabilities, with an initial focus on Microsoft Entra ID integration.

The ideal candidate has strong backend API development experience, especially with Python, FastAPI, and ideally GraphQL, combined with practical experience implementing authentication and identity protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, and enterprise SSO flows.

This role is initially expected to support a focused SSO implementation project, but candidates with strong API engineering experience may be considered for additional backend work beyond the initial scope.

Job responsibilities:

  • Implement SSO integration with Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Build and maintain backend APIs using Python and FastAPI.
  • Support authentication and authorization flows using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML.
  • Implement the relying-party side of enterprise SSO integrations.
  • Work with technical stakeholders to define, validate, and test identity flows.
  • Debug and resolve authentication, token, redirect, metadata, certificate, and session-related issues.
  • Collaborate with backend and platform teams to ensure secure, scalable, and maintainable implementation.
  • Contribute to documentation for configuration, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer onboarding.
  • Potentially support SCIM provisioning for enterprise customer user management.

Nice-to-Have Skills:
  • Experience with GraphQL.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID enterprise integrations.
  • Experience with SCIM provisioning for user and group lifecycle management.
  • Experience with MFA flows and enterprise security policies.
  • Experience with AWS Cognito.
  • Experience supporting enterprise customer onboarding.
  • Familiarity with audit logging, identity lifecycle events, and access management workflows.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

We are looking for a highly skilled Backend Engineer or Identity Management Specialist with hands-on experience implementing and supporting Single Sign-On (SSO) solutions in production environments. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of enterprise identity and access management concepts and proven experience integrating applications with leading identity providers.

The successful candidate will be comfortable troubleshooting complex authentication and authorization workflows, designing secure and scalable API services, and ensuring seamless user access across systems. They should possess strong problem-solving skills, communicate effectively with technical and cross-functional stakeholders, and be capable of delivering high-quality solutions within fast-paced project timelines.

A proactive mindset, attention to security best practices, and the ability to work independently while collaborating with distributed teams will be key to success in this role.

Job requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience in Python backend development.
  • Deep understanding of Clean Code, Clean Architecture, Modular Architecture, and Distributed Systems.
  • Strong experience with Python backend development.
  • Hands-on experience with FastAPI.
  • Experience designing and implementing backend APIs.
  • Practical experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
  • Experience implementing SSO integrations, specifically from the relying-party / service-provider side.
  • Understanding of identity provider configuration, metadata exchange, redirect flows, token validation, claims mapping, and session handling.
  • Ability to troubleshoot SSO issues across application, identity provider, and configuration layers.
  • Strong understanding of secure API design and authentication best practices.
  • Ability to work independently on a focused implementation project.

Job benefits:

  • A hybrid, flexible working policy.
  • Professional growth and development opportunities.
  • An international team of world-class engineers that brings positive energy.
  • A friendly, supportive, and relaxing working environment in our offices.

title: Actuarial Leadership Development Program (ALDP) Intern
description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Actuarial

Compensation Overview

The hourly salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual hourly rate for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$28.00 - $33.00

Target Openings

32

What Is the Opportunity?

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role.

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in early-mid September. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

The goal of the Actuarial Leadership Development Program (ALDP) internship is to attract and develop self-motivated individuals who are highly skilled and passionate about a career in actuarial while providing a foundation for future success within the organization. As an ALDP intern, you will be exposed to a challenging actuarial professional work experience with planned activities giving you insight into business and the many actuarial career options at Travelers. With many company-wide events such as Intern Symposium and community outreach events, you will have the opportunity to interact and network with many levels of leadership and management. You may have an opportunity to work together with fellow interns to develop and present solutions to relevant business and actuarial topics.

Housing: The Internship program is based in Hartford, CT and St. Paul, MN. Positions are available in our business units and corporate departments. Subsidized apartments are available for students who live beyond a commutable distance from Hartford, CT or St. Paul, MN. Positions are available early June through the end of the summer.

What Will You Do?

  • The ALDP internship has a wide variety of actuarial assignments across numerous Business Lines in areas such as: Pricing and Ratemaking, Reserving, Claim, Risk Analysis, Product Management, Corporate/Enterprise, and Data Science.
  • The ALDP Summer Internship Program provides qualified students an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand business experience, receive valuable on-the-job training, and learn about the many actuarial and analytic positions available in the insurance industry. Interns are provided exposure to all levels of management and have the chance to collaborate and network with other development programs during business workshops, work assignments, and social events. You will learn to leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms with the ability to apply critical thinking to evaluate limitations related to quality and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
  • ALDP interns are viewed as a primary source of future candidates for entry level actuarial and analytic careers within the company. They receive challenging work assignments that add value and impact the business.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or greater preferred.
  • Completion of one or more actuarial exams.
  • Suggested degree majors are Actuarial Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science or a related field.
  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel.

What is a Must Have?

  • Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

We are committed to providing accommodation to persons with disabilities. If you require accommodation during the recruitment or interview process we will work with you to accommodate your needs.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

title: Workshop Supervisor – Long-Distance Fleet
description:
Job Purpose

Lead the day-to-day maintenance, repair and inspection of Company's fleet of over 150 long-distance trucks and trailers (prime movers, tippers, flat-beds, tautliners, tankers, skeletal trailers and general cargo trailers) operating on national and cross-border routes. Ensure maximum fleet availability, safety on the road, on-time preventive maintenance, cost-effective spares management and full compliance with statutory and Tanzanian / regional road-transport requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Supervise mechanics, technicians, electricians, helpers, tyre staff and sub-contracted service providers; organise workshop teams, shift cover and mobile / roadside support crews to service a fleet of more than 150 long-distance trucks and trailers.

• Plan and execute preventive maintenance (PM) schedules for the entire long-distance fleet of 150+ trucks and trailers as per OEM, statutory and company reliability targets; ensure no unit operates on the road with an expired PM or inspection.

• Diagnose faults, plan repairs and ensure timely restoration of equipment to working condition to minimize operational downtime in the CFS / ICD.

• Coordinate with the CFS / ICD yard and operations teams on yard-side equipment availability, urgent breakdowns and equipment rotation; escalate shared-resource issues with long-distance fleet to the Transport / Dispatch office.

• Work closely with the Transport / Dispatch office to schedule PM and repair windows for each truck and trailer around its cargo commitments, road-trip cycles, customer deadlines and cross-border turnaround.

• Provide remote and roadside breakdown support for the long-distance fleet – triage breakdowns over phone / WhatsApp, dispatch mobile mechanics, arrange towing, recovery and third-party repair in upcountry or cross-border locations, and get trucks back on the road quickly and safely.

• Coordinate with drivers on daily pre-trip and post-trip vehicle inspections, fault reporting and cleanliness of trucks and trailers; track repeat fault patterns by driver, vehicle and route.

• Coordinate with the Transport / Compliance team on cross-border fleet documentation – vehicle road service licences, TIR carnets, insurance, road-worthiness, axle-weight compliance and customs requirements.

• Maintain accurate equipment maintenance records – job cards, PM records, downtime logs, spare-parts consumption, fuel / lubricants records.

• Manage spare-parts inventory – ordering, stock control, vendor selection, warranty claims – in coordination with procurement.

• Coordinate with external service providers and OEM dealers for specialized jobs, overhauls, warranty work and statutory inspections.

• Ensure workshop safety – toolbox talks, PPE usage, fire-safety, oil / chemical handling, waste oil disposal, housekeeping and lock-out / tag-out procedures.

• Maintain workshop tools, equipment and infrastructure in safe and reliable condition.

• Control workshop costs – overtime, spares, external service, consumables – within budget.

• Coordinate statutory inspection and certification for the entire fleet – vehicle road service licences, brake tests, axle-weight compliance, SUMATRA / Tanzania police requirements, and any lifting equipment, pressure vessels or fuel tanks used in the workshop.

• Maintain the equipment master list, equipment history files and pre-shift inspection checklists.

• Support incident / accident investigations involving equipment (rollover, collision, fire, fluid spillage).

• Train and develop workshop staff on safe working practices, new equipment technologies and OEM-recommended procedures.

Qualification & Skills

• Diploma / Certificate in Mechanical Engineering, Auto-electrical, Heavy Equipment Technician or related field.

• At least 5–7 years of hands-on experience supervising maintenance of a large long-distance truck / trailer fleet – 100+ units preferred; experience with cross-border operations, road transport companies, or long-haul logistics is strongly valued.

• Sound working knowledge of diesel engines (Euro II / III / IV common-rail), heavy-vehicle gearboxes, axles, air and hydraulic brake systems, suspensions, electrical systems, refrigeration units (if applicable) and trailer sub-systems (skeletal, flat-bed, tautliner, tanker, tipper).

• Practical experience diagnosing and managing roadside breakdowns and coordinating recovery across long distances and cross-border routes.

• Demonstrated ability to lead a multi-shift workshop team, plan work, manage spares and coordinate effectively with Transport / Dispatch.

• Good understanding of Tanzanian road-transport statutory requirements – TS / road service licence, SUMATRA regulations, axle-weight rules, customs and transit requirements.

• Good understanding of workshop safety and OEM maintenance requirements.

• Working knowledge of English and Swahili; competent in Excel / fleet-management reporting.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff Software Engineer.

About the job

Qualifications

title: Director, Software Engineering Management
description:
The engineering organization is a dynamic group of builders, thinkers, and problem-solvers focused on delivering scalable, AI-powered software products that improve how IT organizations function and deliver value. We value clean architecture, intuitive experiences, operational excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement. Every engineer plays an important role in shaping the quality, reliability, and long-term success of our products.

About the Team

You'll join a small, founding engineering team building a new product from the ground up with the mandate and latitude to make foundational decisions on architecture, stack, and engineering practices. This is a rare setup: startup-level speed, ownership, and blank-canvas building, backed by the distribution, resources, and scale of ServiceNow. The team is still small and early-stage today, which means the Director hired into this role will have outsized influence over how the engineering org is shaped from here — team structure, technical standards, and culture included.

Responsibilities include:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across Product, Design, Security, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success — aligning on roadmap and release readiness, meeting security and compliance requirements, and feeding field and customer signal back into engineering priorities.
  • Own technical strategy and delivery for your teams. Set architectural direction, hold the bar on quality and reliability, and stay close enough to the work to validate hypotheses through evidence, not theory.
  • Hire, coach, and develop engineers, tech leads, and managers. Build inclusive, high-performing teams with clear career paths and durable ownership.
  • Lead the evolution of current solutions toward AI-native capabilities, identifying where agentic patterns, data utilization, or autonomous workflows can unlock customer value, and translate those recommendations into staffed, executable work.
  • Establish architecture patterns, engineering standards, and operating rhythms specific to your problem domain. Document tradeoffs, rationale, and implementation guidance to help teams move faster and make consistent decisions.
  • Collaborate across the broader org to share learnings, validate approaches, and accelerate adoption of patterns that work.

To be successful in this role, you have:

  • 15+ years of related engineering experience, including 7+ years leading and managing engineering teams for a product at scale. A significant portion of the experience should be in startups building 0-1 products, taking them to market, and rapidly scaling users using PLG motions and experiments.
  • Strong experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, enterprise platforms, workflow systems, data-intensive products, integration frameworks, or cloud-scale infrastructure.
  • Deep understanding of system design for scale, reliability, observability, fault tolerance, data quality, security, and production readiness.
  • Proven ability to define technical direction, influence architecture across teams, and translate ambiguous product strategy into executable engineering plans.
  • Demonstrated success in building a high performance culture within in a team of senior engineers without compromising wellbeing.
  • Ability to lead through formal authority and technical credibility alike, building alignment across peer engineering, Product, Design, Security, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success organizations.
  • Strong judgment in balancing long-term architecture with pragmatic execution, customer impact, engineering velocity, and business priorities.
  • Strong experience with AI-powered products, AI-assisted workflows, and the extensive use of AI in the SDLC.

Why Join Us

  • Join as a founding Director-level engineering leader on a net-new product, at a stage where product, team composition, and engineering culture are still being actively defined.
  • Operate with significant autonomy over technical direction and team-building decisions.
  • Build with modern, cloud-native tooling and patterns, unconstrained by existing platform conventions.
  • Work on a product with real urgency and a near-term launch target, where your decisions have immediate, visible impact rather than being one layer removed from outcomes.
  • Get the best of both worlds: the speed and ownership of an early-stage build, with the backing, resources, and distribution of ServiceNow.
  • Partner directly with a small, senior technical team to define how AI agents, automation, and human workflows come together with the freedom to make foundational calls that will shape the product for years.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $221,200 - $387,100, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Learning Program Manager - Operations, Construction, and EHS

The Operations, Construction, and Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) Learning Program Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and continuously improving training programs that support safe, consistent, and effective execution across data center operations, construction, commissioning, and environmental health and safety functions. This role partners closely with operational leaders, construction teams, EHS stakeholders, and site personnel to identify training needs, strengthen workforce capability, support regulatory and certification compliance, and ensure employees are prepared to perform critical work safely and effectively. The role also helps maintain the learning catalog, supports site-specific training needs, and uses data to evaluate training effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Conduct regular gap analyses to identify opportunities for continuous program improvement

Utilize training effectiveness metrics to plan and implement program improvements.

Engage with stakeholders across the business to identify risks and determine how training can support mitigation of those risks.

Manage the existing training catalog by updating and retiring courses as needed.

Support operational Edged sites in the development of site-specific training materials.

Partner with Site Operations, Construction, and EHS to ensure certification compliance across regulatory-required training topics.

Partner with EHS team to ensure EHS training programs effectively support safe work practices across both operations and construction.

Ensure maximum value is derived from owner’s training at new sites.

Partner with Data Center Construction organization to develop programmatic support of Edged project management/delivery and commissioning functions.

Oversee the implementation of Data Center Technician qualification program.

Uphold training governance and ensure audit readiness by tracking and reporting on training completion.

Facilitates in-person delivery of training materials to support process adoption and skills development.

Skills

Understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design, and training program management.

Ability to translate complex technical, operational, construction, commissioning, and EHS topics into clear, practical learning materials.

Ability to partner effectively with site operations, construction, commissioning, EHS, and leadership teams.

Experience using training data, completion reports, assessments, and learner feedback to evaluate program effectiveness and drive improvement.

Effective project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple programs, priorities, timelines, and stakeholders.

Familiarity with Learning Management System (LMS) administration, training records management, certification tracking, and audit readiness practices.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate training and communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or 5+ years relevant experience supporting training programs or working within a critical facility, data center, construction, commissioning, industrial operations, or EHS environment.

Experience developing or managing training programs in data centers, critical facilities, construction, commissioning, utilities, manufacturing, industrial operations, or a similarly technical environment.

Experience supporting compliance-driven training programs, technical qualification programs, or role-based learning paths.

Demonstrated ability to work with subject matter experts to develop accurate, scalable, and practical training content.

Experience coordinating cross-functional learning initiatives across multiple sites or business units.

Preferred experience with learning management systems, eLearning tools, instructor-led training, blended learning programs, and training governance processes.
