title: Software Engineer II
description:
Join Our Team and Make a Difference!

Are you looking for an impactful role where you finish the workday knowing you helped someone? Whether you are part of our care coordination team or play a supporting role, the work our colleagues do every day enables us to collectively reach our mission of getting people the care they need when they need it. By staying committed to our core values of Think Big, Go Fast, Deliver Awe, Win Together and Care Deeply,we can positively impact the lives of the injured workers we serve and get them back to the things that matter most in life.

Salary Range:

This compensation range considers a wide range of factors, including, but not limited to, skill set, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate is not adjusted for geographic differential associated with the location where the position may be filled. At One Call, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

What We Provide in Return for Your Commitment to Our Mission
We offer a vast array of benefits to help support the whole you, including:

  • Remote Work: We are a remote-first company, and almost all positions receive the flexibility of working from home.
  • Generous Time Off: Besides 8 company holidays and 2 personal days every year, all colleagues receive a minimum of 18 days of paid time off.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package: Including medical, dental, vision, and pet insurance; 401(k) matching program; and company-paid life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage.
  • Supportive Services: Just like our colleagues get injured workers the care they need when they need it, we want to do the same for our colleagues in their time of need. We offer a Colleague Assistance Program that provides free counseling and financial services, and our One Call Foundation, a non-profit arm of our company, provides colleagues financial assistance during times of unexpected hardships.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Software Engineer is responsible for one or more steps in the development life cycle including designing, coding, testing, implementing, maintaining and supporting software applications used by internal business partners and/or external customers. The Engineer works with business analysts, technical product managers, and other internal business partners to ensure that development tasks are delivered on time and within budget and may provide recommendations for the development of new or updated code.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides application software development services or technical support typically in a defined project.
  • Follows One Call SDLC Standards
  • Develops program logic for new applications or analyzes and modifies logic in existing applications.
  • Codes, tests, debugs, documents, implements and maintains software applications.
  • Maintains, tests and integrates application components.
  • Ensures that system improvements are successfully implemented.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of One Call systems and the workers compensation industry.
  • Participates in Planning and analysis phase of SD projects
  • Analyzes requirements and translates business requirements into product designs.
  • Writes technical specifications and other forms of documentation.
  • Suggests technical alternatives and improves/streamlines processes and systems.
  • Completes project assignments and special projects commensurate with job expectations.
  • Conducts planning, analysis and forecasting activities to plan projects and tasks.
  • May provide leadership and/or guidance to other technical professionals.

EDUCATIONAL AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or the equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience. Additional experience preferences by job level are outlined further below.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Knowledge of end-to-end systems development life cycles (i.e., waterfall, iterative, agile, and other modern approaches to software development)
  • Proficiency in business modeling and requirements definition
  • Excellent customer service skills that build high levels of customer satisfaction for internal and external customers
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to technical and non-technical audiences of various levels in the organization (e.g., executive, management, individual contributors)
  • Willingly shares relevant technical and/or industry knowledge and expertise with other resources
  • Excellent problem-solving and time management skills
  • Resourceful and proactive in gathering information and sharing ideas
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work in an environment that aligns with the company's diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging standards.
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
  • Demonstrate our core values of Think Big, Go Fast, Deliver Awe, Win Together and Care Deeply.

PHYSICAL/MENTAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • This position will be performed in the colleague’s home. Work-from-home requirements include the colleague’s ability to set up computer equipment within their home office. Occasional in-person team meetings may be required depending on the position.
  • This job is primarily sedentary and may involve repetitive motions; the colleague must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods of time, operate a computer and other office equipment, assess information and files stored electronically, and converse/exchange accurate information with others, simultaneously.
  • The colleague must be able to discern text displayed on a monitor, input data into specific fields using a keyboard, and adjust focus to distances of up to three feet.
  • The colleague must have the ability to learn new tasks, follow established processes, maintain focus, complete tasks independently, complete multiple tasks simultaneously, communicate professionally with colleagues and customers, and complete tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity requirement.
  • The colleague must be able to manage moderate to significant mental stress as a result of, but not limited to, a dynamic and heavy workload.

Please be advised that job descriptions typically change over time as business needs, job requirements, and employee skill levels change. As such, One Call retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time.

Software Engineer II

Intermediate professional role. Moderate skills with high level of proficiency. Develops and implements solutions that require analysis and research. Works on small to large, complex projects that require increased skill in multiple technical environments. Possesses specialized knowledge in a specific business area. Works on one or more projects as a team member or occasionally as a project lead. May coach more junior technical staff. Works under general supervision with latitude for independent judgment. May consult with senior peers on certain projects. Typically requires 2-5 years of application development experience.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless to race, color, religion, sex, nationality, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

title: Vil du bli en del av teamet på Hotel Norge by Scandic?
description:
Vil du bli en del av teamet på Hotel Norge by Scandic?

Vi søker nye kolleger til Front Office, Concierge og Housekeeping

Hotel Norge by Scandic er Scandics signaturhotell i Bergen, midt i hjertet av byen. Hver dag ønsker vi gjester fra hele verden velkommen til et hotell med høyt tempo, store forventninger og ambisjoner om å skape gjesteopplevelser som blir husket.

Nå ser vi etter flere dyktige mennesker som vil bli en del av teamet vårt.

Vi søker både deg som ønsker å ta neste steg i hotellkarrieren, og deg som ønsker en fleksibel ekstrajobb ved siden av studier eller annen jobb.

FRONT OFFICE / RESEPSJON

Front Office Shift Leader, fast 100 %

Vi søker én Front Office Shift Leader i fast 100 % stilling.

Som Shift Leader er du en viktig del av den daglige driften av Front Office. Du jobber operativt sammen med teamet, samtidig som du har ansvar for å skape struktur, ta beslutninger og sørge for at både gjester og kolleger blir godt ivaretatt gjennom skiftet.

Vi ser etter deg som trives med ansvar og som klarer å beholde oversikten også når lobbyen er full, telefonen ringer og flere ting skjer samtidig.

I rollen vil du blant annet:

  • Lede den operative driften av Front Office på ditt skift
  • Sørge for at teamet er godt organisert og har tydelige prioriteringer
  • Følge opp gjestehenvendelser og håndtere situasjoner som krever ekstra oppmerksomhet
  • Bidra aktivt i resepsjonen og være synlig og tilgjengelig for både gjester og kolleger
  • Sikre høy kvalitet i den daglige driften og i gjestereisen
  • Samarbeide tett med Housekeeping, Concierge, Technical og hotellets øvrige avdelinger
  • Bidra til mersalg og gode kommersielle resultater
  • Være en kulturbærer og bidra til et positivt, profesjonelt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

Vi tror du har erfaring fra resepsjon, hotell eller annen relevant servicevirksomhet. Erfaring med skiftledelse eller annet operativt ansvar er en fordel.

Det viktigste er at du tar eierskap, liker mennesker og har lyst til å utvikle både deg selv og teamet rundt deg.

Arbeidet innebærer turnus med dag-, kveld- og helgearbeid.

Ekstrahjelper Front Office

Vi søker også flere ekstrahjelper til resepsjonen.

Dette passer godt for deg som studerer, har en annen deltidsjobb eller ønsker en fleksibel jobb innen hotell og service.

Som en del av Front Office-teamet er du ofte både det første og siste møtet gjesten har med hotellet. Vi ser derfor etter mennesker som virkelig liker å snakke med mennesker, finner løsninger og trives når det skjer mye.

Arbeidstid vil variere og kan inkludere dag, kveld, helg og ferieperioder.

CONCIERGE

Ekstrahjelp / deltid

Vår Concierge-avdeling skal gjøre oppholdet litt enklere, litt mer personlig og gjerne litt mer minneverdig.

Her ser vi etter deg som er utadvendt, nysgjerrig og genuint interessert i mennesker.

Du liker å ta initiativ fremfor å vente på at noen spør om hjelp. Du kan hjelpe gjesten med alt fra anbefalinger og praktiske spørsmål til spesielle ønsker og opplevelser i Bergen.

Som Concierge vil du blant annet:

  • Være synlig og tilgjengelig for gjestene
  • Gi personlige anbefalinger om Bergen og området rundt
  • Hjelpe med reservasjoner, transport, aktiviteter og andre forespørsler
  • Følge opp gjester og bidra til gode, personlige opplevelser
  • Samarbeide tett med resepsjonen og resten av hotellet
  • Se muligheter for å gjøre det lille ekstra

Kunnskap om Bergen er definitivt en fordel, men nysgjerrighet, serviceinnstilling og evnen til å finne gode løsninger er enda viktigere.

Vi søker både ekstrahjelper og kandidater som ønsker en deltidsstilling.

HOUSEKEEPING

Ekstrahjelper, dag og natt

Et fantastisk hotellopphold starter med et rom som er rent, innbydende og klart når gjesten åpner døren.

Derfor er Housekeeping en av de aller viktigste avdelingene på hotellet.

Vi søker fleksible ekstrahjelper som kan jobbe dag og/eller natt.

Arbeidsoppgavene kan blant annet være:

  • Rengjøring og klargjøring av hotellrom
  • Rengjøring av bad, korridorer og fellesområder
  • Sikre at rom og områder holder hotellets kvalitetsstandard
  • Rapportere tekniske feil eller mangler
  • Samarbeide med kolleger for å sikre effektiv og god drift

Vi ser etter deg som jobber effektivt, er nøye og tar stolthet i resultatet du leverer.

Erfaring fra housekeeping eller renhold er en fordel, men ikke et krav dersom du har riktig innstilling og motivasjon for å lære.

For enkelte stillinger og vakter må du kunne arbeide natt.

HVEM SER VI ETTER?

Uavhengig av hvilken avdeling du søker til, håper vi du:

  • Trives med mennesker og liker å yte god service
  • Tar ansvar og møter på jobb når du skal
  • Klarer å jobbe effektivt når tempoet er høyt
  • Er positiv, løsningsorientert og fleksibel
  • Bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Forstår at detaljene betyr noe for gjestens totalopplevelse
  • Kan kommunisere på norsk, engelsk eller et annet skandinavisk språk der rollen krever gjestekontakt

Hos oss trenger du ikke være ferdig utlært. Men du må ha lyst til å lære, bidra og bli god i jobben din.

HVORFOR HOTEL NORGE?

Hotel Norge er et stort hotell med mange avdelinger, høyt aktivitetsnivå og gjester fra hele verden.

Det betyr også mange muligheter.

Hos oss får du:

  • Jobbe på et av Bergens mest kjente hoteller
  • Bli en del av et stort og mangfoldig hotellteam
  • Grundig opplæring og støtte fra erfarne kolleger
  • Verdifull erfaring fra en stor og profesjonell hotelloperasjon
  • Muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Muligheter for videre utvikling og karriere i Scandic
  • Personalfordeler gjennom Scandic
  • En arbeidsplass hvor ingen dager er helt like

Vi har høye forventninger til oss selv, men vi skal også ha det bra sammen på jobb.

For oss skapes gode gjesteopplevelser av mennesker som samarbeider, bryr seg og ønsker å gjøre en forskjell.

SLIK SØKER DU

Send oss CV og en kort søknad.

Husk å skrive tydelig hvilken stilling eller avdeling du søker på:

  • Front Office Shift Leader, fast 100 %
  • Front Office, ekstrahjelp
  • Concierge, ekstrahjelp/deltid
  • Housekeeping, ekstrahjelp dag
  • Housekeeping, ekstrahjelp natt
  • Housekeeping, ekstrahjelp dag og natt

Fortell oss gjerne når du kan starte, hvor mye du ønsker å jobbe og hvilke dager/tidspunkter du normalt er tilgjengelig.

Søknader behandles fortløpende.

Kanskje er du den neste som blir en del av Hotel Norge-teamet?

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg.

ENGLISHJoin the team at Hotel Norge by Scandic

We are looking for new colleagues for Front Office, Concierge and Housekeeping

Hotel Norge by Scandic is Scandic's signature hotel in Bergen, located right in the heart of the city. Every day, we welcome guests from all over the world to a hotel with a fast pace, high expectations and a strong ambition to create guest experiences worth remembering.

We are now looking for more great people to join our team.

Whether you are ready to take the next step in your hospitality career or looking for a flexible job alongside your studies or other commitments, we would love to hear from you.

FRONT OFFICE / RECEPTION

Front Office Shift Leader, permanent 100%

We are looking for one Front Office Shift Leader for a permanent full-time position.

As Shift Leader, you will play an important role in the daily Front Office operation. You will work operationally alongside the team while also taking responsibility for structure, priorities and decision-making throughout the shift.

You enjoy taking responsibility and are able to keep the bigger picture in mind even when the lobby is busy, the phone is ringing and several things need your attention at the same time.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading the operational Front Office team during your shift
  • Making sure the team is organised and priorities are clear
  • Following up guest requests and handling situations requiring additional attention
  • Working actively in the reception and being visible and available to guests and colleagues
  • Ensuring high standards throughout the daily operation and guest journey
  • Working closely with Housekeeping, Concierge, Technical and other hotel departments
  • Contributing to upselling and strong commercial results
  • Contributing to a positive, professional and inclusive working environment

We believe you have previous experience from Front Office, hospitality or another relevant service environment. Previous shift leader or operational leadership experience is an advantage.

Most importantly, you take ownership, enjoy working with people and want to develop both yourself and the people around you.

The position includes shift work during weekdays, evenings and weekends.

Front Office

Extra Staff

We are also looking for extra team members to join our Front Office team.

This is a great opportunity if you are studying, have another part-time job or simply want a flexible position within hospitality.

As part of Front Office, you are often both the first and last person our guests meet during their stay. We are therefore looking for people who genuinely enjoy meeting others, solving problems and working in a busy environment.

Working hours will vary and may include daytime, evenings, weekends and holiday periods.

CONCIERGE

Extra staff / Part-time

Our Concierge team is here to make our guests' stays easier, more personal and hopefully a little more memorable.

We are looking for someone who is outgoing, curious and genuinely interested in people.

You take initiative instead of waiting for someone to ask for help. You could be assisting guests with anything from recommendations and practical questions to special requests and experiences in Bergen.

As a Concierge, you will:

  • Be visible and available to our guests
  • Give personal recommendations about Bergen and the surrounding area
  • Assist with reservations, transportation, activities and other requests
  • Follow up guests and help create personal experiences
  • Work closely with Front Office and the rest of the hotel
  • Look for opportunities to do that little bit extra

Knowledge of Bergen is definitely an advantage, but curiosity, a service mindset and the ability to find great solutions are even more important.

We are looking for both extra staff and candidates interested in part-time positions.

HOUSEKEEPING

Extra staff, day and night

A great hotel stay starts with a room that is clean, welcoming and ready when the guest opens the door.

That makes Housekeeping one of the most important departments in our hotel.

We are looking for flexible extra team members who are available to work during the day and/or at night.

Your responsibilities may include:

  • Cleaning and preparing guest rooms
  • Cleaning bathrooms, corridors and public areas
  • Making sure rooms and areas meet our quality standards
  • Reporting technical issues or maintenance needs
  • Working together with colleagues to ensure an efficient operation

We are looking for people who work efficiently, pay attention to detail and take pride in the result they deliver.

Previous housekeeping or cleaning experience is an advantage, but not a requirement if you have the right attitude and motivation to learn.

For certain positions and shifts, you must be available for night work.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

Regardless of which department you apply for, we hope you:

  • Enjoy working with people and providing great service
  • Are reliable and take responsibility
  • Are comfortable working efficiently in a fast-paced environment
  • Are positive, flexible and solution-oriented
  • Contribute to a great working environment
  • Understand that the small details can make a big difference to the guest experience
  • Can communicate in Norwegian, English or another Scandinavian language where the role involves direct guest contact

You do not need to know everything before you join us.

But you do need the motivation to learn, contribute and become great at what you do.

WHY HOTEL NORGE?

Hotel Norge is a large hotel with many different departments, a high level of activity and guests from all over the world.

That also means plenty of opportunities.

With us, you will:

  • Work at one of Bergen's most well-known hotels
  • Become part of a large and diverse hotel team
  • Receive training and support from experienced colleagues
  • Gain valuable experience from a large and professional hotel operation
  • Have opportunities for professional and personal development
  • Have opportunities to develop your career within Scandic
  • Receive Scandic employee benefits
  • Work somewhere where no two days are exactly the same

We have high expectations of ourselves, but we also believe that work should be a place where people enjoy being together.

Great guest experiences are created by people who collaborate, care and want to make a difference.

HOW TO APPLY

Send us your CV and a short application.

Please clearly state which position or department you are applying for:

  • Front Office Shift Leader, permanent 100%
  • Front Office, extra staff
  • Concierge, extra staff/part-time
  • Housekeeping, extra staff day
  • Housekeeping, extra staff night
  • Housekeeping, extra staff day and night

Please also tell us when you are available to start, approximately how much you would like to work and your normal availability.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Maybe you are the next person to join the Hotel Norge team.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: democracyFIRST Voter Protection Deputy Director
description:
Position Title: democracyFIRST Voter Protection Deputy Director

Location: Remote

Salary: biweekly, $4,090

Preferred Start Date: September 1, 2026

End Date: November 20, 2026

Position Summary:

democracyFIRST is seeking an experienced Voter Protection Deputy Director. The role will support the national program by tracking and leading voter protection activity across multiple states. The VoPro Deputy Director will be responsible for ensuring the broader program’s alignment on ensuring access to the ballot, helping turn out voters, and tracking certification and cure activities. This is a full-time remote position that reports to the Executive Director. Given placement of staff across time zones, this employee must be available for work during 10:00am - 6:00pm ET hours with night and weekend availability as the cycle demands.

Responsibilities:

  • Track and develop voter protection efforts across multiple states, including understanding and implementing efforts around: early voting, mail-in-ballot utilization, day-of election protection, and certification/cure efforts.
  • Work with the field team to develop and oversee ballot chase and cure efforts.
  • Build and maintain reporting regarding legal and legislative efforts in priority states that impact election access and administration.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Executive Director and National Organizing Director

Qualifications (You will be a good fit if):

  • Either: At least two cycles of experience in a voter protection role, or, experience working in election law.
  • Experience producing briefing materials, tracking legal and legislative activity.
  • Proven experience in developing voter protection plans utilizing field and paid communications strategies to turn out and protect the vote.
  • Ability to manage several tasks and projects concurrently and to prioritize work effectively.
  • Experience working across campaign departments.

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required):

  • Familiarity with Votebuilder, voter file data, election results data.
  • Previous campaign experience in a field or operations role.
  • Experience automating and managing Google Sheets

Questions about the position may be directed to .

About democracyFIRST

Founded in 2021, democracyFIRST is a cross-partisan and ideologically diverse project that aims to restore the political consensus on the central pro-democracy principles underpinning our electoral process. Our mission is to confront the rising anti-democracy movement in America and preserve the future of our democracy. Our electoral programming is designed to confront, isolate, and defeat the anti-democracy candidates and elected officials who pose the greatest threat of subverting our elections - those in positions that administer and certify our elections on a state level. democracyFIRST is an affiliated organization of Progressive Turnout Project.

About Progressive Turnout Project:

Progressive Turnout Project (PTP) has a single mission: Rally Democrats to vote. Since our founding in 2015, we’ve supported 2,227 Democrats in competitive campaigns, raised more than $368 million from more than 2.4 million unique donors, and deployed 38,962 paid team members. These organizers helped make more than 190 million voter contact attempts at doors and through our innovative field programs.

democracyFIRST and PTP are committed to building a staff that reflects the diverse communities that make up our country and the progressive movement. PTP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and it is PTP’s policy to recruit, hire, train, promote, and administer any and all personnel actions without regard to age, color, creed, disability, economic status, ethnic identity, gender identity, national origin race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veterans status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Dit ga je doen Als Lead Data Engineer bij AS Watson, het bedrijf achter Kruidvat, Trekpleister en ICI PARIS XL, heb je een afwisselende rol waarin je leidinggeven combineert met hands-on werk.

Solliciteer nu, lees de vacaturedetails door naar beneden te scrollen. Controleer of u over de nodige vaardigheden beschikt voordat u een sollicitatie verstuurt.

Je ontwikkelt slimme datapipelines en zorgt ervoor dat algoritmes uiteindelijk op een goede manier in productie komen.

Je draait mee in verschillende projecten tegelijk en werkt nauw samen met een team van enthousiaste specialisten.

Je wordt onderdeel van onze afdeling Data, Insights en Analytics die bestaat uit 4 teams: Decision Analytics, Data Analytics & Enablement, Data Science en natuurlijk Data Engineering.

In deze rol ben je niet alleen technisch sterk, maar je hebt ook een frisse en toekomstgerichte kijk op data engineering.

Je zet de koers uit, inspireert het team en zorgt dat iedereen meebeweegt in de ontwikkeling van een schaalbare en robuuste data-infrastructuur.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Are you ready to join a growing team that puts a premium on productivity and has an award-winning culture centered around transforming talented employees into effective business leaders? Then BHG Financial is the place for you.
In 2001, we started with an idea, an opportunity, and $25,000. Back then, our focus was strictly  on serving those in the medical industry. With healthcare in our heritage, we soon expanded  to serve high-earning professionals in many  other industries, providing all with leading-edge financial solutions, including our extensive network of community banks.
Today, BHG Financial has firmly established  its legacy as a leader in the financial services space. Founded on the philosophy of a better way to borrow, we are dedicated to helping accomplished professionals, small businesses, and institutions build upon their success through innovative financial solutions, a hassle-free process, and personalized concierge service.
Our relentless commitment to the success of our customers is part of what has made BHG Financial thrive. We take a 360-degree view of our customers to tailor the best solutions for their financial aspirations. Today's professionals have multiple sources of income, not just their paycheck. Therefore, it is essential to factor those in when making responsible lending decisions. Our continued focus on data, analytics, and proprietary modeling has enabled faster funding for our customers.
From business to personal loans to relationships with community banks, the country’s top professionals and business owners rely on us for our exceptional financial solutions and concierge service to continue their success and legacy.

Who You Are

You are a motivated Salesforce professional who is passionate about creating and improving business processes within Salesforce. You excel at translating business requirements into workable solutions within the Salesforce platform and have experience supporting users within the platform by troubleshooting and fixing configuration issues while contributing to the development and execution of enhancement road maps based on the needs of your line of business focus. You are motivated and organized and not afraid to get your hands dirty to unravel existing processes in order to determine more efficient solutions while utilizing Salesforce standards and best practices. You thrive in a fast-paced environment where your process improvement and organizational skills help to drive efficiencies of scale in a fast-growing organization.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and deploy Apex classes, triggers, and batch jobs to implement complex business logic and custom workflows.
  • Develop and manage customer and partner portals, Salesforce Communities, and other self-service solutions.
  • Design, implement, and maintain APIs (REST/SOAP) for external system integrations, ensuring robust and secure communication between Salesforce and third-party applications.
  • Develop solutions for effective data handling, including data migration, data cleansing, and maintaining data quality in Salesforce.
  • Build user interfaces using Lightning Web Components and ensure smooth user experiences
  • Develop custom objects, fields, and relationships as needed to meet business requirements
  • Conduct thorough unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of Salesforce components and integrations.
  • Work closely with functional teams, including Business Analysts and QA, to ensure that the developed solutions meet user requirements and business goals.
  • Maintain detailed documentation for customizations, workflows, and integrations for future reference and team onboarding.
  • Customize and configure Salesforce Communities for seamless collaboration and user engagement
  • Manage code versions and deployments using Copado.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You'll Need

  • Minimum of 5+ years of software development & architecture experience in Salesforce
  • Proven experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, and other Salesforce development tools
  • Strong experience in Salesforce portals, communities, and API integrations
  • Expertise in data handling, including data migration and management within Salesforce
  • Solid understanding of Salesforce security model and data architecture
  • Extensive knowledge of Salesforce DX and version control systems
  • Follow Salesforce best practices, including code modularity, reusability, and compliance with security standards.
  • Should stay updated on new Salesforce features and updates, incorporating relevant changes into the development roadmap.
  • Should be able to understand Agile methodologies and software development lifecycle
  • Should be able to provide ongoing support for existing Salesforce configurations, debugging issues, and performing enhancements when required.
  • Travel requirement: Within the first 6 months of employment, all employees will travel to attend the BHG All Oars Experience. Following this event, ongoing travel is minimal—approximately 5% annually—for team on-sites, meetings, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Work Authorization: This role is not eligible for employer-provided immigration sponsorship. To be considered, applicants must already possess valid U.S. work authorization that will not require sponsorship now or in the future.

Life at BHG Financial

At BHG Financial, we work hard and aren’t afraid to take risks. Since the beginning, our core values of PMA (positive mental attitude), team player, and loyalty have been the driving force behind every interaction we have between each other and our customers. We have a healthy respect for the daily grind, yet we value work/life balance. We believe that all employees should have the opportunity to lead and that good ideas can come from anyone. From the top down, our leaders are actively involved not only in strategic oversight and running the business, but also in the well-being and growth of all employees. We consider people our #1 asset, and help employees realize their full potential, set and exceed their goals, and explore new opportunities for personal and professional development.

Why You Should Join BHG Financial

We strive to offer amenities, opportunities, events, and programming that support the interests of our teams, while furthering the culture that makes us Great Place to Work® certified. Some of the benefits you can expect when you join BHG Financial include:
•Medical/Rx/Dental/Vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members
•Competitive PTO and vacation policies
•1 Friday off each month for Wellness Weekends
•Company 401(k) plan with employer contributions after one year
•Company-sponsored training and certification opportunities
•Quarterly award ceremonies where top achievers are celebrated and receive additional bonuses
•Ongoing volunteer opportunities to give back to the community through our BHG Cares program
If you’re ready for a career where you can exercise your passions, be surrounded by co-workers who are relentlessly committed to service, and have a team-player mindset, apply today!
BHG Financial is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. BHG Financial is an equal opportunity employer; committed to a community of inclusion, and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

Ever wondered how the physical goods we consume every day (think dairy, snacks, or your favorite choco chip ice cream) reach you in time? Or how beautiful furniture or sophisticated electronic equipment and gadgets you use are delivered in the best possible condition at your doorstep.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

The role

You will be our first dedicated engineering leader, reporting to the CTO with a direct line to both founders - no layers in between.

Today, engineering at Prior Labs is a small, very senior team. We plan to grow it substantially over the next 18 months, and your job is to build and run that organization.

We want to be honest about what this job is. It is a hands-on operator role: managing engineers, building the hiring machine, setting standards, running compliance, and working closely with our partners at SAP. If you light up at making an organization fast rather than at owning the biggest possible headcount, this is your role.

What you'll do

  • Directly manage and grow the engineering team, including building out its management layer.

  • Build the hiring machine: run hiring operations across our hiring managers, design interview loops that hold up in the AI era, and keep a very high bar while the team grows.

  • Own engineering standards and velocity: how we review, test, and ship - and how the team gets real leverage from AI coding tools.

  • Own our security and compliance program - SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27001 - right-sized, so the lab keeps its speed.

  • Own the engineering side of our collaboration with SAP.

  • Treat the deployment layer as a product surface: our models reach customers through a managed API, customer VPCs, and self-hosted open weights, and the engineering behind that needs customer empathy, not just platform craft.

  • Act as a sparring partner to the founders on org design and engineering direction - we're hiring someone who will argue with us.

What we're looking for

  • You have directly led an engineering organization of 10+ people, including through managers or leads, and you can talk concretely about how you built it.

  • You have owned platform or infrastructure scope at scale: serving, APIs, availability, cloud and vendor budgets.

  • You have operated under SOC 2 / ISO-style audit regimes; having built or run the function yourself is a plus, not a requirement.

  • You have worked in both startups and large organizations - you can create structure from scratch and hold your own with a very large partner.

What sets you apart

  • You scaled an engineering org through a real growth phase (25 to 60+ or similar), building the management layer along the way.

  • You have led engineering through an acquisition, working directly with the parent company.

  • You have led engineering in a research- or ML-heavy organization and know how research code and production code differ - and how to bridge them without slowing research down.

  • You have personally changed how your team works because of AI coding tools, and can show what it did to output.

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy page

title: Fysioterapeutti (myös muut terveydenhuollon ammattilaiset)
description:
Haemme uutta ammattilaista Virkkalan Fysioterapiaan!

Fysioterapeutti, osteopaatti tai muu terveydenhuollon ammattilainen – olisiko tässä sinun seuraava työpaikkasi?

Virkkalan Fysioterapia etsii joukkoonsa uutta ammatinharjoittajaa. Haemme ensisijaisesti fysioterapeuttia, jolla on kiinnostusta ja taustaa manuaalisesta terapiasta. Myös vastavalmistuneet fysioterapeutit ovat lämpimästi tervetulleita hakemaan. Otamme huomioon myös muut terveydenhuollon ammattilaiset, kuten osteopaatit, joiden osaaminen täydentäisi Virkkalan Fysioterapian palveluita.

Millainen ammattilainen sopisi meille?

Etsimme henkilöä, joka:

  • Työskentelee asiakaslähtöisesti ja ammattitaitoisesti

  • On kiinnostunut tuki- ja liikuntaelinongelmista ja manuaalisesta terapiasta

  • Haluaa kehittää omaa osaamistaan

  • Pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti, yrittäjähenkisesti ja vastuullisesti

  • Arvostaa moniammatillista yhteistyötä

Arvostamme monipuolista osaamista sekä halua kehittää ammattitaitoa säännöllisesti kouluttautumalla. Tärkeintä meille on kiinnostus oppia uutta sekä halu tuoda omia ajatuksia työyhteisön ja toiminnan kehittämiseen.

Vastavalmistuneelle tarjoamme mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittää omaa osaamistaan kokeneiden ammattilaisten ympäröimänä.

Mitä me tarjoamme?

Virkkalan Fysioterapia on toiminut samoissa toimitiloissa jo vuodesta 1983. Tilamme sijaitsevat Virkkalan keskustassa, Lohjalla. Tarjoamme fysioterapia- ja hierontapalveluita kaikenikäisille. Vuosien varrella meille on muodostunut laaja ja vakiintunut asiakaskunta.

Ammatinharjoittajana saat käyttöösi valmiit ja viihtyisät hoitotilat sekä työskentelyyn tarvittavan välineistön. Käytössäsi ovat myös ajanvaraus- ja potilastietojärjestelmämme. Tuemme asiakaskunnan rakentumista asiakasohjauksella ja yhteisellä markkinoinnilla.

Virkkalan Fysioterapiassa pääset osaksi kokenutta ja monipuolista työyhteisöä. Meille on tärkeää, että töihin on mukava tulla, osaamista jaetaan ja työtä tehdään yhdessä – vaikka jokainen työskenteleekin itsenäisenä ammatinharjoittajana.

Ammatinharjoittajana saat mahdollisuuden rakentaa työstäsi ja asiakaskunnastasi oman näköisesi sekä hyödyntää omaa osaamistasi ja kiinnostuksenkohteitasi. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden monipuoliseen asiakastyöhön, oman ammattitaidon jatkuvaan kehittämiseen sekä joustavaan työaikaan. Voit itse määritellä työaikasi.

Kiinnostuitko?

title: IT-förvaltningsledare
description:
Uppdragsgivare: Soros Consulting AB Kompetensområde: IT-förvaltningsledare

Nivå: 4 (senior)

Omfattning: 100 %

Ort: Örebro (som regel 4 dagar/vecka på plats, övriga dagar distans – fler dagar på plats kan krävas de första veckorna)

Om uppdraget


Till vår kund SCB söker vi nu en erfaren IT-förvaltningsledare. SCB arbetar enligt etablerade förvaltningsprinciper och driver ett övergripande förvaltningsobjekt som omfattar hela IT-avdelningen. Myndigheten befinner sig i en utvecklingsfas där IT-förvaltningen behöver stärkas genom ett mer systematiskt och verksamhetsnära förändrings- och förbättringsarbete – och du blir en nyckelperson i det arbetet.

Som IT-förvaltningsledare leder och samordnar du förvaltningsobjektet för IT-verksamheten, med både strategiskt och operativt ansvar. Uppdraget innebär ett nära samarbete med verksamheten, externa leverantörer och interna IT-resurser.

Dina arbetsuppgifter


I rollen ingår bland annat att:

  • Säkerställa att förvaltningsobjektet stödjer myndighetens verksamhetsmål
  • Bidra till utveckling av förvaltningsstyrning och arbetssätt
  • Ta fram och förvalta förvaltningsplan och roadmap
  • Leda och koordinera förvaltningsaktiviteter inom IT-området
  • Prioritera och följa upp förändringar, incidenter och förbättringsinsatser
  • Säkerställa leverans i tid, kvalitet och enligt överenskommen kostnad
  • Vara kontaktyta mellan verksamhet och IT
  • Samverka med externa leverantörer och säkerställa leverans enligt avtal
  • Samordna interna resurser inom IT-avdelningen
  • Följa upp mål, KPI:er och SLA:er, samt rapportera status, risker och avvikelser till styrgrupp
  • Hantera risker och arbeta proaktivt med förbättringar

Du kommer också att ha ett tydligt ansvar för att driva förändrings- och förbättringsarbete inom hela IT-förvaltningen (inte bara infrastrukturdelen som dagens förvaltningsobjekt omfattar), bland annat genom att:

  • Leda och strukturera förändringsinitiativ kopplade till IT-förvaltningen
  • Driva kontinuerlig förbättring av processer, arbetssätt och styrning
  • Förankra förändringar hos verksamheten och berörda intressenter
  • Identifiera förbättringsområden baserat på uppföljning och analys
  • Etablera och vidareutveckla arbetssätt för förändringsledning
  • Leda förändringsarbete kopplat till införande av nya system och processer
  • Stödja chefer och team i förändringsresor och bidra till ökad förändringsmognad

Vem vi söker


Vi söker dig som är på kompetensnivå 4: du har en mycket hög kompetens inom området, har genomfört komplexa uppdrag med mycket hög kvalitet (normalt tidigast efter 9–12 års erfarenhet i rollen), tar huvudansvar för ledning av större grupper och arbetar med mycket stor självständighet.

Ska-krav (dokumenterad praktisk erfarenhet, normalt över 2 år och inte äldre än 5 år räknat från sista anbudsdag):

  • Minst 4 års erfarenhet som IT-förvaltningsledare eller i en motsvarande roll
  • Erfarenhet av att leda förändringsarbete inom IT-verksamhet och/eller IT-förvaltning i organisationer med fler än 200 medarbetare
  • Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat enligt ITIL
  • Erfarenhet av att leda komplexa IT-miljöer i en organisation med fler än 200 medarbetare
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med agila arbetssätt och transformationsresor
  • Erfarenhet av leverantörsstyrning – att säkerställa att externa och interna leverantörer levererar enligt krav och bidrar till verksamhetens mål

Meriterande (bör-krav):

  • Certifiering inom ITIL
  • Certifiering inom förändringsledning
  • Erfarenhet från offentlig sektor eller myndighet med fler än 500 anställda
  • Erfarenhet av att etablera eller vidareutveckla förvaltningsmodeller

Så ansöker du


Skicka ditt CV till vanja.soro@sorosconsulting.se. Ange tydligt i CV:t var och hur respektive ska-krav och bör-krav uppfylls (märk kraven i CV:t och motivera kort i fritext med hänvisning till relevant erfarenhet)

Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

title: Plant Operator Trainee
description:
PLANT OPERATOR TRAINEE (ALMA, WI)

The Plant Operator Trainee is responsible to timely complete all training requirements leading to the Plant Operator position, while performing the essential job functions of steps as completed.

The Impact You'll Make In This Role:

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

This list is developed to show the level of duties normally performed by this classification. This list is not an all-encompassing list of duties.

1. Perform maintenance during outages.

2. Perform housekeeping activities to keep the plant clean, orderly, and free from hazards.

3. Perform other duties as assigned. Attain a thorough working knowledge of equipment, procedures, policies, and safety rules by active participation in training programs.

4. Complete requirements as Plant Operator Trainee Area III and be responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation and surveillance of designated turbine/generator auxiliaries, steam generator auxiliaries and other assigned plant auxiliary equipment per the Operator training program.

5. Complete requirements as Plant Operator Trainee Area II and be responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation and surveillance of the turbine/generator, steam generator and other assigned plant auxiliary systems per the Operator training program.

6. Complete requirements as Plant Operator Trainee Area I and be responsible for the coordinated operation of the turbine generator and steam generator in a safe, reliable, and efficient manner per the Operator training program.

7. Required to be capable of performing the following operational functions: Operate manual and automatic valves that could range in size from ¼” to 24” and range in pressure from negative to 2,000 PSI. Be able to distinguish colors, especially the difference between red, green, and yellow. Be able to use tools such as long handled scrapers to clean coal systems. Must be able to identify differences in sound levels to find equipment problems. Operate electrical switches and breakers up to 24,000 volts.

8. Initiates maintenance request for repair of equipment.

9. As you become qualified, rotate through the operating areas routinely to maintain knowledge of plant systems.

10. Assist with drafting and updating operating procedures by reviewing, editing and initiating as needed.

11. Responsible for understanding and following DPC policies, plant operating policies and procedures, lockout/tagout procedure, environmental guidelines, safety programs, Hazardous Substance Emergency Plan and all state and federal reporting and permit requirements.

Your Experience and Expertise:

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Education & Experience: (Internal Candidates) - Associate Degree or two (2) year diploma in directly related field or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be considered.

Applicant must have a background in industrial operations, computer software, maintenance, electrical or instrumentation and possess basic mechanical, critical thinking and reading comprehension skills. Applicant must complete a state-approved Plant Operator apprenticeship program within three (3) years of entering the position.

(External Candidates) - Associate Degree or two (2) year diploma in directly related field or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be considered.

Applicant must have a background in industrial operations, computer software, maintenance, electrical or instrumentation and possess basic mechanical, critical thinking and reading comprehension skills. Applicant must complete a state-approved Plant Operator apprenticeship program within three (3) years of entering the position.

Skills: Must be able to read and understand procedures, blueprints, and technical information. Must be computer literate and be able to navigate through windows-based programs.

Licenses and Certifications: Valid driver’s license.

Physical Demands: Sitting, standing, kneeling, crouching, crawling, twisting upper body, walking, bending, reaching, stretching, writing, hearing, speaking, seeing, fingering, grasping, climbing (stairs, ladders, sky climber, confined spaces), pushing, pulling, lifting (up to 75 pounds; 40 pounds frequently). Become trained and operate scissor lifts and forklifts as required. Must have the ability to wear protective equipment (safety glasses, hard hat, respirators, etc.). Must have the ability to become respirator certified.

Environmental Demands: Work indoors and outdoors, occasionally in extreme cold, heat, and temperature swings, and often in extreme noise. Work around mechanical and electrical hazards, and occasionally work around fumes/odors, dust, chemical and toxic waste hazards.

Other Job Characteristics: Team-oriented crews working rotating shifts. Off-duty availability. Frequent interaction with co-workers. Work overtime as required.

Our Organization and Mission:

The Florida Commission on Human Relations is the state agency charged with enforcing the state’s civil rights laws and serves as a resource on human relations for the people of Florida. It is against Florida law to discriminate on the bases of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, marital status or familial status. The Commission investigates complaints of discrimination in the areas of employment, housing, public accommodations, and state employee whistle-blower retaliation.

The Commission is responsible for promoting fair treatment, equal opportunity, and mutual respect among members of all economic, social, racial, religious and ethnic groups and works to eliminate discrimination against groups and their members.

This is an independent professional position as the Investigation Specialist I, conducting investigations about discrimination cases within the State of Florida. The incumbent will gather and record information accurately and thoroughly through interviews and or correspondence with parties involved in the investigation. This involves conducting research and collecting facts about any complaint assigned and the incumbent must be able to write investigative reports within the statutory timeframes. The incumbent will testify and appear before the Commission panels and in civil court proceedings, and administrative hearings regarding investigative findings and recommendations.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!


As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.


Role Overview


As a Senior Software Engineer on our Pulse Core team, you will be a high-impact individual contributor helping accelerate the velocity of all City’s Experience product teams. You will work alongside a Tech Lead and Engineering Manager in a team that builds and maintains a robust, self-service developer platform and shared core services — and that embraces AI-assisted development as part of its daily workflow. This is an execution-focused role — you will design, build, test, and own features end-to-end. You will contribute to architectural discussions and influence technical decisions, but the overall technical vision is owned by the Tech Lead. Your focus is on delivering high-quality, well-tested code at pace, and on growing your own skills in a team that is defining the future of how we build software.


What makes this a Senior Engineer role (not a Tech Lead role)



  • You contribute to the technical vision and architecture — you don’t own it.

  • You execute on the roadmap with a high degree of autonomy, but you are not jointly accountable for the team’s overall technical direction.

  • You pair with and learn from the Tech Lead, and you mentor mid-level engineers — but uplifting the entire team’s practices is not your primary responsibility.

  • You are expected to be self-directed — you can take a loosely defined problem, break it down, and deliver a well-tested solution with minimal guidance.


Key Responsibilities



  • Design and Build Features End-to-End: Take ownership of features from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You own what you build.

  • Write High-Quality, Well-Tested Code: Primary development is centered on Node.js leveraging your deep backend engineering background from languages like Java, Kotlin, Go to build resilient architectures.

  • Embrace AI-Assisted Development: Use generative AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) as part of your daily development workflow. You don't need to be a power-user from day one, but you should be enthusiastic about learning and growing your AI-assisted coding skills.

  • Own Your Services in Production (DevOps/SRE): Embrace “You Build It, You Run It.” Fully own production deployment, incident resolution, monitoring, and alerting. Actively participate in on-call rotations and build with observability and resilience in mind from the start.

  • Contribute to System Design & Infrastructure: Participate actively in design discussions and infrastructure planning. Help bridge the gap between our code and infrastructure across both cloud and on-premise solutions.

  • Collaborate, Communicate & Mentor: Work closely with Product, Design, and your engineering peers. Support the growth of mid-level team members through pairing, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing.


Required Skills



  • Strong Engineering Experience: 5–8 years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering complex features in production systems.

  • Strong Backend Background: Deep experience in traditional backend languages like Java, Kotlin, or Go. You understand concurrency, distributed systems, API design, and performance tuning, and can effortlessly apply these principles to Node.js development.

  • Full Stack Breadth with Node.js Target: Hands-on experience with Node.js and modern TypeScript/JavaScript across the full stack is a plus, but senior backend engineers eager to apply their Java/Kotlin/Go expertise to Node.js are strongly encouraged to apply.

  • DevOps & SRE Expertise: Proven experience managing production deployments, configuring proactive monitoring and alerting systems, and resolving critical live incidents. Must be comfortable participating in on-call rotations.

  • Infrastructure & Kubernetes: Solid understanding of both AWS cloud infrastructure and on-premise Kubernetes environment setups. Experience with IaC tools (like Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines (like GitHub Actions) is highly valued.

  • System Design Competence: You can design and reason about scalable, distributed systems. You understand trade-offs and can articulate your design decisions clearly.

  • Testing and Quality Mindset: You write unit, integration, and contract tests as a matter of course. Experience with quality tooling and robust CI/CD principles is expected.

  • AI-Assisted Development Awareness: Familiarity with AI coding tools. A genuine enthusiasm to learn and adopt AI-first workflows is essential.


We are open to candidates based anywhere in Poland who are available to travel to the office in Łódź as needed to meet business requirements.


About Arrive


Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision‑makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data‑driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

title: Sr Agent Architect (Germany)
description:
About Parloa

Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience - one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role

As a Sr Agent Architect at Parloa, you will act as a solution architect for enterprise AI Agent deployments. You will design end-to-end system architectures that connect Parloa's platform to complex enterprise environments, solve multi-system integration challenges, and apply systems thinking to build reliable, scalable AI solutions for global enterprise clients.

You will also shape the conversational experience layer, using prompt engineering and your knowledge of LLMs to translate customer requirements into agent behavior. Architecture and integration depth are the core of this role. Conversational design skills are valued and can be developed on the job.

Areas of ownership

  • Design end-to-end solution architectures for AI Agent deployments, mapping how Parloa's platform integrates into customers' enterprise systems (CRMs, ERPs, ticketing systems, contact center platforms).
  • Build and configure integrations using integration platforms and APIs, applying systems thinking to solve complex, multi-system data flows.
  • Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineers on complex or custom integration scenarios that go beyond standard integration capabilities.
  • Apply structured testing approaches to validate architecture, integration reliability, and AI agent performance under real-world conditions.
  • Identify and resolve blockers together with other departments at Parloa (e.g., Product, Solution Engineering, Sales) and the customer.
  • Scope AI Agent deployments, providing strategic architecture advice and execution support to customers and partners.
  • Use your knowledge of LLM internals (e.g., embeddings) to analyze customer requirements and design prompts for reliable, user-aligned agent behavior.
  • Translate complex customer workflows into structured conversational components that LLMs can execute reliably.
  • Fine-tune conversational flows and voice output (e.g., SSML, Lexicons, Regex) to align with customer brand standards.
  • Document best practices, how-to guides, and product capabilities for internal and external audiences, representing the expertise of the Agent Architect team.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise customer-facing roles, with proven expertise in solution architecture, systems architecture, or enterprise integration.
  • Strong systems thinking, with a track record of solving complex technical problems across multiple systems and data sources.
  • Experience with complex SaaS implementations at scale (CRMs, ERPs, contact center platforms, ticketing systems).
  • Proficiency in REST API design, JSON/XML data structures, API testing tools (e.g., Postman), and API authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, JWT).
  • Experience reading and consuming API documentation across enterprise SaaS platforms, including data transformation and field mapping logic.
  • Analytical and critical thinker with expertise in risk assessment and problem-solving.
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with a passion for meeting milestones and effective communication.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with initiative, results orientation, and ability to identify opportunities for impact.
  • Ability to analyze customer requirements and translate them into LLM prompts and conversational flows, with attention to subtle conversational nuance and A/B testing to assess agent performance.
  • Prior conversation design, prompt engineering (e.g., chain-of-thought, few-shot learning), or A/B testing experience is a plus, not a requirement - we will train this.
  • Excellent written and spoken German and English skills are required.

Our Recruiting Process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

title: Senior Total Rewards Lead
description:
Job Description:

RMI is seeking a Total Rewards Senior Lead to own and lead its compensation, benefits, and people analytics function. Reporting to the Director of Talent & People Operations, you will own compensation strategy and administration, benefits program design and oversight, people analytics infrastructure, and LOA policy for a global workforce.

This is the senior Total Rewards presence at RMI. The function is being built and this person will serve as its architect; an experienced individual contributor with full functional accountability for compensation, benefits, LOA policy, and people analytics.

Responsibilities

Compensation Strategy & Administration

  • Own, lead, and evolve RMI’s global compensation strategy, including salary structure design, pay equity framework, job leveling, and the annual compensation cycle.

  • Maintain and evolve compensation benchmarking using market data (e.g., Radford, Mercer, Birches) to keep RMI competitive globally; lead new-hire and promotion benchmarking and the annual pay-equity review.

  • Partner with People Partners and hiring managers on offer recommendations and internal equity reviews.

  • Partner with People Operations on payroll accuracy and timing; serve as the Total Rewards SME on compensation-related payroll questions.

Benefits Strategy & Program Design

  • Own and lead benefits program strategy and design for US and global programs (health, dental, vision, retirement/403b, wellness, PTO, supplemental), with operational administration executed by the Benefits & Compliance Specialist.

  • Lead annual benefits plan assessment and plan design decisions — evaluating coverage, competitiveness, and global benefits structure; advise on renewals in partnership with People Operations, which maintains broker relationships and owns open enrollment execution in Workday.

  • Own and lead LOA policy design and oversight across all leave programs (FMLA, parental, disability, accommodations, sabbatical), with case management handled by the Benefits & Compliance Specialist; serve as policy SME for complex or escalated situations.

People Analytics

  • Own and lead compensation and benefits analytics, including pay equity reporting, salary trend analysis, benefits utilization data, and compensation benchmarking, to support decision-making across the People Team; partner with People Operations on broader People Team dashboards where compensation data is an input

  • Translate data into actionable insights and leadership presentations; partner with Finance on headcount modeling and workforce-planning scenarios.

Functional Leadership & Partnership

  • Own and lead the Total Rewards function end to end — setting strategy, standards, and priorities across compensation, benefits, LOA policy, and people analytics, and driving outcomes through cross-functional partnership rather than direct authority.

  • Partner with the Sr. Manager, Talent & Performance on analytics deliverables that support workforce planning, talent review, and performance management decision-making.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Total Rewards, Compensation, or Benefits, with demonstrated ownership of compensation strategy, benefits program design, and people analytics.

  • Experience supporting a global workforce across multiple geographies and employment types (EOR, direct hire, contractors).

  • Strong analytical skills; proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets and HRIS systems (Workday preferred), including experience building dashboards and analytics reporting using HRIS and compensation data.

  • Knowledge of US benefits compliance (ERISA, HIPAA, ACA) and familiarity with international benefits structures.

  • Experience with FMLA and state leave policy; comfort with LOA frameworks and third-party administrator management.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex compensation and benefits information to all levels.

  • Demonstrated ability to own a function independently and drive outcomes through influence rather than direct authority; experience partnering with specialists and analysts on execution while retaining full accountability for the work.

  • Experience building or maintaining compensation and benefits analytics, including pay equity reporting, salary benchmarking, and benefits utilization data, and translating insights into actionable recommendations for senior leaders.

  • Experience owning and leading compensation survey participation (Radford, Mercer, Birches, or comparable) and translating market data into pay recommendations and job architecture decisions.

  • Strong interpersonal awareness, collaboration, and coaching skills; skilled navigator of differences to build inclusive processes.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and build relationships at all levels in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CCP (Certified Compensation Professional) or CEBS (Certified Employee Benefits Specialist) certification is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with compensation survey platforms — Radford, Mercer, Birches, or comparable — including survey participation and market pricing methodology.

  • Experience with Workday compensation and benefits modules, including system configuration and reporting.

  • Experience owning and conducting pay equity analyses, including statistical review and remediation planning.

  • Experience with international compensation structures — EOR models, developing market pay practices, and multi-currency compensation management.

  • Experience with benefits open enrollment including plan design, employee communications, and coordination with system administration teams.

  • Experience with energy, climate, or mission-driven organizations.

  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Finance, or related field.

We encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply, regardless of whether you feel you meet 100% of the qualifications. The top candidates will bring their own unique perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds from a variety of industries along with many but not necessarily all the skills listed above. We offer professional learning and training opportunities to help you develop the skills you may not have had the opportunity to cultivate yet.

Visa Sponsorship

Please note: At this time, RMI is not able to sponsor employment visas or hire candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the United States. All candidates must have current, independent authorization to work in the U.S. without present or future sponsorship from RMI. We will update our hiring pages if this status changes.

Location

We are a remote-ready company with team members around the globe. Our beautiful and welcoming offices are available for meetings or focused work, whether you are traveling through or living nearby. Our U.S. offices are in New York City; Washington DC; Oakland, California; Boulder, Colorado, and Basalt, Colorado. This role can be located from anywhere in the continental United States.

We provide you with the essential IT equipment plus a one-time home technology payment and a monthly work from home/commuter allowance to ensure you have a comfortable home office set up and necessary supplies.

We love seeing each other in person! We occasionally gather for shared time together like retreats and learning experiences. Be ready to travel for occasional in-person meetings (and of course, we cover travel costs). Some roles may require more travel, which will be discussed during the hiring process.

Compensation

At RMI, we prioritize fairness in our pay practices. Salaries are determined based on a mix of experience, market benchmarks, and internal equity across similar roles. The salary range for this position is $94,930-$117,000. New hires typically start toward the lower end of the range, depending on experience and alignment with the role scope. In addition to base salary, this position includes an annual bonus target of 10% and eligibility for merit-based increases, which are tied to both individual and organizational performance.

Benefits

We offer an array of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance

  • 403b retirement match with immediate vesting

  • Group life, AD&D, and short- and long-term disability

  • Optional voluntary life, AD&D and accident plans

  • Health savings or flexible spending accounts

  • Fertility and hormonal health support

  • Mental health and wellness support

  • Comprehensive leaves of absence (including generous parental leave)

  • Generous paid time off and sick leave

  • Paid sabbatical leave

  • Regional holidays with at least one extended break in each geography

  • Work from home and home technology allowances

  • Learning & development opportunities (LinkedIn Learning and an annual individual professional development budget)

  • Potential for bonuses and merit increases

  • Discount marketplace (gym memberships, pet insurance, etc.)

  • Hybrid / remote work options

  • Team retreats and geographic meetups

  • Rewards and recognition programs

Diversity

We know that the diversity of our teams makes us stronger as an organization, and RMI is dedicated to the principles of equal employment opportunity as outlined in U.S. federal law. We prohibit discrimination against applicants, interns, and employees on the basis of any legally recognized basis, including but not limited to: age (40 and over), race, color, sex, pregnancy (including lactation, childbirth, or related medical conditions), religion, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), sexual orientation, gender expression/identity, uniformed service member status, veteran status, citizenship status, or any other applicable status protected by applicable law.

RMI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Principal Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Guided by our values: Care First. Better Together. Grow Forward. Own It. We create an environment where veterinary professionals can do their best work, build meaningful careers, and deliver exceptional care. Growth with intention. Care without compromise.

Kennel Attendant

Position Summary:

The Kennel Attendant plays an essential role in maintaining the health, comfort, and safety of hospitalized and boarding pets while supporting the veterinary team in daily hospital operations. This position ensures the hospital environment is clean, organized, and welcoming, and provides compassionate care to all animals during their stay.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Provide daily care for boarded animals, including feeding, watering, walking, bathing, and monitoring behavior and health.

  • Assist veterinarians and technicians with restraint, positioning, and minor procedures as directed.
  • Follow detailed feeding, medication, and exercise instructions for boarding pets.

  • Manage inventory of cleaning and kennel supplies and report replenishment needs as appropriate.
  • Unpack and organize deliveries, restock treatment and exam areas, and remove expired or damaged items as needed.
  • Work collaboratively and proactively with team members, offering help whenever needed to support smooth hospital operations.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Previous experience in a kennel, animal care, or boarding facility preferred.
  • Commitment to cleanliness, safety, and compassionate animal care.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and safely handle animals up to 150 pounds.

Ready to Learn More?
