title: Azure Data Platform Leader & Engineering Architect
description:
At AIA we’ve started an exciting movement to create a healthier, more sustainable future for everyone.

As pioneering innovators for over 100 years, we’re now transforming our organisation to be faster, simpler and more connected. Because we want to be even better equipped to develop digital solutions and experiences that help more people live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives.

To get there, we need people with tech/digital/analytics expertise and passion to help develop positive, sustainable change through digitally enhanced experiences that will impact the lives of millions of people and create a healthier future for everyone.

If you believe in developing a better tomorrow, read on.

About The Role

The incumbent is responsible for shaping AIA Singapore’s engineering strategy, building scalable and secure application platforms, and driving best-in-class engineering practices across multiple development teams.

This role manages multiple engineering teams delivering enterprise applications built using modern platform using Java, Python, SQL/Postgres/MS SQL, Kubernetes, deployed as microservices on Azure Cloud. The ideal candidate should bring deep hands-on engineering expertise, strong architectural thinking, and the ability to lead and grow technical teams.

The incumbent will partner closely with Technology, Product, AIA Group teams, and business stakeholders to deliver digital solutions that accelerate AIA’s transformation journey.

What You'll Be Doing

Strategic Leadership


  • Define and drive the engineering roadmap aligned with AIA Singapore’s digital and data strategy.
  • Design scalable, secure, high-performance application architectures leveraging cloud-native engineering on Azure.
  • Establish engineering governance, coding standards, DevOps practices, and quality controls to ensure security, availability, and operational excellence.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and proactively introduce modern engineering capabilities (microservices, containerization, APIs, DevSecOps, data engineering practices, etc.).

Delivery Ownership


  • Oversee delivery of complex, mission-critical applications across 5 engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with AIA Group, Technology teams, and Product Managers to define, plan, and execute the technology roadmap.
  • Ensure teams deliver high-quality, scalable and maintainable solutions within agreed timelines.
  • Remove blockers, optimize engineering processes, and drive continuous improvement in speed, stability, and reliability.

Stakeholder Collaboration


  • Serve as primary point of contact for business units, translating outcomes to measurable deliverables (SLAs, KPIs, timelines).
  • Drive prioritization and backlog management across multiple squads, balancing regulatory deadlines, business demand, and technical debt.
  • Champion data product thinking—clearly defined ownership, contracts, SLAs, versioning, and standardized documentation (API specs, data dictionaries).

Governance Risk and Compliance


  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory frameworks (e.g., MAS TRM, cyber hygiene, records retention), audit readiness, and evidence collection.
  • Own access management and API policy governance (rate limits, quotas, consumer onboarding, keys, secrets).

Operational Excellence


  • Define and monitor SLAs for system availability, performance, and reliability.
  • Implement automation and monitoring solutions to ensure efficient operation and minimal downtime.
  • Oversee capacity planning, mange budget, forecasting costs, optimizing platform usage and infra resources and cost optimization of infrastructure.

People leadership


  • Build and lead a high‑performing team (platform engineers, leads, API developers).
  • Foster a culture of customer focus, accountability, and continuous improvement; mentor managers and senior ICs.
  • Develop talent pipelines, succession plans, and partner strategies (vendors, SIs, managed services).

What You Should Have


  • Degree from a recognized University in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent.
  • 12+ years of total experience in which 10+ years of hands-on software development experience with strong proficiency in Java, Python, Microservices architecture, SQL & relational database design, Kubernetes & containerization, Cloud-native development and 8+ years of engineering leadership experience managing multiple technical teams or large-scale engineering organizations.
  • Proven experience in designing and delivering enterprise-grade systems with high scalability, performance, and availability.
  • Strong architectural mindset with the ability to guide technical direction and make informed engineering decisions.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across business, technology, and group teams.
  • Experience in coaching and developing engineering managers and senior engineers.
  • Insurance/financial services experience is a plus but not mandatory.
  • Highly technical and hands-on when necessary; able to engage deeply with engineers on architecture, design, and code-level challenges.
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to motivate and inspire high-performing teams.
  • Growth mindset and willingness to continuously learn and adopt new technologies.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • Passionate about building sustainable engineering culture, not just managing projects.


Build a career with us as we help our customers and the community live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives.

You must provide all requested information, including Personal Data, to be considered for this career opportunity. Failure to provide such information may influence the processing and outcome of your application. You are responsible for ensuring that the information you submit is accurate and up-to-date.

ABOUT AIA

For over a century, AIA has served the ever-changing needs of our customers across Asia-Pacific. Our Purpose to help millions of people live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives is at the heart of everything we do.

As pioneering innovators, we’re now transforming AIA to be faster, simpler and more connected to create better solutions and impactful experiences for our customers and communities. AIA encourages and enables our people to act with clarity, courage and humanity in service of our Purpose.

JOIN US

At AIA, we believe in empowering every one of our people to find their 'better' - in the work they do, the career they build, the life they live and the difference they make. Whether it’s investing better wellbeing, inspiring better learning, building better relationships, or making a better impact on customers, a career at AIA will challenge you to find new ways to pursue your ‘better’.

AIA is committed to building a vibrant, diverse, and inclusive workforce for all employees to thrive in. Join us if you believe in creating a better tomorrow!

title: Member of Technical Staff (EMEA)
description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

The Role:


As a Member of Technical Staff on the EMEA field team, you build on top of one of the largest inference platforms in the world. The work spans the stack: capabilities on top of inference and serving, tooling around fine-tuning and post-training of LLMs, and the product our region’s customers need that the core platform team will not take on. You are first and foremost an excellent software engineer; that is what we are testing for. You prefer building product to being customer-facing, and that is exactly right for this role, though you are welcome to join customer work when it interests you.

Treat this as a flexible role: a bucket for exceptional builders at different levels of experience rather than a fixed job spec. There is no specific seniority requirement; anywhere from 3 to 10 years of experience can fit.

What we value most is first principles thinking: reasoning about unfamiliar problems from the ground up rather than from playbooks. You will be evaluated on this directly in the interview process, and strength here can outweigh gaps elsewhere in your background.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build: Design and ship product capabilities end to end, from ambiguous need to running in production.

  • Build on Inference: Create capabilities on top of the serving stack: routing, model controls, observability, and whatever a deployment turns out to need.

  • Build on Training: Ship tooling around fine-tuning and post-training of LLMs, from data pipelines to evaluation, working alongside our applied ML engineers.

  • Own Regional Capability: Turn EMEA-specific requirements into product, working with core platform where the line is unclear.

  • Engineering Quality: Set the engineering bar for the regional team; your code is the reference.

  • Agentic Development: Use coding agents and AI tooling as a core part of how you build, with judgment about when to trust the output.

  • Optional Customer Work: Join deployments or customer conversations when useful or interesting; never required.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • First principles and critical thinking: the ability to break down novel problems and reason to a solution without a reference implementation. This is the primary interview signal and can outweigh other qualifications.

  • Excellent software engineering: depth in backend systems and infrastructure, and a track record of shipping production systems you owned.

  • Strong coding skills in Python and at least one systems language.

  • Fluent in AI-assisted and agentic engineering: uses coding agents and AI tooling as a core part of how you build, and knows when to trust the output and when not to.

  • Genuine interest in inference and AI infrastructure.


Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

title: Principal Databricks Engineer
description:
This is a defining role for a technology leader who wants to build things that matter and build the teams that deliver them. As a Principal Databricks Engineer / Architect at Nimble, you won't just be writing code or drawing diagrams; you'll be setting the technical direction for our most significant client engagements and lifting the engineers around you as you go.

You'll be a senior technical voice in our Databricks capability advising on architecture, leading delivery teams, and being the person our clients trust when the problem is hard and the path isn't obvious. We're looking for a hands-on leader who can hold both a room of engineers and client stakeholders with equal confidence, and who has strong opinions (loosely held) about what good data engineering actually looks like.

Your Impact

1. Architectural Vision & Technical Ownership

  • Design for the Real World: Use the entirety of the Databricks platform, in combination with cloud provider services, to design robust, pragmatic solutions. You know when to build, when to buy, and how to advocate for the right choice.
  • End-to-End Accountability: Own the architecture across the full lifecycle of ingestion, transformation, governance, orchestration, serving and consumption whilst staying close enough to the code to know your designs hold up in practice.
  • Data Engineering Fundamentals: Bring rigour to how we model, test, deploy and operate data platforms: dimensional and medallion modelling, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, cost management and data quality by design.

2. Leading Teams of Engineers

  • Lead from the Front: Build and lead high-performing delivery teams, setting direction, breaking down ambiguity and unblocking the people around you.
  • Set the Standard: Establish the bar for "what good looks like" across multiple teams through design reviews, coding standards, architectural principles and reusable patterns. Your expertise and engagement will help to ensure we maintain high operational standards.
  • Empower Others: Mentor and coach Senior and Lead consultants, giving them the confidence and support to drive technical initiatives of their own. Helping to grow the capability, not just build solutions.
  • Trusted Technical Advisor: Build lasting relationships with senior client stakeholders and become their go-to person for technical vision, strategy and the honest answer.
  • Translate Complexity: Diagnose the real problem behind the stated requirement, and explain trade-offs, risks and options in language that lands with both engineers and executives.
  • Bring Clients With You: Uplift client engineering teams as well as your own, leaving them more capable than you found them.

What You Bring

  • Databricks Expertise: Significant hands-on experience with Databricks, having delivered multiple platform implementations end to end, backed by certifications (Databricks Data Engineer Professional or equivalent preferred; Data Engineer Associate as a minimum). Databricks Champion status is a strong plus.
  • Solution Architecture: A proven track record of designing and owning data platform architectures at scale, across at least one major cloud (Azure, AWS or GCP), with a clear grasp of the non-functional requirements that make or break them.
  • Data Engineering Depth: Strong command of Spark, SQL and Python, data modelling, streaming and batch patterns, performance tuning, and engineering practice (version control, testing, automated deployment).
  • Engineering Leadership: Demonstrable experience leading teams of engineers — technically and as people — in a consultancy, product or in-house environment.
  • Client Leadership: Confidence and credibility with senior stakeholders, and the judgement to know when to push back, when to compromise and when to escape.
  • Engaging Communicator: Exceptional interpersonal skills, able to build rapport quickly and explain hard technical ideas to non-technical audiences without losing the substance.

Why Nimble?

We don't just want you to work here; we want you to grow here. We offer a flat structure where your voice shapes our goals and our future.

  • Autonomy & Growth: £2k annual "Champion Fund" to spend entirely as you wish on your own L&D, plus dedicated time to learn.
  • Reward: Competitive salary, company pension, and a £3,000 referral scheme for every successful hire you bring in. You’ll also get access to a cycle scheme and EV scheme through salary sacrifice.
  • Wellness: Private healthcare (for you and a family member), regular 1-1s with mental health first aiders, and a supportive, "egoless" culture.
  • Community & Culture: An active community of Nimblers with a range of shared interests. From capability meet ups, tech talks and meals to escape rooms, bouldering walls and gin tasting, we genuinely enjoy each other's company.
  • Flexibility: Top-tier equipment (Mac or Windows) and a relaxed environment that focuses on client outcomes.

Please be advised we are not able to offer any form of Sponsorship for this role.

description:

Job Description

Second Shift - 3pm-1am

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Location/Division Specific Information:
The Marietta Manufacturing site is a part of the Laboratory Products Division within Thermo Fisher Scientific. Our laboratory equipment products are used primarily by pharmaceutical companies for drug discovery and development and by biotechnology companies and universities for life science research to advance the prevention and cure of diseases and enhance quality of life. Our offering consists of equipment, accessories, and services for sample preparation, storage and protection, and analysis.

To learn more about our Marietta, Ohio site, including the work we do, our culture, and what makes the location unique, visit our Marietta careers page and watch the site video: Marietta | Thermo Fisher Scientific

How Will You Make an Impact?:

The Operator will support the manufacturing process by operating various machinery to provide high-quality parts for work cells to meet scheduled demands.

A Day in the Life:

  • Set up and operate machine on trial run to verify accuracy of machine settings or programmed control data; continue operation to accomplish production goals.

  • Calculate and set controls to supervise machine and enter commands to edit program in order to accomplish quality production goals.

  • Confirm accuracy of first set ups regarding size, build, forming sequence, etc., using test pieces and again with first production piece and at subsequent intervals.

  • Study blueprints, sketches, drawings, manuals, specifications, or sample part to resolve dimensions and tolerances of finished work piece, sequence of operations, and setup requirements.

  • Observe machine operation to detect malfunctions or out-of-tolerance results, and adjust machine controls or control settings as required.

  • Troubleshoot work-related problems by applying knowledge and experience to efficiently maintain production/quality goals with minimal attrition to equipment.

  • Use computer (SAP) system shared plant-wide to accomplish and track production data.

  • Measure, count, coordinate materials and parts to monitor production quality and volume.

  • Clean scale or scrap from die with air hose or brush to achieve quality.

Hammasklinikka Paikka on kahden hammaslääkärin perustama yksityinen hammaslääkäriasema, jonka toiminnan ytimessä ovat laadukas hoito ja lämmin sekä asiakaslähtöinen kohtaaminen.

  • hammaslääkärin työparina toimiminen

  • vastaanoton valmistelu ja potilaiden kohtaaminen

  • välinehuolto

  • ajanvaraukseen ja asiakaspalveluun osallistuminen

Työtehtävät sijoittuvat sekäValkeakosken että Pirkkalan toimipisteisiin. Olemme avoinna arkisin klo 8-20 sekä lauantaisin.

  • hammashoitajan koulutusta

  • iloista ja positiivista työotetta

  • oma-aloitteisuutta ja halua oppia uutta

  • hyviä yhteistyö- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja.

Tärkeintä meille on positiivinen työote, lämmin asiakaspalveluasenne ja halu tehdä laadukasta hammashoitoa yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.

Tarjoamme

  • Vakituisen, täysiaikaisen työsuhteen

  • Viihtyisän työympäristön

  • Pienen ja lämminhenkisen työyhteisön

  • Monipuolisen sekä joustavan työn

  • Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa toimintatapojen kehittämiseen

  • Epassi -etu 400e/vuosi

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi palkkatoiveineen ja CV:si meille. Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Työn aloitus loka-marraskuun vaihde.

Paikalla on väliä.

title: Data Engineer Mle
description:
Data Engineer MLE Insud Pharma•Cequelinos, Galicia, Spain, Spain

Descripción del trabajo

In a few words

Position: Data Engineer MLE

Location: Madrid (Chamberí area).

Want to know more?

INSUD PHARMA operates across the entire pharmaceutical value chain, providing specialized knowledge and experience in scientific research, development, manufacturing, sales, and marketing of a wide range of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), finished dosage forms (FDF), and branded pharmaceutical products, adding value to human and animal health.

The activities of INSUD PHARMA are organized into three synergistic business areas: Industrial (Chemo), Branded (Exeltis), and Biotech (mAbxience), with over 9,000 professionals in more than 50 countries, 20 state‑of‑the‑art facilities, 15 specialized R&D centers, 12 commercial offices, and more than 35 pharmaceutical subsidiaries, serving 1,150 customers in 96 countries worldwide. INSUD PHARMA believes in innovation and sustainable development.

Ready to be a #Challenger?

What are we looking for?

We are AI Labs — the applied AI team at Insud Pharma. 30 people. AI Engineers, Data Scientists, DevOps Engineers, Product Managers building the systems that power how trials get designed, how patients get recruited, and how everything gets monitored once the trial is live.

Clinical trials run on data. Bad pipelines, slow models, and infrastructure that breaks under pressure can cost months — or worse, the trial itself.

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer / Machine Learning Engineer to join our Applied AI Team. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering foundations with hands‑on experience in data pipelines and machine learning systems, and enjoys working at the intersection between data, models, and production systems.

As a Data Engineer / MLE at AI Labs, you will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and product owners to design, build, deploy, and operate end-to-end data and machine learning solutions across multiple business units — including Regulatory, Clinical Trials, R&D, Pharmacovigilance, and Drug Manufacturing.

This role is critical to ensuring that AI models move reliably from experimentation to production, supported by scalable data pipelines, robust ML infrastructure, and strong engineering standards.

How the team works:

AI Labs operates with a startup mindset within Insud Pharma. The department is young, and the culture reflects that: flat, collaborative, and fast-moving. You will work alongside Data Scientists, AI Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and Product Managers who are equally committed to delivering high-quality work.

We hold regular demo days where teams present their work, as well as whiteboard sessions where we tackle problems together. The cross-disciplinary dynamic is genuinely strong. The office is located in central Madrid (Chamberí, near Eloy Gonzalo), well connected and situated in a vibrant part of the city.

The challenge!

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, and serving, supporting both analytics and machine learning use cases.
  • Develop and productionize machine learning pipelines, covering training, validation, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Scientists to translate notebooks and prototypes into robust, production-ready ML systems.
  • Implement model deployment patterns (batch, real-time, or hybrid) using APIs, scheduled jobs, or event-driven architectures.
  • Build and maintain feature pipelines and data abstractions that enable reproducible and reliable model behavior.
  • Ensure data quality, versioning, and traceability across datasets and models.
  • Optimize pipelines and ML workloads for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with DevOps and Platform teams to deploy solutions using containerization and CI/CD best practices.
  • Contribute to defining data engineering and MLOps standards across AI Labs. Participate in code reviews, documentation, and mentoring to foster a culture of engineering excellence.

What do you need?

  • Proficient in Spanish and English, written and verbal communication.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, including clean code practices, packaging, and modular design.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering principles (OOP, SOLID, testing, version control).
  • Hands‑on experience building data pipelines (ETL / ELT) using Python-based frameworks or custom solutions.
  • Experience working with machine learning workflows, including model training, evaluation, and deployment.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and service-based architectures (FastAPI, Flask, or similar).
  • Strong experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and cloud environments (AWS or Azure).
  • Experience with MLOps practices (model versioning, monitoring, drift detection, retraining strategies).
  • Familiarity with orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster).
  • Experience with data storage systems (SQL / NoSQL databases, data lakes, object storage).
  • Exposure to streaming or event-driven architectures.
  • Experience deploying or operating ML systems in regulated or high-reliability environments.
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks and scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow).
  • Interest in applied AI topics such as NLP, LLM-based systems, or scientific computing.

Our benefits!

  • Flexible start time from Monday to Friday
  • Permanent contract.
  • Life and accident insurance.
  • Ticket restaurant
  • Training and language learning platform
  • Wellness platform with unlimited free psychologist sessions
  • Cabify transportation service for employee use
  • Development plans, internal mobility policy.

Many more!

What will the Selection process be like?

Stay tuned to your phone and email! The first thing we will likely do is contact you through one of the two channels.

Prepare well! We will continue with an in-person/virtual interview depending on availability and what we agree upon; there may be one or two interviews in the process, and depending on the type of process, there may also be some kind of test.

Wait for the result! We care that you feel guided throughout each selection process and know what to expect from us, so we will always try to inform you of the status of the process.

Do you think this offer is not for you?

Follow us on social media like LinkedIn/Instagram and stay tuned for any offers we may release; the opportunity to be a new Insuder is waiting!

#InsudPharma #Challenger #Insuder #InsudTalent

KIRA builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Technical Lead owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

We are looking for a reliable Dispatcher to act as a communication point for emergency and non-emergency calls. You will supervise and monitor scheduled deliveries for the transportation department. You will serve as a central contact point for both truck drivers and the warehouse, to help ensure successful delivery to the customer. Will also monitor trucks and drivers once they’re enroute, and they help if an issue arises with a pickup or delivery.

  • Receive emergency and non-emergency calls and record significant information from our drivers and plant personal.
  • Address problems and requests by transmitting information or provide solutions to plant personal and divers throughout your assigned shift.
  • Monitor the GPS of trailers and tractors within our fleet, including monitoring the route and status of field units, and to coordinate and prioritize their whereabouts and return position to the plant.
  • Ensure drivers are dispatched are on time for their scheduled deliveries.
  • Prioritize calls according to urgency and importance.
  • Use phone and/or computer to ensure drivers communicate trailer returns such as the number of empty cases returning to the plant.
  • Provide drivers with information about highway conditions, traffic, obstacles, and requirements.
  • Adjust orders in the system and print tickets for customers.
  • May be asked to perform other responsibilities as needed.

title: Team Lead, Cloud - 1
description:
We are seeking a Team Lead, Cloud to provide technical leadership for a multi-tenant enterprise software product team building and operating high-quality .NET applications. This role is responsible for guiding the delivery lifecycle from requirements analysis through deployment and production support, while driving engineering excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Building on hands-on expertise in .NET and AWS, the Team Lead will own the technical quality of the team's work architecture, design, code review, CI/CD, and security - and partner with internal stakeholders and Infor application teams across onshore and offshore locations to translate business requirements into scalable, actionable technical plans. The lead will manage a team of engineers by allocating workload, conducting performance reviews, and participating in hiring, while driving the adoption of AI and automation to increase productivity and reduce support overhead. This leadership is key to delivering the provisioning, database-migration, configuration-management, and self-service capabilities. This position offers a potential growth path into a Development Manager role for individuals interested in expanding their leadership responsibilities.

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of software solutions from requirements analysis through deployment and production support, owning realistic estimates and proactively communicating risks to committed timelines.

  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business requirements into actionable technical solutions that align with business needs and existing implementations.
  • Coordinate development and QA efforts across distributed teams, ensuring clear communication, documented decisions, and adherence to established processes.
  • Mentor engineers through coaching, knowledge sharing, professional development support, and the adoption of AI and automation to improve productivity and operational efficiency.
  • Experience leading software development initiatives or technical teams in an enterprise environment.
  • Experience gathering, analyzing, and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience conducting code reviews and promoting software engineering best practices.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working with cloud-based applications and modern software development practices.
  • Ability to coordinate work across multiple teams, functions, and time zones, including offshore teams.
  • Demonstrated technical judgment across code reviews, design reviews, root cause analyses, and stakeholder discussions.

  • Experience with AWS or similar cloud platforms.
  • Experience supporting multi-tenant SaaS or enterprise software products.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices.
  • Experience with .NET technologies and application development.
  • Experience with SQL and relational databases, including database provisioning or migration activities.
  • Experience coordinating QA activities, including automation, load, scalability, and security testing.
  • Familiarity with software development lifecycle methodologies, governance practices, and people leadership responsibilities.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history.

Key Responsibilities

  • As a Senior Data Engineer (DE) at Planet, you will own, architect and build production, enterprise-scale data ecosystems using modern cloud technologies, to power mission-critical, customer-facing products. You will act as a strategic partner to cross-functional stakeholders, translating complex requirements into robust, scalable solutions. You will build and design data solutions end to end: from high-level architecture and implementation to CI/CD, orchestration automated QA, and seamless integration into production systems. You’ll be a senior member of the Data Team within the Software Engineering organization, which is made up of data scientists, engineers and analysts working on similar tasks across Planet domains.
  • Your scope will focus on the architecture and evolution of data systems supporting our global monitoring products. These products are vital offerings designed to provide persistent, high-cadence monitoring and active intelligence, particularly for our Defence and Intelligence customers. You will collaborate closely with leadership across Product and Engineering to ensure some of our most sophisticated customers have the data required for global security and rapid decision-making. This role is ideal for an expert data engineer looking to lead the evolution of complex systems and deliver transformative technology to the defense sector. The ideal candidate is an independent operator who thrives in a dynamic, global environment and is deeply passionate about Planet’s mission and national security solutions.
  • This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Washington DC or Denver CO office 3 days per week.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in data engineering with a track record of technical leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Expertise in designing and implementing end-to-end data architectures for global-scale, customer-facing solutions, with a focus on data integrity and efficiency.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and SQL for complex ETL/ELT pipeline construction, including event-driven data architectures.
  • Proactive, self-starter mindset with the ability to lead problem-solving initiatives in a dynamic, high-stakes environment.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical execution and high-level business requirements.
  • Deep experience in maintaining enterprise-grade, peer-reviewed codebases and advanced CI/CD workflows using GitLab CI, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Significant experience with cloud-native architectures (GCP preferred).
  • Experience tuning storage formats such as Parquet to ensure sub-second query performance for consumers.
  • Experience using modern data tooling (e.g. dbt) for pipeline inputs to customer-facing production systems.
  • Experience leveraging Infrastructure as Code tooling (e.g. Terraform) to manage cloud architecture.
  • Experience architecting solutions for geospatial datasets.
  • Knowledge of earth observation and/or satellite operation concepts.
  • This position requires access to export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by the Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.

title: Sanitation- Lumberyard
description:
Franklin Logistics is a local, family-owned business founded in 1985. With six locations in the Chambersburg, PA area, we have grown into a leading 3PL provider and industrial developer, delivering warehousing, transloading, and transportation solutions for over 40 years.

Our employees are the foundation of our success. We foster a supportive, team-oriented workplace where people are respected, safety comes first, and growth is encouraged. Our team takes pride in owning our customers’ challenges and delivering dependable, high-quality service. By embracing change and continuously improving, we strengthen relationships, keep our commitments, and create a positive environment for both our employees and customers.


Are you safety-focused and experienced in assisting with warehouse operations while keeping spaces clean and organized? If so, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Looking for a role where you can stay active and make a real impact every day? The Sanitation/General Laborer keeps things running smoothly by maintaining a clean, organized workspace and jumping in to help stack, unload, and move materials when needed. No two days are the same, so you’ll need to be dependable, adaptable, and ready to roll with whatever comes your way.

If you’re someone who works well independently, has a sharp eye for detail, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-energy environment, you’ll fit right in.

This role reports directly to the site supervisor and is a full-time, hourly, non-exempt position. You may work across multiple locations depending on business needs, keeping things fresh and dynamic. Oh—and you’ll have the opportunity to level up your skills with forklift certification within your first year! This is a full time, non-exempt, hourly position.

  • Hours of operation: Monday-Friday, 7:00AM-3:30 PM
  • Starting pay: $17.00 hourly
  • Receive weekly pay

Primary Job Duties:

  • Clean up and remove trash/debris from Lumberyard
  • Staple covers to lumber bundles
  • Restack lumber bundles
  • Sweep, mop, dust and wipe down breakroom, restrooms, interior of facility
  • Use of push behind or riding scrubber to clean warehouse floors
  • Use of cleaning tools to remove dust and debris from walls, racks, and other items
  • General housekeeping duties in production areas
  • Become certified to operate 5K Forklift
  • Use 5K forklift to move trash hopper (no material handling)
  • Comply with and adhere to all safety policies and regulations

title: Regional Site Specialist - 1st Shift
description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

Location/Division Specific Information

How do we make an impact?

High school diploma or equivalent required.

Experience

Customer requirements may differ from or exceed Thermo Fisher’s criteria.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (Linux/Kion)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer (Linux/Kion) based in the United States.

This role offers the opportunity to support secure, cloud-based infrastructure within a highly regulated, mission-driven environment.
You will combine advanced Linux administration with cloud engineering and DevOps practices across AWS and Azure.
The position plays a key role in maintaining reliable systems, resolving complex technical issues, and strengthening security and performance.
You will work with technologies such as Kion, Ansible, LDAP, SSO, SPNEGO, and SAML while supporting enterprise-scale environments.
The role also involves translating customer and technical needs into practical infrastructure solutions and continuous improvements.
Success requires strong troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams and stakeholders.
This is an impactful opportunity for an experienced cloud engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges in a security-focused environment.

Accountabilities

  • Manage and maintain cloud-based IT infrastructure, systems, and operational processes across enterprise environments.
  • Provide second-level diagnosis and resolution for complex infrastructure and system issues, including analysis of logs, traces, service requests, and supporting documentation.
  • Support the implementation, troubleshooting, maintenance, configuration, and enhancement of customer IT systems.
  • Monitor network and computer system performance through master consoles and coordinate network access, connectivity, and subnet operations with relevant engineering teams.
  • Perform Linux and UNIX administration activities across large-scale environments.
  • Develop, test, debug, and enhance Ansible Playbooks, recipes, and related automation solutions.
  • Analyze security scans, remediate findings, and address Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) to strengthen system security and compliance.
  • Coordinate configuration changes, installations, and upgrades with application owners, including planning, scheduling, status reporting, and adherence to established change-control procedures.
  • Coordinate with third-party teams and contribute to communications, environment reviews, and audits of installed systems and operational processes.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, support procedures, and written instructions for routine and non-routine activities.
  • Evaluate new technologies and products and provide recommendations for improving infrastructure capabilities, reliability, and security.
  • Provide guidance or supervision to junior team members when assigned.

    • Requirements

    • 5–7 years of professional experience installing, configuring, and administering UNIX/Linux-based systems within large-scale enterprise environments.
    • Hands-on experience supporting and securing cloud-based systems in AWS and Azure.
    • Practical experience implementing and configuring Kion.
    • Experience requesting and installing secure certificates, enabling Global Security through LDAP registries, and configuring SSO using SPNEGO and SAML.
    • Strong UNIX shell scripting capabilities and experience with DevOps and automation tools, particularly Ansible.
    • Advanced troubleshooting and analytical skills, including log and trace analysis, vendor coordination, service-request management, documentation, and end-to-end problem resolution.
    • Strong understanding of security standards and hardening requirements, including DHS 4300A, DoD STIG, and FISMA requirements.
    • Ability to evaluate emerging products and technologies and recommend solutions that improve existing environments.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Demonstrated ability to work independently with limited supervision while also contributing effectively within structured, collaborative teams.
    • Strong time management, organizational, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities, with excellent attention to accuracy and detail.
    • Flexibility and adaptability when managing competing priorities and changing operational demands.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with personnel at different organizational levels, including stakeholders outside the IT function and external organizations.
    • Ability to obtain and maintain a DHS Public Trust clearance; the clearance must be fully granted before the candidate can begin the program.
    • AWS, Azure, Ansible, or other relevant DevOps certifications are desirable.
    • Ability to function effectively in a general office environment.

      • Benefits

      • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
      • 401(k) retirement plan.
      • Tuition reimbursement.
      • Flexible Spending Account (FSA).
      • 11 paid federal holidays.
      • Three weeks of paid time off.
      • Full-time employment opportunity supporting a mission-focused technology environment.
      • Opportunity to work with modern cloud, Linux, automation, and security technologies.
      • Professional environment focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and secure infrastructure operations.

title: Service Desk Analyst II
description:
Concentric, LLC is the nation’s largest independent industrial power provider, delivering forklift power, critical infrastructure, mechanical/HVAC, and dedicated material handling and automation maintenance solutions. Through a nationwide network of technicians, engineers, and support teams, Concentric understands and prioritizes the unique needs of each customer to maximize uptime, improve operational efficiency, and maintain infrastructure. We provide reliable, scalable solutions that support data centers, telecommunications providers, utilities, manufacturing, distribution, commercial facilities, and other mission-critical environments across America.


Job Summary


The IT Service Desk Analyst II role provides efficient technical assistance and support to end-users within the organization. This role provides timely support, troubleshooting issues, and offering solutions to internal staff experiencing technical problems related to hardware, software, network, and other IT-related concerns. The role demands excellent communication skills, technical proficiency, and a customer-focused approach to problem-solving. This position reports to the Director of IT Infrastructure and does not have direct reports.


Key Job Responsibilities

  • Reliable attendance and punctuality.
  • Comply with all company safety requirements and complete mandatory training.
  • Provide first and second-level support to end-user issues via phone, email, or in person.
  • Respond promptly to IT support requests and efficiently resolve technical problems with a focus on minimizing downtime.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, including hardware and software problems, and escalate unresolved issues to the appropriate IT teams.
  • Ability to walk users through step-by-step solutions, helping them remotely or on-site when necessary.
  • Install, configure, and maintain hardware and software components according to company policies.
  • Perform system upgrades, backups, and patch management as directed.
  • Maintain accurate records of IT support requests and resolutions using help desk tracking software.
  • Create user accounts, reset passwords, and manage access permissions.
  • Provide technical guidance and assistance to users on IT-related matters.
  • Contribute to IT documentation, knowledge base articles, and user guides to facilitate self-help solutions.
  • Serves as a liaison between the end users and engineering staff to escalate and report information during critical events and/or outages.
  • Will participate in basic project activities, supporting the planning, coordination, and execution of small-scale projects within the company.
  • Other duties as assigned by supervisor.


Key Performance Measurements

  • A scorecard that reflects performance against established IT support SLAs, first contact resolution, ticket closure, customer satisfaction scores, and knowledge base utilization.
  • Other key performance indicators as assigned

title: Project Manager Intern
description:
ABOUT YOU

Ready to experience a better way to build your career? ARCO hires only the best and brightest dedicated to providing our clients with superior solutions, cultivating our award-winning workplace culture, and driving success at all levels of the business.

We are looking for a highly motivated Project Manager Intern to join our team of experts. Because ARCO is committed to creating opportunities for individual success, from day one, you will be given the tools to excel in your role, take on meaningful responsibilities, and experience why ARCO is truly the best place to build a career.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

At ARCO, an Intern works during the summer and has the opportunity to assist Project Managers with the following:

  • Estimating – Describing project proposals and assigning dollar values to the projects
  • Scheduling – Creating a working timeline for subcontractors/trades to complete the project on time
  • Design meetings – Attend design meetings with owner and team to understand design proposals from structural engineers and architects
  • Buyout – Send bid instructions, schedule, and drawings to subcontractors. Receive and evaluate proposals, then award the subcontracts
  • Permitting– Fill out permit forms, submit forms with drawings and fees, then send to city/county/fire and wait for approval
  • Shop Drawing and Submittal Review – Receive shop drawing or submittal from subcontractor, give to PM, communicate to subcontractor that they can begin ordering material and working
  • Billing – Subcontracts, change orders, pay requests, and pay applications
  • Job Site Visits – Visit job site with PM, make sure project is running smoothly

NECESSARY QUALIFICATIONS

  • Enrolled in a Civil/Mechanical/Architectural or Construction Management Bachelor’s degree program
  • Minimum Grade Point Average of 3.0 out of 4.0
  • Previous Internship or Co-op construction experience preferred
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a strong work ethic

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU

At ARCO, we are committed to taking care of our greatest asset – our team. ARCO’s best-in-class benefits and superior compensation are what set us apart from the competition and continue to attract top industry talent.

  • Competitive hourly rate (with overtime possible)
  • Housing stipend (based on need)
  • Internship hours count towards our ESOP eligibility
  • End-of-term performance bonus based on merit
  • Path to full-time position
  • Sign-on bonus for each term served if hired as a full-time associate following graduation
  • Direct access to leaders
  • Intern training program to learn real-world skills
  • 2 formal reviews during your Internship to enhance learning opportunities
  • Traveling to job sites
  • Engagement events

MAKE YOUR MOVE

We are proud to be one of the fastest-growing, privately-owned companies in America, celebrating over 30 years of experience as design-build experts. We have completed over 7,500 design-build projects nationwide. We ranked #9 on ENR’s Design-Build Firms list and #34 on ENR's Top 400 Contractors list of 2026. Most importantly, our clients like us, trust us, and want to do business with us. We are looking for people with the same enthusiasm, passion, and respect for the hard work that brought us to where we are today. Are you a person who can make a difference at ARCO? If the answer is “Yes!” we look forward to meeting you.

ARCO does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies without pre-approval from ARCO’s Human Resources team. Pre-approval is required before any external candidate can be submitted. ARCO will not be responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes and for candidates who are sent directly to our hiring managers. Agencies must have a fully executed vendor agreement in place as well as written approval to submit candidates from an ARCO TA Manager for a specific position before submitting candidates.

title: DevOps Engineer (Azure & AWS)
description:
CHI SIAMO

Adentis Italia è un gruppo europeo di consulenza ingegneristica e IT operativa facente parte del Gruppo MoOngy. Presente in 14 Paesi europei con oltre 8500 dipendenti, abbiamo aperto la prima sede italiana a Milano e, grazie alla nostra continua crescita, stiamo rafforzando e ampliando il nostro team con persone che condividano i valori della nostra società: AMBIZIONE, DINAMISMO, VOGLIA DI METTERSI IN GIOCO. Siamo una realtà in continua evoluzione, dove le relazioni umane sono sempre al primo posto.


Posizione: DevOps Engineer (Azure & AWS)

Sede: Italia

Modalità: Full remote


IL TUO RUOLO

Siamo alla ricerca di un/una DevOps Engineer con esperienza in ambienti cloud Azure e AWS, capace di supportare il team nella progettazione, implementazione e gestione di pipeline CI/CD, infrastrutture Kubernetes e processi di automazione.

La figura ideale possiede solide competenze in ambito Cloud Native, scripting e sviluppo Python, con esperienza nella gestione di cluster Kubernetes e strumenti GitOps.


Responsabilità principali:

  • Definizione, sviluppo e manutenzione di pipeline CI/CD in ambienti Azure e AWS
  • Automazione di processi infrastrutturali e applicativi tramite scripting e Python
  • Gestione e orchestrazione di cluster Kubernetes
  • Implementazione di strategie di delivery applicativo in ambienti containerizzati
  • Gestione di deployment GitOps tramite strumenti come ArgoCD o Flux
  • Supporto nella configurazione e gestione di Helm Chart e Ansible
  • Collaborazione con team di sviluppo e infrastruttura per migliorare processi di rilascio e monitoraggio
  • Gestione e ottimizzazione di repository e pipeline su Azure DevOps


Requisiti:

  • Esperienza di almeno 4 anni in ambito DevOps su cloud Azure e/o AWS
  • Ottima conoscenza di Kubernetes e architetture Cloud Native
  • Esperienza con Rancher e/o RKE2
  • Esperienza nella creazione e gestione di cluster Kubernetes, anche tramite kubeadm
  • Conoscenza dei processi CI/CD e strumenti Azure DevOps
  • Esperienza con strumenti GitOps (ArgoCD, Flux)
  • Utilizzo avanzato di Helm Chart
  • Conoscenza di Ansible per automazione e configurazione
  • Buona esperienza di sviluppo/scripting in Python
  • Familiarità con repository e sorgenti Azure DevOps
  • Conoscenza di altri linguaggi di programmazione oltre Python costituisce un plus
  • Conoscenza di DLT (Delta Live Tables) o tecnologie analoghe considerata un plus


La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 30.000 EUR e 35.000 EUR.

La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato dalla nostra società.


Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna.



Cosa offriamo?

  • Contratto a tempo indeterminato o collaborazione in partita iva.
  • Strumenti di formazione sia per le hard che soft skills
  • Follow-up costanti con il team HR e con il proprio Business Manager
  • Un piano di crescita professionale ben strutturato in un ambiente dinamico e stimolante


The world needs you

Adentis Italia è un equal opportunities employer: crediamo che tutte le forme di diversità siano fonte di arricchimento reciproco. Ci impegniamo a garantire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, nel quale ogni singola risorsa possa apportare un valore unico alla nostra realtà. Pertanto, accogliamo candidature senza distinzione di età, genere, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o stato civile. Inoltre, teniamo fede ai nostri impegni prestando attenzione alle risorse appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi degli articoli 1 e 18 della Legge 68/99. I dati personali saranno trattati in conformità alle disposizioni contenute nel regolamento UE 2016/679.

title: Backend Engineer
description:
HUMAN’s Application Protection products safeguard online businesses and their customers from sophisticated bots, fraud, and abuse.

The Enforcers team builds the software that connects customer traffic to HUMAN’s real-time detection platform and applies protection decisions directly within customers’ environments. Our components run across CDNs, cloud and serverless platforms, web servers, and application frameworks, making performance, reliability, security, and portability central to everything we build.

We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join the team and help develop the integration and enforcement layer behind HUMAN’s products. You will work on production software deployed in diverse environments, solve complex web and infrastructure challenges, and own features from design through delivery and operation.

What you’ll do

  • Design, build, and maintain backend and edge components that integrate HUMAN’s detection and enforcement capabilities into customer environments.

  • Develop reliable, secure, and maintainable services and SDKs, primarily using JavaScript and TypeScript.

  • Own the full software lifecycle, including technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

  • Optimize performance and reliability for latency-sensitive components that operate directly in the request path.

  • Solve portability and integration challenges across different platforms, runtimes, and customer architectures.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Security Research, Customer Success Engineering, and other Engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.

  • Investigate complex production and customer-integration issues and turn what you learn into product and engineering improvements.

Who you are

  • 4+ years of hands-on software development experience, with a focus on backend or platform engineering.

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript, including experience building and maintaining production systems with Node.js.

  • Solid understanding of backend engineering fundamentals, HTTP-based services, APIs, and web infrastructure.

  • Experience writing clean, testable, and maintainable code and taking ownership of features through production.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate unfamiliar systems and complex technical issues.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively across teams and disciplines.
